Then add spicy chutney, chaat masala, squeeze in the lemon juice, and mix well.
Garnish the top with sev and fresh coriander leaves.
Collegian bhel is ready.
First, soak the chana dal and urad dal for up to 5 hours.
Then drain the water, coarsely crush them in a mixer, add curd, and crush again.
Then add turmeric, ginger-green chilli paste, salt, soda, and one teaspoon of oil, and mix very well.
Next, grease a plate with oil, place it to steam like dhokla, and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Then remove it onto a plate using a spatula, top it with 1 teaspoon of butter and 1 teaspoon of locho masala, sprinkle fine sev on top, and the locho is ready.
Method for locho masala –
Take 1 teaspoon chilli powder, 1 teaspoon chaat masala, and 1 teaspoon roasted cumin powder, mix them together, and the masala is ready.
Wash and boil the potatoes.
Once boiled, peel them and pierce holes in them using a fork.
In a bowl, add lemon juice, grated dry coconut, coriander-cumin powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder, spicy red chilli powder, garam masala, and salt, and mix well.
Then add the boiled potatoes to it, mix well, and sprinkle fresh coriander leaves on top.
Serve these spicy potatoes with roasted peanuts.
Toast the plain prepared dabeli in a non-stick pan using 1 teaspoon of butter.
Prepare all the remaining dabelis by roasting them in butter in this manner.
Can be served with spicy-sweet chutney.
First, place 1 tsp of cheese (grated) into the ready Dabeli and close the pav to prepare the Dabeli.
Next, roast the prepared Dabeli in a non-stick pan using 1 tsp of butter.
Hot and ready is the cheese Dabeli.
Can be served with spicy-sweet chutney.
First wash the potatoes, pierce holes in them, add salt and boil them. Then peel them.
Afterwards, extract the lemon juice.
In a bowl, add lemon juice, sugar, coconut, coriander-cumin powder and salt to taste.
Then add Kashmiri red chilli powder, red chilli powder (medium spicy) and garam masala and mix well.
Then add a little warm water.
Next, mix the boiled potatoes into it and put fresh coriander leaves on top.
Fry the bhungra (fryums) in oil.
Then the potato-bhungra is ready.
542.note: Serve the bhungra hot with the prepared potatoes and you can also add sweet chutney to the potatoes according to your taste.

ing: Green and red dry chillies – 4-5 pcs
moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour) – 3 tablespoons
steps: To make the dal:

First, soak the chana dal in water for 4-5 hours. The soaked dal should be completely swollen. Then, add salt and turmeric in a pressure cooker and cook for 4-5 whistles so that it remains whole yet cooked.
Now, take 3 spoons of oil in a pan and temper it with cumin seeds, red chillies, green chillies, cinnamon, etc.
Then, add tomato puree to the tempering and cook until the oil separates.
In another pan, temper the chana dal in a little oil.
Pour the tempering into the dal and add fresh coriander leaves. To make the pakwan:
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in a large bowl, add salt and moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour), and knead a stiff dough like puri.
Then cover and let it rest for 5 minutes, make balls, and roll out a large thin roti.
Now, prick holes in the rolled roti with a fork so that it does not puff up.
Alternatively, roll out 5-6 small puris, apply oil between them, and stack them on top of each other.
Then roll them out together so that their layers separate.
Next, fry them in oil by pressing down until they are completely crispy and golden brown.
Arrange the fried puris in a container in such a way that any excess oil drains out.
Dal Pakwan is ready.

ing: Finely chopped fresh coriander leaves – 1 teaspoon
steps: Take water in a vessel and put it to boil.
Now add cumin seeds, red chilli powder, green chillies, baking soda, and salt to it.
Heat it until it comes to a boil.
Then add rice flour to it.
Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon so that no lumps remain.
Then cover it and let it cook on low heat for 10 minutes.
Add oil and finely chopped fresh coriander leaves and mix well.
546.note: You can also cook mung dal papdi no lot. For that, soak green moong dal in water and grind it to make a paste. Then prepare it according to the method given above.

steps: Method for making dal:
First, take a pressure cooker and wash the yellow moong dal, chana dal, and masoor dal.
Then add 1 tsp of ghee to the cooker and let it whistle 4-5 times.
Now, heat 3 tbsp of ghee in a pan and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, ginger, green chillies, and tomatoes to it.
Sauté all of this for 5 minutes.
Then add the boiled dal to it and add water according to the consistency of dal you prefer.
Then boil it for a while and add fresh coriander leaves, the dal is ready. Method for making baati:
Add ghee to the wheat flour and rub it well to get moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour).
Knead a firm dough like bhakhri dough.
Then make medium-sized round balls and bake them in the oven for 15 minutes.
Once the baati is baked and ready, dip it in ghee.
Now the baati is ready.
While serving, take the baati out of the ghee and let the excess drain.
In a bowl, add pineapple pieces, black pepper powder, mayonnaise, and cheese, and mix well.
Now apply butter on the bread and place the prepared pineapple mixture on top of it.
Then sprinkle black pepper powder over it.
Apply butter and jam on the second bread, close the sandwich, and serve.
548.note: Cut off all four edges of the bread before making the sandwich. It can also be made without using jam.

steps: First, mash the boiled potatoes in a vessel.
Add capsicum, carrot, cabbage, boiled corn kernels, sandwich masala, black pepper powder, salt, and cheese to it, and mix well.
Then apply butter and spicy chutney on the bread, arrange the prepared stuffing in it, and place another bread on top.
Now toast the sandwich in a toaster machine by applying butter on both sides.
Hot cheese sandwich is ready.
Cut it into pieces and serve with tomato sauce and spicy chutney.
549.note: If you do not have a toaster machine, roast it in a non-stick pan with butter.

steps: First, mix mayonnaise, Schezwan sauce, red chilli flakes, and oregano in a vessel to make a sauce.
Then take three slices of bread and apply butter and spicy chutney on them.
Now take one bread, place boiled potato and tomato slices on it, and spread grated cheese over it.
Then place the second bread on top, put cucumber and capsicum slices on it, and spread the prepared mayonnaise sauce.
Sprinkle chaat masala and sandwich masala over it, and place the third bread on top to close the sandwich.
Place the sandwich prepared with three breads this way into the grill toaster machine.
Hot grill sandwich is ready, and can be served with tomato sauce.
550.note: If you do not have a grill machine, you can use a grill tawa or a regular non-stick tawa. Applying butter on it while roasting makes the sandwich more delicious.

steps: First, mash the boiled potatoes.
Then heat oil in a vessel, add mustard seeds, turmeric powder, urad dal, and sweet neem leaves for tempering.
Add chopped spicy chillies and salt, then add the mashed potatoes and mix well.
The stuffing for the toast sandwich will be ready this way.
Now add sugar, fresh coriander leaves, lemon juice, garam masala, and boiled peas to the stuffing and mix well.
Then take the bread, apply butter and spicy chutney to it, and place the potato stuffing inside.
Now place cabbage, capsicum, and carrot on top of it and sprinkle sandwich masala.
Apply butter and chutney on another bread, place it over the stuffed bread, and press gently with your hands.
Then place the sandwich in the toaster machine and roast it.
Hot toast sandwich is ready, cut it into pieces and serve with tomato sauce.
551.note: If you do not have a toaster machine, roast the sandwich on both sides with butter in a non-stick tawa until golden brown. For extra flavor, grated cheese can be added inside the sandwich before toasting. Applying butter while roasting makes the sandwich more delicious.

steps: Apply butter to one side of all the bread slices.
Keeping the buttered side down, sprinkle cheese over it.
Finely chop and place salt, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes, and pickled peppers on top.
Place the second bread on top with the buttered side facing up.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat on the stove and put a little butter in it.
Place the prepared bread on it. Let it cook until the bottom side of the bread is golden and the cheese melts.
Then flip the sandwich and let the other side turn golden.
Make the second sandwich in the same way.
552.note: A grill machine can also be used instead of a non-stick pan. Capsicum, chillies, olives, tomatoes, etc. can also be used as toppings inside the sandwich.

steps: Set the sandwich grill to preheat and spread mayonnaise on 3 bread slices.
Place butter on the grill and put the bread on it.
Place a cheese slice, lettuce, and tomatoes on this bread and cover it with a second bread.
Place red and green bell peppers, cucumber, and a cheese slice on this covered bread.
Now cover it with a third mayonnaise-spread bread.
Grill this way until it turns pinkish in color.
553.note: A mixture of finely chopped vegetables mixed with grated cheese and mayonnaise can also be used. Green spicy chutney and butter can also be applied to the bread.

steps: First of all, slice the tomatoes, cucumber, green bell peppers, boiled potatoes, and boiled beetroot.
Then apply butter and green chutney on top of the bread.
Place cucumber, tomatoes, potatoes, beetroot, bell pepper, etc. on it and sprinkle chaat masala and sandwich masala.
Grate cheese on top of it and apply butter or tomato sauce on another slice of bread as well.
Cut it into 4 pieces and serve with sauce.
554.note: While making the sandwich, remove the outer crusts on all four sides of the bread.

ing: Lettuce - 1 (keep long, thin or large pieces)
Salt, lemon juice, black pepper powder - to taste
steps: Method for making pesto:
Grind all the pesto ingredients listed above in a mixer.
Slowly add olive oil while stirring. Method for making the sandwich:
First take a bread slice and apply pesto on the inner side.
Then place tomato slices, cucumber slices, lettuce, and cheese on top of it.
Now apply pesto on another bread slice and cover the first bread keeping the pesto side inside.
Grill it in a panini maker.
Prepare all other sandwiches in this same way.
555.note: According to your preference, corn kernels, boiled potatoes, etc. can also be added.

ing: Green bell pepper chilies – 1 pcs (long chopped)
steps: Method for making bread:
In a large bowl, mix warm water, yeast, sugar, salt, and olive oil and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Now mix in 1 cup of maida (all-purpose flour) and mix for 3 to 5 minutes.
Then add another 1 cup of maida and knead the dough until it comes together.
Now keep adding about another 1/4 cup of maida (all-purpose flour) until a soft dough is formed.
The kneaded dough will still stick to the bottom of the bowl, keep removing it and start kneading.
Continue kneading the dough like this for about 8 minutes.

Now the dough has come together and formed, it will still stick a little to the bottom of the bowl. Take it out, dust a flat surface with flour, and knead the dough on it until it becomes completely smooth. Doing this will make the dough very soft.

Now put the dough in a bowl, tie a plastic bag tightly, and let it rise for 30 minutes. After the dough has risen, take it out of the bowl and divide it into 4 portions. Now prepare 9 to 10-inch long thin loaves from each dough portion. Place the shaped long dough pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 2 inches of space between all the pieces. Now cover this baking sheet with oiled plastic and let the loaves rise for 1 hour, until they double in size.

Shortly before the loaves are ready, preheat the oven to 350°F. When the loaves are fully risen, place them in the 350°F preheated oven to bake for 25 minutes. Now when the bread is ready, take it out of the oven, apply ghee on top, and cover it with a piece of cloth to let it cool.
Let the bread cool for 30 minutes, then cut it. After cooling and cutting, the bread is ready to serve. Subway method:

First cut the bread lengthwise and separate its two layers. Place 2 slices of cheese, then add lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, green bell pepper chilies, olives, mustard, oil, vinegar, oregano, pepper, and salt.
Then place the top layer on. Now the subway is ready!

ing: Red chilli powder and garam masala – 2 spoons
Salt and fresh coriander leaves – to taste
steps: First, to make the stuffing, boil the potatoes and peas in a cooker, mash them, and keep them aside.
Now heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, grated ginger-chili, and curry leaves and sauté.
Now mix in red chilli powder, garam masala, salt, and turmeric.
Add the mashed boiled potatoes and peas to it and mix.
Now cut the edges of the bread and apply green chillies chutney on them.
Spread the prepared stuffing on that bread, place another bread on top, and press gently to prepare.
Now cut this prepared bread from one corner to the other to make two triangular parts.
Now to make the batter, mix gram flour (besan), rice flour, ajwain (carom seeds), salt, and red chilli powder in a vessel.
Add water to it and make a batter.
Then heat oil in a non-stick pan and fry the prepared sandwiches by dipping them in the gram flour (besan) batter.
Serve the prepared pakoras with spicy and sweet chutney.
First, place a non-stick pan on the stove to heat.
Now pour the batter on it to make a dosa.
Then spread Schezwan chutney on it and sprinkle some Pav Bhaji masala.
Now add cabbage, capsicum, and carrot on top and roast the dosa for a while.
Then roll the dosa up and take it off.
Now cut it into 4 or 5 equal parts and put grated cheese on top.
So the Jini roll is ready, serve it with sambhar, coconut chutney, and ketchup.
558.note: All the chopped vegetables can also be used by first sautéing them in a little oil and adding salt, chili, and other spices. If you love cheese, it can also be added to the dosa along with the vegetables before rolling.

steps: First, spread pizza sauce on top of the pizza base using a spoon.
Then layer mozzarella cheese slices on it, followed by tomatoes, capsicum, cabbage, and boiled corn kernels.
Again, layer grated cheese on top of that.
Now sprinkle chilli flakes, oregano, and salt over it.
Then bake the pizza in the oven at 180 degrees temperature for 20 minutes.
Cut the ready pizza into 5-8 pieces using a cutter, hot pizza is ready.
Serve with tomato ketchup.
Boil and mash the potatoes, add all the patty spices to it, make patties, roll them in corn flour, and roast them.
Cut the burger buns from the middle, apply butter and roast them, apply tomato ketchup on the bottom bun and place the patty on it.
Place sliced tomato and cucumber on the patty and spread cheese.
Now apply tomato ketchup on the top part of the bun as well and cover it over the patty part.
Now grill this burger in a grill machine.
Serve with potato wafers.
560.note: To make burger buns, make them just like we make pav, keep the shape round instead of square, and sprinkle sesame seeds on top before putting them in the oven. Burgers can also be eaten without roasting.

steps: Rolls:
Sift maida (all-purpose flour) and mix semolina (rava), baking powder, salt, and oil in it.
Then knead it like a puri dough using cold water and keep it covered for 10 minutes. Filling:
Cut French beans, carrot, and cabbage lengthwise into thin strips and keep them in cold water for 1 hour.
Cut thin slices of capsicum.
Heat oil in a vessel, add capsicum, French beans, moong, and ajinomoto, and stir.
Cover and keep for 10 minutes, then add cabbage and carrot (after draining water) and add salt.
Once the water evaporates, take it off the stove and add chilli sauce, soya sauce, and red chilli powder, mix well, and keep aside.
Spring Roll:
Now knead the dough well and make 10 dough balls.
Take one dough ball and roll out a thin roti.
Now place about 2 spoons of filling on the roti, fold from both sides to make a roll, and apply water on the top part to seal it.
Prepare all rolls this way, sprinkle maida (all-purpose flour) over them, and place them on a plate.
Fry them in hot oil on low heat until they turn pink.
Make two-three cuts in the middle while still hot and serve with ketchup.
561.note: If you want the spring rolls to be crispy, make a batter by adding a little corn flour and salt to maida, dip the rolls in it, and fry in hot oil.

steps: In a bowl, mix turmeric, red chilli powder, ajwain, salt, and ginger-chilli paste.
Then add gram flour (besan), rice flour, and water to make a thick batter.
After the batter is made, dip the cheese cubes into it.
Put oil in a kadai to heat.
After the oil is hot, fry the cheese cubes in the oil until they turn golden brown.
Then serve them with green chutney.
First take a pizza base and spread pizza sauce over it.
Then spread grated cheese over it, and sprinkle chili flakes and oregano for garnishing.
Now bake it in the oven for 10 minutes at a temperature of 150º degrees.
Hot cheese pizza is ready, to be served with tomato sauce.
563.note: If you do not have an oven, a non-stick pan can be used on the gas stove. Mozzarella cheese can also be used as the cheese.

ing: Chopped capsicum - 1 ½ cups (red, green, yellow)
steps: First, mix the capsicum, tomatoes, and boiled corn kernels in a bowl.
Then take the bread and apply butter on it.
And spread about 1 teaspoon of the prepared mixture over the bread.
Now place grated cheese on top of it.
Sprinkle 2-3 pinches of red chili flakes and oregano on the prepared bread for garnishing.
Bake the prepared bread in the oven for up to 10 minutes at 180º degrees temperature.
Hot bread pizza is ready, serve it with tomato sauce.
564.note: If you do not have an oven, apply oil in a non-stick pan and roast the bread for 5 to 7 minutes. Mayonnaise sauce can also be added to the mixture prepared for bread pizza.

steps: Take mayonnaise, tomatoes, cucumber, and carrot in a bowl and mix them well to prepare the mixture.
Spread the mixture over the khakhra.
Then grate and spread cheese over it.
Put oregano and chili flakes from the top.
Then serve.
565.note: You can also use boiled corn and capsicum. You can also use pizza gravy instead of mayonnaise.

steps: Put yeast, 1/2 cup of water, and sugar in a bowl and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Then add an extra 1/2 cup of lukewarm water, add maida (all-purpose flour) flour, yeast, and salt to it to knead a soft dough and keep the dough for 3 hours.
After 3 hours, roll out a flatbread of it for the pizza.
Roll out 4 pizzas from this much dough, then preheat the oven to 180 ℃.
Then add a teaspoon of olive oil, oregano, powdered black pepper, and salt to the tomato sauce.
Spread that sauce slightly inside the edge of the pizza and then spread cheese over it, then put it in the oven until the cheese melts.
Keep it for about 8 minutes, then take it out, spread 8 basil leaves on the pizza, and then serve.
This much dough will make 4 pizzas.
First take 2 teaspoons of warm water in a bowl.
Add dry yeast and sugar to it and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Now add maida (all-purpose flour) flour, yeast water, oil, salt, etc. in a vessel and knead the dough.
Then cover the dough with a damp cloth.
After 1 hour, knead the dough slightly again.
Divide it into 5 parts to make the pizza base.
Take 1 part out of the 5 parts of the prepared dough and roll out two flatbreads from it.
One flatbread large and thick, and the other flatbread slightly smaller and thinner.
Prepare 5 small and 5 large flatbreads in this way.
Now take a large flatbread, pierce holes in it using a fork, and spread 1 cup of cheese in it.
Then pierce holes in a small flatbread and place it on top.
Now bake the prepared pizza base in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes at 200 degrees temperature.
The cheese burst pizza base is ready.
567.note: Wheat flour can be used instead of all-purpose flour to make the base. The pizza base dough should be kneaded as soft as roti dough.

steps: First, take a pizza base and spread pizza sauce evenly over it using a spoon.
Then layer it with refried beans, chopped tomatoes, black olives, and cheese.
Now sprinkle taco seasoning over it and add salt as needed.
Bake the prepared pizza in an oven at 180 degrees temperature for 10-12 minutes.
Prepare all pizzas this way and serve piping hot with sour cream and tomato ketchup.
Take maida (all-purpose flour), salt and water in a bowl to prepare a batter.
Place butter in another non-stick pan and roast it for 1/2 minute.
Then add milk, stirring continuously, and let it boil.
Once it thickens enough to leave the sides of the pan, turn off the gas.
Now add corn, green chillies, cheese, fresh coriander leaves and salt to it.
Once cooled, mix everything well, divide into equal portions and make balls.
Now dip the balls into the batter and roll them in bread crumbs.
Once the oil is hot, deep fry on medium heat until golden brown.
Remove on a paper napkin and serve with sauce.
So hot cheese balls are ready.

ing: Broccoli, cut into small pieces - 200 grams
Red bell pepper finely chopped – 1 pcs
Green bell pepper finely chopped – 1 pcs
steps: Take 500 grams of prepared pizza dough and divide it into four parts (keep the pizza dough kneaded in advance).
After preheating the oven to 450 degrees, prepare the baking dish as well.
While the oven is heating, place a pan on the gas and add olive oil to it.
Then add red and green bell peppers to it, then sauté on medium heat for ten minutes.
Add pepper, basil, red chilli powder to it, stir for 30 seconds, then lower the gas.
Then add broccoli and olives, stir for two minutes, turn off the gas and add spinach to it.
Then in a large bowl, mix ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper as per taste.
Then take one portion of the dough, roll an 8-inch round roti, and place the vegetable mixture and cheese mixture in it.
Then seal all sides like a ghugra (dumpling).
Then prepare all of them in the same way.
Then place them on the baking dish, then apply butter on top, and make two or three small holes in it.
Then bake for 13 to 15 minutes until golden.
Our calzones are now ready!
First, take maida, salt, black pepper powder, and Italian seasoning in a bowl, add water as needed, and prepare a batter.
Now take a large square block of mozzarella cheese and cut it into uniform long stick-like pieces.
Then dip the mozzarella stick into the prepared batter and roll it in bread crumbs.
Repeat the same process, dip it in the batter and roll it in bread crumbs, and keep it aside.
Prepare the remaining sticks in the same way, then keep all the breaded sticks in the fridge for 1-2 hours.
After 1-2 hours, heat oil in a kadhai. When the oil is hot, fry the mozzarella sticks until they are golden brown.
Once fried, remove them onto a plate lined with paper towels, sprinkle a little Italian seasoning on top, and serve hot with tomato sauce.
571.note: Mozzarella sticks can also be enjoyed by topping them with finely chopped tomatoes, coriander, and lemon juice.

ing: Cheese cubes cut into pieces – 5 small squares
steps: Make a dough by mixing mashed boiled potatoes, paneer, grated green chillies, salt, and sugar.
After that, take a small portion from the prepared dough and make small round balls using your palms.
Press it slightly from the center and place a small piece of cheese on it.
Cover the cheese pieces with another dough ball and seal it.
Now heat oil in a kadhai.
Once the oil is sufficiently hot, fry the paneer balls until they turn golden brown.
Once done, transfer them to a serving bowl and serve hot with fresh coriander leaves chutney.
Take the potatoes, poke holes in them using a fork and apply oil on top.
Place them in the oven to bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes.
Mix the ingredients for the stuffing in a bowl.
Take the boiled potatoes out of the oven.
Make a cut on any one side of the potatoes, fill the stuffing inside and put cheese on top of it.
Garnish the top with sauce and coriander.
Serve piping hot.
After heating oil in a pan, add ginger paste and saute.
Now add potatoes, peas, kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) and all the spices to prepare the stuffing.
Then roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Now cut off all its side edges.
Then cut it into equal square pieces and fill each with the prepared stuffing.
Then fold the square pieces and seal them properly.
Then let it bake in the oven at 200 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Then serve it hot with sauce.
After heating oil in a pan, add ginger paste, capsicum and saute.
Now add salt, chilli sauce, soya sauce, vinegar and then add cabbage.
Then roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Now cut off all its side edges.
Then cut it into equal square pieces and fill each with the prepared Chinese stuffing.
Then fold the square pieces and seal them properly.
Then let it bake in the oven at 200 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Then serve it hot with sauce.
First, heat oil in a kadhai and add cumin seeds and ginger-chilli paste to it.
Then add finely chopped carrot and capsicum to it and saute well.
Then add turmeric, red chilli powder, amchur (dry mango powder), garam masala and coriander powder to it.
Then add tomato ketchup and mix well.
Then add water to it.
Then add small cut pieces of paneer and mix well.
Add some fresh coriander leaves to it to prepare the stuffing.
Then roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Now cut off all its side edges.
Then cut it into equal square pieces and fill each with the prepared stuffing.
Then fold it from the corners or sides and seal it properly.
Then let it bake in the oven at 200 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Then serve it hot with sauce.
Put oil to heat in a pan.
Add roasted cumin seeds, ginger-chilli paste and Punjabi masala to it, then put boiled potatoes and boiled peas.
Then add salt to taste, amchur (dry mango powder) powder and dry pomegranate powder and mix well.
Then roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Now cut off all its side edges.
Then cut it into equal square pieces and fill each with the prepared stuffing.
Then fold the square pieces and seal them properly.
Then bake it in the oven at a preheated 200 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Then serve it hot with green chutney or sauce.
First, heat three tablespoons of oil in a kadai and add dry coriander to it.
Then add carrot, peas, and capsicum to it, mix well, and sauté everything.
Then add potatoes, mix everything, and add amchur (dry mango powder), chaat masala, coriander-cumin powder, red chili, and salt to taste, mixing everything well.
Then roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Now cut the edges on all sides.
Then make equal square pieces and fill the prepared stuffing in each.
Then fold the square pieces and close them properly.
Then bake in the oven at 250 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
After it is done, serve with tomato ketchup (sauce).
First, add maida (all-purpose flour), salt, and water in a vessel to make a dough. Now add oil and knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Now heat oil in a pan.
Add carrot and cabbage, sauté, and add salt, pepper powder, and ginger-chili paste, mixing well.
Prepare the filling this way.
Now roll puris from the prepared maida (all-purpose flour) dough.
Place the prepared filling in the center with a spoon and gather it into a pouch shape.
Now steam the prepared pouches in a steamer.
Hot momos are ready.
They can be served with tomato sauce and chutney.
First wash the potatoes, peel them, and cut them into long chips.
Then soak them in water for 10 minutes and dry them in a cloth so that the potato starch is removed.
Now add corn flour and salt to the potato chips, mix well, and keep covered for 10 - 15 minutes.
Now heat oil in a pan and fry the French fries on medium heat.
After the French fries become crispy, add chaat masala and serve piping hot.
580.note: To give the French fries a masala flavor, pepper powder and red chili flakes, etc., can be added to the corn flour.

ing: White, pink, or black kidney beans (rajma) - 100 grams
steps: Tacos:
Sift salt into the corn and maida (all-purpose flour) flours, add 2 spoons of oil moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour), and knead a medium dough.
Take a portion of maida (all-purpose flour) dusting and roll a thin puri. Poke holes with a fork so they do not puff up.
Fry the puri on one side in hot oil, then flip to the other side and use a slotted spoon to give it a U-shape in the middle. Take it out, let it cool, and store it in a container. Filling:
Soak the kidney beans (rajma) for six to seven hours, add salt and lemon salt, and boil in a cooker. Once cooked, drain the water.
Chop some kidney beans into pieces and mash some.
Now place ghee in a kadai, add tomato gravy, red chilli powder, salt, kidney beans, a little butter, cheese, and chili sauce, and take it off the heat once it thickens. Serving:
Fill tacos with two spoons of filling, spread cabbage and cheese on top, and serve in a dish.
581.note: You can make small corn and maida puris, place filling and cabbage on top of one puri, and place another puri on top to serve.

ing: Bell pepper / Kashmiri chili (finely chopped) – 1 pcs
steps: Method for corn tortilla shells:
Sift corn flour, maida (all-purpose flour), and baking powder.
Then add salt to taste and oil moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour), and knead a paratha-like dough.
Let the dough rest covered for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, roll it like a thin paratha and roast it on a semi-hot griddle.
If cooking on high flame, roast the tortilla for about 30 seconds on the front side and 50 seconds on the back side.
Once the semi-cooked tortilla is ready, fry the roti in oil. Refried beans method:
Soak pinto beans in water for 4-6 hours. Wash the pinto beans and boil them with a pinch of salt or baking soda until the beans become completely soft.
Heat oil in a kadai. Once the oil is hot, temper with ajwain.
Add finely chopped tomatoes, red chilli powder, oregano, parsley, and Italian seasoning, and let it cook on low heat until oil separates from the tomato puree.
After the oil separates, add the boiled pinto beans to it along with a small bowl of water.
Add salt and fresh coriander leaves. Mash the beans to make a paste.
Let the bean paste cook for 5-7 minutes, and then let it cool. Salad mix method:
Mix tomatoes, pickled chilies, avocado, olives, bell pepper/Kashmiri chili, chili flakes, oregano, parsley, Italian seasoning, grated cheese, and salt in a bowl. Tostada method:
Take one corn tortilla, then apply a thick layer of refried beans on top of it.
Apply a layer of salad mix on top of that. Sprinkle some extra cheese on top.
Then let it cook in the oven until the cheese melts.
If you like the cheese uncooked, you can skip this step.
582.note: If you do not want to fry the tortillas, apply oil on the rotis and bake them in the oven until light golden. A pav bhaji masher makes it very easy to mash beans.

583.serves: Water as required (knead a dough like roti dough)
steps: Quesadilla roti method:
First of all, take flour, salt and oil in a bowl.
Then keep adding water in it as required and knead the dough.
The dough should be like roti dough.
Then make rotis. (Roll out a large roti)
When the roti is done, keep it aside. Quesadilla method:
First heat a pan and place a roti on it.
Sprinkle cheese on top of the roti and let it stay until the cheese melts.
When the cheese melts, place another roti on top of the cheese and flip the whole quesadilla so the other side's roti gets roasted.
Now your quesadilla is ready!
583.note: In this dish, chaat masala, beans, and tomatoes can also be added on top of the cheese.

ing: Red and green capsicum/bell peppers – 1 cup
steps: Soak beans for 5 hours. Then boil them in a pressure cooker with 4 whistles. Mash them.
Now add fresh coriander leaves, oregano, cumin, coriander powder, chili paprika, chili powder and salt to taste.
Now spread this prepared mixture into the tortilla roti, roll it up and place it in an oven-safe dish for baking.
Then prepare tomato sauce, add oregano, chili flakes, pepper powder and salt to it.
Now spread this sauce over the roll, spread cheese on top and put finely chopped capsicum on it.
Now bake it at 180 ℃ for 15-20 minutes.
So delicious enchiladas are ready.
Heat a large pan on medium heat and add oil.
Once the oil is hot, add bell peppers and carrots to it.
Stir with a spatula and saute for a while.
Add red kidney beans to the pan and mix. Add all the spices and stir.
If it sticks to the bottom, you can add a little water to it.
Then add corn, and let it roast until hot.
Keeping the oven on the lowest heat around 170 ℉, warm the tortillas.
Fold the tortillas and prepare the garnishing ingredients while they warm.
Serve the fajita mix on the folded tortillas.
Fold front, back and sides and serve.

ing: Mexican rice – 1 ½ (one and a half) cups
steps: First boil the rice separately so grains remain separate. Boil the soaked beans so they remain separate.
Now drain the water from both and mix them together.
Now add taco seasoning, capsicum, green chillies, salt and fresh coriander leaves to it and mix.
Then spread a little cheese in the tortilla and place the rice and beans mixture in it.
Then place tomatoes, sour cream, lettuce and cheese on top of it, fold it, apply oil and roast on low heat on all sides.
First, cut the cucumber, carrot, and lettuce into thin, long strips.
Finely chop the spicy green chillies.
Next, spread cream cheese over the roti and place the cucumber, carrot, lettuce, and spicy green chillies on top.
Then, add black pepper powder and salt, and roll it up tightly.
After that, place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Then, take it out and cut it into small rolls.
Then serve it to Maharaj.
592.note: Wheat rotis can also be used.

steps: First, in a bowl, add maida (all-purpose flour), 4 spoons of corn flour, red chilli paste, vinegar, soy sauce, etc.
Add water to make a batter, keeping the consistency loose like fritter (bhajiya) batter.
Then, add red capsicum, green capsicum, yellow capsicum, cauliflower, baby corn, and other vegetables to this batter and prepare.
Now, heat oil in a pan and fry the vegetables mixed in the batter.
When these fried vegetables cool down, fry them once again so they become crispy.
Then, heat 3-4 spoons of oil in a pan and sauté the ginger-chilli paste and chopped spicy green chillies.
Now add celery, 2 spoons of red chilli paste, tomato sauce, red chilli flakes, dry ginger powder, black pepper powder, and salt, and mix well.
Now add the fried vegetables and sauté for 2 minutes.
Hot veg fry is ready.
593.note: Chop the vegetables like capsicum, cauliflower, and baby corn into large pieces. It is necessary to add salt when mixing the flour to prepare the batter.

steps: To make the balls:
First, squeeze out all the water from the cabbage and grated carrot by pressing them with both hands.
Now add maida (all-purpose flour) and corn flour to it.
Then add crushed ginger-chilli, black pepper powder, soy sauce, chilli sauce, and salt, mix well, and make small balls.
Now heat oil in a kadhai and fry the balls until they turn brown. To make the gravy:
Now to make the Manchurian gravy, heat oil in another kadhai and sauté the ginger-chilli paste in it.
Add sliced cabbage and capsicum to it and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Then add soy sauce, chilli sauce, and black pepper powder to it.
After that, add about three cups of water and bring it to a boil.
Take a little water in a small bowl, add corn flour to it, and mix well.
Add this mixture to the gravy and mix well so the gravy becomes thick.
Then add salt to it.
Once this gravy is ready, add the fried Manchurian balls to it and serve piping hot.
594.note: Aji-no-moto can be added while making the balls to help maintain the flavor of the dish.

ing: red, green, yellow capsicum chillies – 200 grams
guacamole / salsa / sour cream – to taste
steps: In a bowl, mix maida (all-purpose flour), corn meal, salt and pepper to taste, rub in some oil for moyan (ghee or oil rubbed into the flour), and add about 2 spoons of lemon juice to mix.
Then knead a dough similar to roti using a little lukewarm water.
Cover the kneaded dough and let it rest for a while.
Then roll it out like a regular roti and half-roast it on a griddle.
Heat oil for frying in a kadhai.
Cut each roti into 8 triangular pieces.
Fry all the pieces until golden brown – thus preparing the nacho chips.
Chop the red/green/yellow capsicum chillies into small, medium pieces, and also chop the tomatoes, avocado, olives, and pickled jalapeños.
Then, on a regular dish, arrange the nacho chips neatly so the dish is completely covered.
Sprinkle boiled black beans over them.
Sprinkle the chopped chillies, olives, avocado, and tomatoes on top.
Spread grated cheese all over the top.
Then place the dish in the microwave to heat for 1 to 1 ½ minutes.
Afterwards, place salsa, guacamole, and sour cream on top to taste.
595.note: After arranging the chips on the dish, tomato sauce can also be spread loosely over them.

steps: Blend all the items mentioned in the ingredients coarsely in a chopper.
Then take it out in a bowl and serve it with corn or potato chips.

ing: Salt, black pepper, chilli flakes – to taste
steps: Wash and dry the potatoes.
Without peeling, poke holes all around the potatoes using a fork.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Grease the potatoes with oil and sprinkle salt on all sides.
Bake the potatoes directly in the oven without placing them on any other plate for 1 hour.
Take the baked potatoes out into a dish and cut a vertical slit down the middle.
Put a little butter in the cavity formed in the middle. Add salt, pepper, and chili according to taste.
Put tomato sauce in it.
Sprinkle cheese on top and heat the prepared potatoes until the cheese melts.

ing: Ingredients for making turmeric basmati rice:
steps: Method for making tofu:
Preheat the oven to 400°F (204 °C), then prepare a baking sheet by placing parchment paper on top.
Now cut the tofu into 1/2 inch pieces.
In a medium-sized bowl, mix lemon juice, maple syrup, tomato paste, oil, fresh ginger, garam masala, and pepper powder.
Add the cut tofu to it and gently toss to coat the tofu with the spices.
Now arrange the spiced tofu in a line on the baking sheet. And put it in the preheated oven.
Bake for about 30 minutes until they look slightly dry and brown.
Around the 15-minute mark, flip the pieces to the other side and bake for another 15 minutes.
Now take it out of the oven and sprinkle coriander on top. Method for making turmeric basmati rice:
While the tofu is baking in the oven, take rice, water, and turmeric in a pot and put it on the stove to boil.
Stir for a little while, keep the heat on low-medium, and cover the pot with a lid.
Keep it on the stove for about 20 minutes until all the water is absorbed.
Once done, remove from the stove, open the lid, and add salt to taste. Tofu Bowl:
Now when the tofu and rice are ready, put the rice in a dish and add spinach on top.
Place the tofu on top and sprinkle cashews.
The tofu bowl is ready.
598.note: Tofu is paneer made from soy milk. It can be made just like normal paneer.

steps: Boil 2 bowls of pasta and 4 glasses of water with one spoon of oil and a little salt.
After boiling for 10 to 15 minutes, strain it in a colander and pour cold water over it.
Now heat 2 spoons of oil in a kadhai, once hot add ginger paste, and after it is sautéed, add the boiled pasta.
Add salt, chili, turmeric, and garam masala to it and mix everything well.
Plain pasta is ready, serve it hot.

ing: Red Kashmiri chili powder – 1 ½ spoons
steps: First, heat oil in a pan, add butter to it, and sauté the ginger paste.
Then add tomato gravy to it and stir (until it thickens).
Now add turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, and salt and mix.
After 1 minute, add corn kernels and tomatoes and stir.
Now add basil leaves, oregano, chili flakes, and water as needed.
Add boiled pasta and tomato sauce to it and mix.
Hot masala pasta is ready.
600.note: To boil pasta, boil pasta in water with oil (1 spoon) and salt in a pot. Now take the pasta out in a colander and pour cold water over it so that the pasta does not stick. Grated cheese can be added on top of masala pasta when serving.

steps: Heat oil in a kadhai and mix ginger paste, tomato paste, Italian herbs, tomato sauce, salt, sugar, cheese, and pepper powder.
Add a little water and leave it for 15 minutes. The sauce is ready. For the pasta:
Take 2 spoons of oil in another kadhai, add capsicum, zucchini, broccoli, baby corn, pepper powder, and salt, mix, and leave it on the gas for 5 minutes.
Then add the boiled pasta and the prepared sauce to the above mixture and mix.
Then grate cheese on top and serve.
First, pour water in a pan and put the spaghetti to boil for 8 to 10 minutes.
Strain the water from the spaghetti and set it aside.
In a pan, add chopped zucchini in olive oil and sauté for 5 minutes.
Then add tomato pulp, chili flakes, tomato sauce, and sugar, and combine well.
Next, add basil leaves.
Now add oregano and salt and cook for 7 to 8 minutes.
Add the boiled spaghetti into the vegetables and mix well.
Your spaghetti is ready!
For making patties:
Take boiled rajma and potatoes, mash them, and add ginger paste, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, and salt to taste, then mix well.
Also add fresh coriander leaves and prepare the mawa (khoya).
Now prepare rectangular shaped patties from it.

Take about half a teaspoon of oil in a non-stick tawa (pan) and place the tikkis on the tawa, roasting both sides until they turn slightly golden brown. Roast all the patties this way. Method of making masala:
Take the given ingredients for masala in a small bowl, mix well, and prepare the dry frankie masala (this masala can be used for two to three months). Method of making roti:
Take wheat flour and maida (all-purpose flour) in a vessel, add salt to taste and oil, and mix well.
Bind a dough like roti using water.
To make the frankie roti soft, cover this dough and keep it aside for 10 to 15 minutes.
Then take sized dough balls from it and roll out the roti, but do not roll it too thin.
Roast it half-cooked on both sides on a griddle (lodhi). (Do not use oil or ghee while roasting the roti) Method of making frankie:
Apply tomato sauce on a roti, then place the prepared rajma and potato tikki in the middle of the roti.
Sprinkle the prepared dry masala over it according to taste.
Garnish finely chopped cabbage and capsicum chillies on top of the tikki and fold the roti from both sides.
Take a little oil in a tawa and roast this roll again on both sides for half a minute and serve hot in a dish with tomato sauce.
606.note: If rajma is to be used in the morning, it needs to be soaked in hot water the previous night for 7-8 hours, and while boiling it, add a little salt and a pinch of baking soda (chapati) to boil.

steps: Method to make the topping:
Take mashed potatoes in a bowl.
Then add finely chopped carrot, capsicum, and crushed corn, and add ginger-chilli paste.
Then add a little soy sauce.
Then add salt to taste.
Then mix to prepare the topping and set it aside. Method to make gold coins:
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in a bowl, then add 1/2 cup of water and mix it to make a batter.
Then cut bread slices into round shapes from the middle using a small bowl.
Place 1 teaspoon of the prepared topping on top of each round-shaped bread piece.
Then apply water and maida (all-purpose flour) paste on the bread topping and coat it with bread crumbs.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan and fry 3 gold coins at a time.
Fry until both sides turn golden brown.
After frying, take out the gold coins and serve them with red chilli sauce.
Take 2 liters of water, bring it to a boil, and add salt and noodles.
Once the noodles are 90% boiled, strain them in a colander (perforated bowl) and pour cold water over them.
Then heat oil in a pan, add ginger-chilli paste, and sauté.
Then add green chilli sauce and soy sauce and stir.
Then add cabbage, carrot, French beans, and capsicum, and stir.
After that, add black salt (sanchal), red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder, black pepper powder, amchur (dry mango powder) powder, garam masala, and salt, and mix well.
Then add the noodles, mix well, add fresh coriander leaves, and turn off the gas.
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in a vessel, add corn flour, salt, red chilli sauce, and a little water to make a batter. Then add paneer pieces and mix.
Now fry the paneer in oil (until it gets a golden color).
Now take 2 teaspoons of corn flour in a bowl, add 5 to 6 teaspoons of water, stir, and keep it aside.
Then heat oil in a pan, add ginger-chilli paste, and sauté.
Then add capsicum, and add black pepper powder, salt, soy sauce, and red chilli sauce, and stir.
Then add tomato sauce, a little water (1/4 cup), and stir.
Then add the prepared corn flour water, chopped tomatoes, and paneer pieces, and mix.
Hot and spicy chilli paneer is ready.

ing: Capsicum cut into long strips - 2 cups
steps: First, heat water in a pot and boil the noodles (boil only up to 80%).
Then strain them in a colander and pour cold water over them so that the noodles do not stick to each other.
Then heat oil in a pan and sauté the paneer, then take the paneer out into a dish.
Then in the same pan, sauté capsicum and cabbage.
After 3-4 minutes, add peanuts, salt, garam masala, chilli sauce, soy sauce, and chillies, and mix.
Sauté it on high heat for 1 minute.
Now add 1 cup of water, keep stirring, and then mix in the noodles.
Add lemon juice and a little water, cover with a lid, and let it cook for 2 minutes.
Hot and delicious fried rice noodles are ready.
610.note: Adding a little salt and oil while boiling rice noodles keeps the noodles separate. Vinegar (1 teaspoon) can be added for flavor after making the rice noodles.

ing: Salt, black pepper powder, and vinegar – to taste
steps: First, put water to boil. When the water boils, add the noodles.
Let the noodles boil for 5–7 minutes.
Once boiled, strain them and keep them in cold water for a while.
Then take them out of the cold water and make them completely dry.
Heat oil in a kadhai, add ginger-chilli paste, and stir-fry all the above chopped vegetables until they are half-cooked.
Once sautéed, add vinegar and soy sauce and mix.
Add chilli sauce, black pepper powder, and salt to taste.
Then add the noodles.
Hot Chinese noodles are ready.

ing: Mix vegetables (carrots, corn, peas, French beans) – 1 kg
Spices (red chilli powder, cumin, salt, ajwain (carom seeds) and sugar) – to taste
steps: First, boil the noodles in a large pan with water and salt, taking care not to break them.
Place finely chopped tomatoes in a pan over medium heat.
Then add 1 teaspoon of salt, sugar, oregano, and red chilli flakes; if it tastes too sour, add a little more sugar.
In a bowl, mix 200 grams of ricotta cheese, finely chopped spinach, oregano, red chilli flakes, and salt.
Heat a little oil in a pan, temper with cumin seeds, then add mixed vegetables, chilli powder, and salt.
Keep on very low heat until all the vegetables become soft. Method to assemble the lasagna:
Take a large glass dish first and grease it with oil.
First lay down a layer of noodles.
Then spread the mixed vegetable mixture, and place cheese on top of it.
Then lay down noodles again. Now spread the ricotta cheese mixture.
Lay down noodles again and place cheese on top of them.
Continue repeating this way until the entire pan is filled.
Make the final layer with mozzarella cheese.
Then preheat the oven to 375 F (180 C) and bake for 15-20 minutes. Our lasagna is ready.
First, take boiled potatoes, paneer, and ginger-chilli paste in a vessel, mash them together, and keep aside.
Then take bread pieces, soak them in water, and squeeze out the water.
Then stuff the potato and paneer mixture into the bread pieces, shape the bread pieces, and make cutlets.
Roast the prepared cutlets in a pan using oil.
Roast the cutlets until they turn golden brown and become crispy.
Now put about one liter of water to boil in a vessel.
Add carrots, capsicum, French beans, etc., to it, boil for 4-5 minutes, and let the vegetables cool.
Then in the same hot water, boil the soaked black-eyed peas and soya chunks for 3 minutes and drain the water.
Now take curd in a vessel, mix ginger-chilli paste, tomato sauce, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, pepper powder, and salt, and heat it.
Heat until the curd mixture thickens.
Then heat the sizzler plate.
Apply butter on it and arrange all the vegetables and the prepared cutlets.
Now pour the heated curd mixture over it and serve hot.

ing: Chopped red and green capsicum – 1/2 cup
Lemon juice or white vinegar – 2 to 3 tablespoons
steps: Method for making cream cheese:
Take milk in a large vessel and put it on high flame to heat, stir continuously until the milk boils.
Now turn the flame to low, add 1 tablespoon of lemon juice first and keep stirring.
After 1 minute add another 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, keep stirring the milk continuously.
Keep heating it on the gas until the liquid and solid parts separate from the milk.
Now when the liquid stays at the bottom and the solid substance comes up, turn off the gas and take the vessel down.
Take a strainer or perforated vessel, place a cotton cloth over it and keep it in a bowl.
Now pour the solid substance that came out into the cloth and let the liquid drain, keep it for about 15 minutes to cool down.
Now put it in a food processor and blend until smooth and creamy, it will be ready in about 15 minutes.
Now add salt to it as per taste.
Once the cream cheese is ready, keep it in the fridge. Method for making Pinwheels:
In a bowl, mix cream cheese and other spices to prepare the mixture.
Spread this mixture on each rotli.
Sprinkle bell peppers and cheese on top of it.
Roll up the rotli, now wrap the roll tightly and arrange it in aluminum foil.
Now keep these rolls in the fridge to chill for 2 hours or overnight.
Then cut off the edges of the roll and cut the chilled roll into 1-inch sizes.
Pinwheels are ready to serve.
First of all, put water in a vessel to heat, once it boils, turn the flame very low.
Then add semolina (rava) to it little by little. Stir at the same time.
Keep it on the gas on low heat until all the semolina (rava) absorbs the water.
Then take out the semolina (rava) in a bowl.
After the semolina (rava) cools down a bit, add grated boiled potatoes, chilli flakes, salt, and coriander to it and mix well.
While mixing, grease your hands with a little oil.
Then make fingers as long and thick as a finger from it.
Then fry the fingers in preheated oil on medium flame until golden brown.
Serve it with green chutney or sauce.
First, peel the potatoes and grate them.
Put the grated potatoes in cold water and keep them until the starch comes off the top.
Then take a colander and drain all the water from the potatoes.
Now squeeze the water out of the grated potatoes with your hands and dry them with a cloth.
Heat a pan and apply a little ghee.
Shape the grated potatoes like a patty (keep it slightly thinner than a regular patty).
Now place this potato patty on the pan to roast, and sprinkle salt and pepper, roasting until light brown.
Now your hash brown is ready.
617.note: You can eat this dish with tomato ketchup.

ing: 1 Red capsicum (cut into long vertical strips)
1 Green capsicum (cut into long vertical strips)
steps: Method for making Lemon-Coriander Rice:
First, take water in a deep vessel and put it on to heat.
After the water boils, add rice and salt to the water.
Let the rice cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, strain it in a colander and drain the water completely.
Then add lemon juice to the rice and mix well by sprinkling coriander on top.
Now keep the lemon-coriander rice aside to cool. Method for Taco Seasoning:
Take all the dry ingredients in a dry grinder jar and grind until a fine powder is formed.
Now your taco seasoning is ready.
Keep half of the seasoning for the black beans and half for the fajitas. Method for Spiced Black Beans:
First, put water, beans, and salt in a cooker and pressure cook for 15-20 whistles until the beans are soft.
(If you have soaked the beans for 4-6 hours beforehand, give seven whistles)
Then heat oil in a pan, temper with cumin seeds, and add the beans and taco seasoning.
Now mix everything and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes.
Now set the spiced beans aside to cool. Method for Fajitas:
First, heat oil in a pan.
Then sauté the red and green capsicum.
Now add the taco seasoning to it and let the peppers sauté for 10 to 15 minutes.
Now set the fajitas aside to cool. Chipotle Bowl Method:
Now take a bowl and place a moderate amount of 2 spoonfuls of lemon rice.
Place one spoonful of spiced beans on top of it.
Then place one spoonful of fajitas on top of the beans.
Then place one spoonful each of tomatoes, salsa, corn, lettuce, avocado dip, sour cream, and cheese.
Now your chipotle bowl is ready!
Method for making the sauce:
Add oregano, pepper powder, chilli flakes, salt, and sugar to one kilogram of tomato sauce to taste, and boil for a while. Method for Brinjal Parmesan:
Make a batter by mixing 500 grams of maida (all-purpose flour) flour with 15 grams of oregano, 15 grams of pepper powder, 10 grams of chilli flakes, 15 grams of Italian seasoning, and salt to taste.
Cut the eggplant into round rings, heat oil in a pan, dip the rings in the batter, and roast them until golden brown on both sides.
Take an oven tray, apply oil at the bottom, and make a layer of eggplant rings.
Make a layer of tomato sauce over it. Spread Parmesan cheese on top of this.
Repeat the above step again and finally sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top.
Now place it in the oven to bake at 200 degrees.
Once the top layer is golden brown, take it out, cut it, and serve hot.
First, wash and clean the coriander.
Then chop it coarsely, take all the above ingredients in a mixer bowl, crush them, and make a paste.
Then transfer the paste to a bowl; fresh coriander leaves chutney is ready.
First, wash the green chillies and cut them into large pieces.
Then, put the chilli pieces, peanuts, lemon juice, turmeric, and salt into a mixer jar and grind it.
Green chillies chutney is ready.
622.note: Roasted peanuts can also be used.

steps: First, put one teaspoon of oil in a pan and fry the peanuts.
Then, take the fried peanuts and small pieces of fresh coconut in a mixer jar and crush them.
Now, in a kadhai, temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and pieces of dry red chilli.
Then let it stay on low heat for a while and then turn off the gas.
Now, add half of this tempering, salt to taste, and 1/2 cup of water to the crushed peanuts and grind it again in the mixer.
Then, transfer it to a bowl, add the remaining tempering to it, and mix well.
First, add dalia, fresh coriander leaves, green chillies, ginger pieces, curry leaves, lemon juice, sugar, and salt into a mixer jar.
Add a little water to it and grind.
Remove the ground paste into a bowl, add water as needed, and prepare the chutney.
624.note: A tempering of mustard seeds in a little oil can be added on top.

steps: First, remove the seeds from the dates and put them to boil in hot water.
Once the dates are boiled, drain the water from them and make a paste of the dates in a mixer.
Then, put the paste on to heat.
Add amchur (dry mango powder) powder, jaggery, red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder powder, and salt to it and mix. Add water if needed.
Date chutney is ready.
First, soak the tamarind in hot water for 30 to 40 minutes.
Then let it boil in a vessel for 3 to 4 minutes.
Then cover it and let it stay until it cools down.
Then grind that tamarind in a mixer jar.
Then strain it from a strainer.
You can add a little water, then add 1 teaspoon of oil in a pan (loyu).
Then after the oil gets hot, add cumin seeds to it, and after the cumin splutters, add the tamarind to it.
Then add jaggery, salt, black salt, cumin powder, dry ginger powder, fennel seeds powder, red chilli powder, and sugar to it and stir well.
Then let it boil on the gas on low heat for 5 to 6 minutes.
Then turn off the gas and let it cool down.
626.note: This chutney can be kept in the fridge for a month. It stays good.

steps: First of all, whisk the yogurt well, then add salt and sugar to it and mix.
Next, heat ghee in a pan.
Once the ghee is hot, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, then add finely chopped pieces of green chilli.
Now turn off the gas.
Then add red chilli powder and immediately pour the tempering into the yogurt, and mix the yogurt gently with a light hand.
So the yogurt chutney is ready.
Then garnish on top with finely chopped fresh coriander leaves.
627.note: This chutney can be eaten with dosa, idli, and medu vada.

steps: First of all, cut the tomatoes into four pieces, put them in a cooker with half a cup of water, and let them boil for 3 whistles.
Grind the boiled tomatoes in a mixer to make a puree.
Keep the water used for boiling separately in a bowl.
Now strain the puree through a large sieve, adding the remaining water as needed.
Then place a vessel on the gas to heat and put this tomato puree to boil in it.
Add vinegar, chilli powder, salt, and sugar to it and boil.
After 10 to 12 minutes, check the sauce on a plate.
If water is still releasing, let the sauce boil further.
Finally, the sauce will become very thick.
Tomato sauce is ready.
639.note: To check if the sauce is done or not, take a little sauce on a plate. Then tilt the plate slightly; if water separates, it is still not ready. If the sauce does not move even when the plate is tilted and no water separates, the sauce is ready. Vinegar can also be added after the sauce is made when it cools down.

steps: Heat oil in a kadai, add mustard seeds to it, and temper.
Now add tindora and let it cook for a while.
Then add cucumber and carrot and let them cook for a little longer.
Now add spicy chillies and cabbage, add salt and turmeric, mix well, and let it cook for a bit.
Finally, add tomatoes, turn off the gas, squeeze the lemon, mix everything well, and keep it covered for a short while.
Sambharo is ready.
Add salt to taste in finely chopped cabbage, mix it, and keep it aside for a short while.
After 2 to 3 minutes, squeeze out the excess water from that cabbage using both hands.
Put 1 teaspoon of oil to heat in a small pan, then temper with 1 teaspoon of mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Add chopped spicy green chillies. Let them cook for 30 seconds.
Then add this tempering to the cabbage mixed with salt, mix well, and finally serve with fresh coriander leaves on top.

ing: Finely chopped fresh coriander leaves - 1 cup
steps: First of all, mix the vegetables in a bowl.
Now add all the spices to it and mix uniformly.
Kachumber is ready.
First soak the sprouted moong in water for 5 minutes and remove.
Then add cucumber, spinach, carrots, capsicum, tomatoes, red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder to it.
Then add amchur (dry mango powder), lemon juice, pepper, fresh coriander leaves and salt and mix.
Sprouted moong salad is ready.
644.note: To sprout moong, soak them in water for 12 hours. Then drain the water and tie them in a cotton cloth. After 2 days the moong will sprout and then can be used.

steps: First mix red chilli powder and salt and keep aside.
Now place the corn on the gas on high flame to roast.
Keep turning it on all sides from time to time so that it roasts properly.
Let it roast for 5 to 10 minutes.
Then dip half a lemon into the mixed chili and salt blend and apply it on the roasted corn.
Serve hot.
First remove the husks of the corn.
Put water in a pressure cooker.
Put the corn in the cooker and add 1 teaspoon of salt, then close the cooker and put it on the gas.
After 3 whistles turn off the gas and take the corn out of the cooker.
Then apply salt and red chilli powder to lemon wedges and rub it over the corn.
Serve the prepared corn hot.
First bring fresh green jowar ponk cobs and keep them aside.
Prepare a wood ash furnace for roasting.
Put the freshly plucked jowar ponk cobs into the hot furnace and keep turning them from time to time.
When the ponk is roasted properly, its husks will turn light brown in color.
Roast the ponk cobs for a maximum of up to half an hour.
Take out the roasted cobs from the furnace and let them cool down, then remove their husks.
Sift the remaining husks using a sieve to separate the ponk and husks.
Serve the hot green jowar ponk with spicy fine sev and butter.

ing: Half cup chopped fresh coriander leaves
steps: First take 10 to 12 pcs of green half-ripe wheat cobs.
Prepare a furnace to roast them.
And put the wheat cobs in it.
Stir or keep turning them so they roast on all sides for half an hour.
Roast until the husks become slightly black. Then take those roasted cobs out of the furnace.
Take them in a cloth and beat with a stick (to remove the husks).
Doing this will separate the husks from the cobs and they will settle down in the cloth.
Then sift the separated ponk through a sieve to remove the remaining half husks and discard the husks.
Thus the roasted wheat ponk is ready. Add finely chopped fresh coriander leaves to it and serve it hot with spicy sev.

ing: Fresh pearl millet ears (Bajri na dunda) – 10–12 pcs
Wood ash kiln or salt for roasting.
steps: First, take 10–12 fresh ears of pearl millet.
The ears can be roasted either in a wood ash kiln or in a kadhai by heating salt properly.
Let the kiln get properly hot, then put the whole ears of pearl millet in it and let them roast for 20-25 minutes.
Once roasted, the husks will separate automatically.
Now sift the roasted ponk using a strainer to separate the husks, and rub any remaining husks with your hands to remove them.
Serve the prepared ponk mixed with spicy thin sev.

ing: Pickle fenugreek spice mix (methi na masalo) – 2 teaspoons
steps: First, cut the mango into pieces, add turmeric powder and salt to it, and keep it aside for half an hour.
Then dry them on a clean, dry cloth.
Now take them in a bowl and add pickle masala and red chilli powder.
Then add oil and mix everything well.
It can be used after keeping it for 1 hour.

ing: Split fenugreek seeds (methi na kuriya) – 80 grams
Split mustard seeds (rai na kuriya) – 40 grams
Split coriander seeds (dhana na kuriya) – 20 grams
steps: Wash the Rajapuri mango, cut it into pieces, mix them with turmeric and salt, and dry them on a cotton cloth for 1 day.
Take split mustard seeds, split coriander seeds, and split fenugreek seeds in a vessel and add turmeric powder to it.
Heat about 3 teaspoons of oil in a pan until it starts smoking.
When it becomes lukewarm, pour it over the mustard, fenugreek, and coriander seeds, mix everything, and let it cool down.
After it cools down, mix Kashmiri red chilli powder and Resham patti chilli.
Roast salt on a griddle and add this roasted salt to the spice mix.
Add the mango pieces to this prepared spice mix and mix everything well.
Now add fennel seeds on top and mix.
Now heat 250 grams of oil in a kadhai until steam comes out.
Then, after it cools down, mix it into the pickle.
Fill this pickle into a glass jar.
Mix it properly once every day for 1 week.
After 1 week, the pickle is ready for consumption.

ing: Split coriander seeds (dhana na kuriya) – 250 grams
Split mustard seeds (rai na kuriya) – 100 grams
steps: First, peel the mango, cut it into pieces, and soak them in turmeric and salt for 2 days.
On the third day, dry them on a cloth for 2 to 3 hours.
Put 500 grams of oil to heat in a kadhai. When the oil is hot, temper it with cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper.
Then add mustard and coriander split seeds to it, add turmeric and salt, and mix everything.
After this mixture cools down, add chopped jaggery and sugar to it and mix.
Then mix Kashmiri red chilli powder into it.
Once the mango pieces are dry, add them to this spice mix and mix everything.
Keep this pickle in a large vessel for 8 days, stirring it 2 times a day.
After 8 days, this jaggery-mango pickle is ready.

ing: Split mustard seeds (rai na kuriya) - 100 grams
steps: First, wash the kerda and soak them in buttermilk for three days, change the buttermilk daily, and after three days wash them with water and dry them.
Now mix split mustard seeds, turmeric powder, salt, lemon juice, and oil in a large bowl and whisk well.
Once the oil blends uniformly with the other spices, add kerda little by little and keep mixing well.
When all the spices are nicely coated on the kerda, fill them in a glass jar, close the lid tightly on top, and keep it undisturbed for 15 days.
They get pickled and ready in 15 days, after which they can be used.
669.note: Instead of buttermilk, it can also be made in plain water or sour mango water. It can also be made without split mustard seeds using just water, turmeric, and salt.

steps: Take enough water in a vessel to submerge the karondas and let it heat.
Once the water is hot, add washed and cleaned karondas to it and let them boil for 3 to 4 minutes.
Then remove the karondas from the water using a strainer.
Take fenugreek seeds, ajwain (carom seeds), and cumin seeds in a pan and roast them on low heat for a minute and a half.
Once cooled, put them in a mixer along with yellow mustard seeds and salt, and grind them coarsely; do not make them fine.
Heat oil in a pan until it smokes, then take it off the heat and let it cool down.
Once cooled, add turmeric and karondas to it and mix well.
Along with that, add the prepared spice blend and red chilli powder and mix everything together.
Karonda pickle is now ready.
Use this pickle for consumption after 4 days.
Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and dry red chillies to it, mix, and set it aside.
Now, in a bowl, combine raw mango, carrot, lemon, green chillies, turmeric, red chilli powder, fenugreek powder, vinegar, salt, lemon juice, and the prepared tempering, and mix well.
Fill this mixture into a glass jar and let it rest for 2 days.
It can be consumed after 2 days.
Clean the fenugreek seeds and chickpeas and soak them separately in plain water for one night.
The next day, remove them from the plain water and soak them in mango water.
On the 3rd day, spread them out on a cotton cloth to dry.
Now take oil in a pan, heat it, and then let it cool down a little.
Add split mustard and fenugreek seeds, turmeric, and salt to it and mix.
Once this mixture cools down, combine the fenugreek seeds and chickpeas.
677.note: It is necessary to keep the pickle in the fridge; if kept outside, there is a possibility of mold forming.

steps: First, peel the mango and cut it into pieces.
In a vessel, mix mango pieces, turmeric, and salt and keep it for 1 night.
The next day, when extracting water from the mango, save the water in a vessel and take out the mango pieces, wiping them dry.
Now take the mango pieces in a vessel and add sugar to them.
Cover it with a cloth, tie it up, and place it in the sun for 5-6 days to form syrup.
During these 5-6 days, do not stir or open it.
On the third day of keeping the mango mixture in the sun, heat oil in a vessel and temper it with cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper.
Then mix in split mustard seeds, split fenugreek seeds, and split coriander seeds, and turn off the gas.
After that, add fennel seeds and let this spice mixture rest for 2 days.
After 2 days, the spice mix will be ready, and the 5 days of keeping the mango in the sun will be complete.
Now open the vessel containing the mango mixture, take out the mango pieces into a separate vessel, and leave the syrup in it.
Mix the mango pieces extracted from the syrup into the spice blend.
After 3-4 days, when the syrup becomes as thick as honey, add it to the spice mix.
Now slit the dry dates on one side to remove the pits without splitting them into two pieces.
Then soak them in warm water for one hour.
Now split whole cashews into two halves and soak them in the sour turmeric-infused mango water that was saved earlier for 20-30 minutes.
Now take the dry dates and cashews out of the water and dry them with a cloth.
After an hour, add them to the mango mixture and stir well to combine everything.
Now the cashew-dry dates pickle is ready.
678.note: To preserve the pickle for a longer time, fill it in a jar and pour hot oil over the top until the pickle is submerged.

steps: First, cut the dates into 2-4 pieces and remove the pits.
Take dates and raw mango pieces in a bowl.
Add powdered sugar, lemon juice, pickle masala, oil, and salt to it, mix well, and store it in a jar.
After 2 days, it will be ready for consumption.
Actually, it can be served immediately after making. It tastes very delicious.
First, peel the Bilo and wash it.
Then cut it into slices, add turmeric and salt, and mix well.
Now keep this pickle aside for 1 day.
After that, add enough water to submerge the pickle.
Bilo pickle is ready.
The pickle can be consumed after one day.

ing: Split mustard seeds (rai na kuria) – 2 teaspoons
steps: Wash the tindora and cut each into four slices.
Then take them in a bowl, mix salt, cover and keep aside for 3-4 hours.
Now after 3-4 hours, drain the excess water and pat the tindora dry.
Now heat a pan and dry roast fenugreek seeds, split mustard seeds, and fennel seeds on low heat for 1-2 minutes.
Roast only until the color changes slightly, do not roast too much.
Now once they cool down, grind them in a mixer.
Then heat mustard oil in a bowl.
Now add the ground split seeds and tindora and mix well.
Now add red chilli powder, turmeric, and salt, mix well, and then add vinegar and mix everything.
Fill in an air-tight jar and shake well twice a day.
The pickle can be consumed after two days.
681.note: If this pickle is kept in the fridge, it can stay good for up to 12 days. Outside, it will stay good for about five days. Lemon juice can be used instead of vinegar.

ing: Fenugreek split seeds (methi na kuria) – 300 grams
Mustard split seeds (rai na kuria) – 200 grams
Fennel seeds split (fennel seeds na kuria) – 100 grams
Oil – 400 grams and for tempering – 100 grams
Turmeric + Salt – to mix in the bijora
steps: First, cut the bijora with skin into medium-sized pieces.
Mix salt and turmeric in it and keep aside for two to three hours, stirring occasionally in between.
After 2 to 3 hours, take a large cooker, apply a generous amount of oil inside the cooker (apply a little extra quantity).
Put the pieces of bijora in it and close the cooker.
Turn on the gas and after five minutes, hold the cooker up, shake the inner pieces well, and put the cooker back on the gas.
Do this two or three times without opening the cooker.
Turn off the gas after the cooker gets filled with steam.
Do not let the cooker whistle, otherwise the bijora will become too soft.
After opening the cooker, add finely chopped jaggery to those pieces.
Take mustard, fenugreek, and fennel seed split seeds in a bowl and mix them.
Take 400 grams of oil in a kadhai, and once it is hot, temper with cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper.
Then, after the oil cools down a bit, mix it into the above split seeds mixture.
First, wash and wipe the lemons, cut them into small slices to prepare.
Remove the seeds from them. Cut one lemon into eight pieces.
Put these lemon pieces into a jar, add salt, mix, and keep for 10 days.
In between, keep stirring the lemons at intervals of 2-3 days.
After 10-15 days, the lemon pickle will be ready. Method to make jaggery syrup:
Take jaggery in a kadhai, add a little water, heat it on the gas and let the jaggery melt.
Once the jaggery melts, strain this syrup through a strainer.
Then add the softened lemons to it.
Keep it on the gas and let it cook on high heat.
Add ginger powder, black salt, garam masala, and red chilli powder to this mixture, mix and let it boil.
Add cardamom powder to it and let it cook thoroughly.
When the syrup becomes slightly thick, turn off the gas.
After it cools down, fill it in a jar and store it.
Lemon pickle is ready.

ing: Mustard split seeds (rai na kuria) – 50 grams
steps: First, wash the chibda and cut them into slices.
Mix salt in them and let them remain for 3-4 hours.
Then drain the salty water from the chibda, and dry the chibda with a cloth.
Again leave them to dry for 3-4 hours.
Now grind the split seeds slightly in a mixer (coarsely grind).
Add oil and lemon juice to these split seeds and let them soak for 3-4 hours so that they ferment.
Then, mix the chibda slices and mustard split seeds. Fill them in an air-tight container.
Chibda pickle is ready.
Peel the green bamboo and cut it into two or three-inch pieces.
Boil enough water to submerge the bamboo.
Put the bamboo in boiling water, take it out when it becomes soft, place it on a clean cloth and dry it.
Using a sharp knife, slice open the knots and remove them.
Now grind the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, mace, cloves and cardamom in a mixer.
Heat oil in a pan.
When very hot, add the ground spices and sauté slightly.
Now add salt, turmeric and red chilli powder and stir.
When it cools down, mix it into the bamboo pieces.
After mixing the spices, mix in the vinegar.
Fill the pickle in a clean and dry jar and keep it in the sun for seven days.
Use the pickle only after it is ready.
685.note: This pickle tastes good in mustard oil. It can also be made in other oils.

steps: First wash the amla, cut them into small pieces and remove the seeds.
Then roast the sesame seeds in a pan and then roast the fenugreek seeds and keep them aside (roast for 2-3 minutes).
Then coarsely grind the roasted sesame seeds and fenugreek seeds in a mixer.
Now heat oil in a pan, sauté the amla until soft, then turn off the gas.
Then mix salt, turmeric, crushed sesame seeds and fenugreek seeds into the sautéed amla.
Now let this mixture cool down.
Now add red chillies and red chilli powder and fill it in an airtight container.
After 3 days the amla pickle will be ready.
686.note: If you want to keep the pickle good for a long time, heat enough oil to submerge the amla, and after it cools down, pour it over the pickle filled in the container or jar.

steps: Wash the raw mango and remove its peel. Then grate the mango using a grater.
Take this grated raw mango in a pan, add sugar and mix.
Then tie a thin cloth over that pan and keep it for 1 day.
The next day, remove the cloth, stir the mixture and tie the cloth again.
Stir the mixture once every day for 3 days.
On the fourth day, when the sugar syrup is formed in the mixture, add cardamom and saffron and mix well.
Then tie the cloth over it again and put it in the sun for 3-4 hours.
Then fill the murabba in a glass jar or airtight container.
Prepare the mango murabba this way.
687.note: Do not keep the mango shreds and sugar in the sun immediately after mixing. Doing so causes sugar crystals to form in it.

steps: First take 2 glasses of water in a vessel and boil the amla for 8-10 minutes. Then cool the amla and poke holes in it with a fork.
Then drain the water from the amla, put it in a jar or container and add finely chopped jaggery to it.
Keep this jar or container in the sun for 2 days so that the jaggery will melt.
Then heat this mixture in a vessel so that a jaggery syrup is formed.
Then add lemon juice, pepper powder, black salt powder and mix it.
Amla murabba is ready.
688.note: If you want to prepare amla murabba in the sun instead of heating it on the gas, keep it in the sun for 15 to 17 days. Adding pepper powder and black salt is optional.

steps: First wash the mangoes, peel them and prepare mango shreds using a grater.
Add salt to taste and mix everything well.
Keep this mixture for 1 hour, then squeeze the shreds to remove water.
Mix the mango shreds and sugar in a vessel and let it rest for a night, so that the sugar will turn into water.
Then tie a fine cloth to the vessel with a string and put it in the sun. Stir the chunda once a day, bring the vessel inside the house at night.

After 4-5 days all the sugar will melt. Now mix cinnamon, cloves, and Kashmiri red chilli powder into it. Crush the cumin seeds coarsely and mix them in. Then keep it outside for a day and then fill it in a jar.
689.note: There is no need to keep the chunda in the fridge. If we tie a cloth over the glass jar and tie it with a string, moisture does not enter the jar. If the sugar water remains, a white web forms on top of the chunda, for this let it heat properly in the sun. So that if the syrup thickens, a white web will not form. If you want to make chunda on the gas in the same way, mix the mango shreds, salt and sugar and let it heat on the gas. After the syrup reaches the right consistency, mix the remaining spices in it. If there is no sunlight where you live, chunda can be made this way too.

ing: green chillies or red chillies – 600 grams
split mustard seeds (rai no kuriyo) – 12 teaspoons
lemon juice to be added later –
steps: Wash the chillies and cut them into four lengthwise slits.
Then add 10 tablespoons of lemon juice, 60 grams of salt, and 2 teaspoons of turmeric powder, mix well, and let them soak for 1 to 3 hours.
Then take the soaked chillies out of the mixture and dry them on a cotton cloth for 4-5 hours.
Take split mustard seeds in a vessel and add warmed and lukewarm oil to it.
Add the oil and mustard seed spice mix to the dried and wiped chillies.
Add 1 teaspoon of lemon juice, 20 grams of salt, and 3 teaspoons of fennel seeds powder to it and mix well.
The prepared raita chillies can be used immediately or after one day.
First, add turmeric and salt to the lemons, fill them in a bottle, and let them rest for 10 days.
After 10 days, wash the chillies and make a slit in each chilli.
Now, pack the chillies tightly into the bottle containing the lemons.
All the chillies must remain submerged in the lemon water.
Close the bottle and let it sit for a week.
Ready for consumption after one week.

ing: salt or black salt (sanchal) – to taste
steps: First, wash the cluster beans, wipe them dry, and split them into two lengthwise.
Take water in a wide vessel (loyu), place a stand in it, put a plate on top of this stand, and steam the cluster bean pieces in it.
After steaming the cluster bean pieces, dry them in the sun.
Within 2 days, these cluster beans will dry and become kachari.
Fry the prepared kachari in oil, sprinkle salt or black salt on top, and serve hot.
692.note: Always use cluster beans with seeds to make kachari.

steps: First, wash the okra, cut off their stems, and slit them into two parts.
Now, mix salt into the buttermilk, soak the okra in it, and let them stay for a night.
The next day, take the okra out of the buttermilk and dry them in the sun for 2 to 3 days.
Once the okra kachari is dried, fry it in oil and serve.
First, wash the chillies and make a slit in the middle or cut them into two halves.
There is no need to remove the stems of the chillies.
In a vessel, mix lemon juice, salt, and turmeric, and combine the chillies into the mixture.
Let the chillies dipped in turmeric-salt rest for a day and a night.
Now on the next day, dry them in the sun for 2 to 3 days.
After drying, fry the kachari in hot oil and serve hot.
First, wash the ridge gourd and cut them into long, thick slices.
Mix them with salt and buttermilk and let them soak for one night.
The next day, dry the ridge gourd in the sun for 2 to 3 days.
Once the ridge gourd is dried and turns into kachari, fry it in hot oil and serve it hot.
First, wash the kothimba and cut them into two halves.
Soak them in buttermilk and salt mixed together for a day and a night.
The next morning, dry them in the sun.
If the sun is very strong, the kachari will be ready in 1 to 2 days, and if it is slightly less, in 3 to 4 days.
