Once the kothimba kachari is ready, fry or roast it in oil and serve.

ing: Split mustard seeds (rai na kuriya) – 1.5 spoons
steps: First, take tender cucumbers and grate them without peeling the skin.
Lightly squeeze the grated cucumber with your hands to remove the water.
During the monsoon season, apply a little ghee to your hands and rub the grated cucumber so it does not release water.
Next, strain the water from the curd, whisk it, and add the grated cucumber, split mustard seeds, sugar, and salt to it.
Make the raita one hour before eating so that the split mustard seeds soak well and give a good flavor.
First, boil the carrots for 3-4 minutes, then peel the skin and remove the central white part.
Next, grate them.
Take the curd and add the grated carrot, ginger-chilli paste, and salt to taste.
Now, prepare a tempering (vaghar) of oil and mustard seeds over it and add it to the mixture.
Now add sugar and fresh coriander leaves and mix well.
Carrot raita is ready.
First, finely chop the mogri.
Then in a bowl, add mogri, green capsicum, black salt, coriander-cumin powder, red chilli powder, sugar, and curd, and mix everything well.
So the mogri raita is ready.
Sprinkle fresh coriander leaves on top.

ing: Boiled mix vegetables – 250 grams (potatoes, carrots, pumpkin, bottle gourd, capsicum, cucumber, etc.)
Finely chopped fresh coriander leaves – 2 teaspoons
steps: First of all, grate the boiled vegetables.
Then take curd and cream in a bowl and mix well.
Then mix the boiled vegetables into it.
After that add salt to taste, sugar, ginger-chilli and fresh coriander leaves, and stir well.
Then put it in the fridge to chill for a while.
And then serve it.
700.note: It becomes even better if we use black salt, roasted cumin powder, red chilli and chaat masala in the raita.

steps: Cut the bananas into small pieces.
Strain the water from the curd and add banana pieces, ground cumin, ginger, chillies, sugar and salt to it.
Mix this entire mixture well, the banana raita is ready, and sprinkle fresh coriander leaves while serving.
First of all, heat and melt ghee in a non-stick pan.
Then add pearl millet (bajra) flour to it and roast for 2 to 3 minutes.
While roasting the flour, take water in another vessel, add jaggery to it and heat it on the gas.
After the flour is roasted, add the jaggery water to it and stir on low flame.
After boiling for 3 to 4 minutes, add dry ginger powder and ajwain (carom seeds), stir it and remove it from the gas.
So the bajra raab is ready.
702.note: Raab should always be served hot. Take water accordingly for thin or thick raab. Jaggery can be increased or decreased according to taste.

steps: First of all, heat and melt ghee in a non-stick pan.
Then add rajgira flour to it and roast for 2 to 3 minutes.
While roasting the flour, take water in another vessel, add jaggery to it and heat it on the gas until the jaggery dissolves.
After the flour is roasted, add the jaggery water to it and stir slowly.
After boiling for 3 to 4 minutes, add dry ginger powder and ajwain (carom seeds), stir it and remove it from the gas.
Then add pieces of cashews and almonds to it and serve hot.
703.note: Raab should always be served hot. Take water accordingly for thin or thick raab. Jaggery can be increased or decreased according to taste.

steps: First of all, heat and melt ghee in a non-stick pan.
Then roast the jowar flour in it.
While roasting the flour, take water in another vessel, add jaggery to it and heat it on the gas.
After the flour is roasted, add the jaggery water to it and stir on low flame.
After boiling for 3 to 4 minutes, add dry ginger powder and ajwain (carom seeds), stir it and remove it from the gas.
Then add pieces of cashews and almonds to it.
704.note: Raab should always be served hot. Take water accordingly for thin or thick raab. Jaggery can be increased or decreased according to taste.

steps: First, wash the rice and let it soak for half an hour.
Put 1 liter of water to heat in a pot. Once the water gets slightly warm, add the rice to it.
Then add lemon juice and ghee to it.
Now let the rice cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, strain the excess water with the help of a strainer.
Thus, nice separate grains of rice will be ready.
706.note: Adding 2-3 drops of lemon makes the rice grains separate.

steps: First, wash the rice.
Then add rice and water in a pressure cooker and make rice.
After the cooker cools down, take out the prepared rice in a bowl.
Now add 2 cups of curd to the rice and stir.
For tempering, take oil in a small kadhai, add mustard seeds, urad dal, and chana dal to it, and roast until both dals become slightly red.
Then add red chillies and green chillies and sauté, then pour this tempering into the curd rice.
Add salt to taste and stir.
Curd rice is ready, serve it hot.
708.note: Adding 2-3 drops of lemon makes the rice grains separate.

steps: Boil the rice in 1 liter of water.
Add jaggery and ghee to the hot rice and mix well.
Piping hot selan is ready.
First wash the rice 2-3 times, heat water in a pan and boil the rice.
Then add saffron, 2-cloves, 1-cardamom to it and let it boil for 10-12 minutes.
In another pan, heat ghee, add the remaining cloves and cardamom to it, and mix the rice.
Now add sugar and after 2-3 minutes turn off the gas.
Now add cashews-almonds, grated dry coconut and raisins for garnish and mix well.
Hot ghee-sugar rice is ready.
710.note: Adding 2-3 drops of lemon juice makes the rice grains separate.

steps: First soak the rice in water for half an hour.
Now wash the rice two to three times, put the rice, salt to taste, and 2-3 drops of lemon juice in a pot.
Now add whole cumin seeds and water to it and make the rice.
Jeera rice is ready.
711.note: If you do not want to add cumin seeds while boiling the rice, you can temper it in a little oil and add it after the rice is ready. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate. If making rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. And if making rice in a pot, take 3-4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice.

steps: First wash the rice, cook it for 10 to 20 minutes, strain it in a colander and let it cool.
Then heat oil in a pan, add urad and chana dal to it and roast until they turn brown.
Now add mustard seeds, dry chillies and curry leaves to it.
Then add finely chopped tomatoes and red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander-cumin powder and salt to taste, and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Once the tomatoes are cooked, add the rice, mix well, add garam masala and fresh coriander leaves on top, and serve piping hot.
712.note: If making rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. And if making rice in a pot, take 3-4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate.

ing: Coconut – 1 pcs (finely ground in a mixer)
steps: First wash the rice, add salt and lemon, and make separated rice.
Then heat oil in a pan, add urad and chana dal, and sauté until golden brown.
Then add mustard seeds, dry red chillies, and curry leaves, followed by the ground coconut.
Add finely chopped green chillies to it.
Let the coconut roast well. Once it starts releasing oil, add the prepared rice and mix well.
Coconut rice is ready. Serve hot.
713.note: Peas, cashews, carrots can also be used. You can use dry fruits of your choice. If making rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. And if making rice in a pot, take 3-4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate.

ing: green chillies paste – 1 spoon, Cabbage finely chopped – 1/2 cup
steps: To make rice, boil water in a vessel, add oil and lemon juice, and then add rice.
After the rice is ready in 7 to 8 minutes, strain it in a colander (holed vessel).
In a pan, sauté oil, ginger, green chillies paste, French beans, carrots, capsicum, and cabbage.
Now add Schezwan chutney to it and keep for one minute.
Then add plain rice and salt to taste, and mix well.
Piping hot Schezwan rice is ready.
714.note: If we use non-aromatic rice for this rice, the aroma of Schezwan rice will stand out more. If making rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. And if making rice in a pot, take 3-4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate.

steps: First, wash the rice and cook it into plain rice.
Heat oil in a pan.
Once the oil is hot, add urad dal and chana dal. When they turn brown, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds.
Then add the ginger-chilli paste to it.
Then add lemon juice to the tempering.
Then add the cooked rice to it, finally add lemon juice and coriander, and mix well.
So, lemon rice is ready.
715.note: If cooking rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. And if cooking rice in a vessel, take 3–4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate.

steps: For the masala:
Roast all the spices in a pan.
Then crush them in a mixer to make a powder.
Now wash the rice and soak it for 15 minutes.
Now boil the rice in such a way that each grain of rice remains separate.
Let it cool down.
Meanwhile, roast the peanuts and sesame seeds separately in a pan.
Then grind them coarsely in a mixer.
Now heat ghee in a pan and sauté mustard seeds and chana dal for 1 minute.
Then add dry chillies and curry leaves to it.
After that, add boiled rice, grated dry coconut, tamarind pulp, turmeric, chitrana masala, roasted peanuts, sesame seeds, and salt.
Mix well and keep for 5 minutes.
So, hot hot chitrana rice is ready.
Heat water in a vessel to cook the rice.
Once the water gets hot, add salt to taste and washed rice to it.
When the rice is 90% done, drain the excess water from it.
Now put oil in a kadhai and put it to heat.
When the oil is hot, add corn kernels, French beans, broccoli, capsicum, carrots, and peas, and stir with a spoon.
Once all the vegetables are cooked, add salt, chilli flakes, pepper powder, ginger paste, soya sauce, and chilli sauce, and stir.
After that, add the rice and mix well, and our hot-hot fried rice is ready.
First, clean the mint, fresh coriander leaves, and ginger-chillies properly and grind them finely in a mixer.
Then take rice in a vessel and clean it.
After that, add water as needed and salt to taste, and cook loose/separate rice.
Then take oil in a pan.
When the oil is hot, add mustard seeds. Once the mustard seeds crackle, add the mixture of mint and fresh coriander leaves.
Add salt to taste, turmeric, coriander-cumin powder, and garam masala, and keep stirring.
When oil separates from it, add the prepared rice, then squeeze lemon juice from top and mix everything well.
Let it cook for 2 minutes, then take it down from the gas and serve.
718.note: Adding lemon while cooking the rice makes the rice white and separate.

steps: First, keep the separately cooked rice ready, and let it cool down for a while.
Put plain oil in a vessel according to the above measurement to heat.
Temper it with finely chopped green chilli.
Then add red-green capsicum chillies as well. Sauté it for some time.
Then add crushed tomato puree and add olive oil at the same time.
After a little while, add taco seasoning masala and salt to taste. Also add the beans.
Then add the rice little by little and keep stirring. This way add all the rice evenly.
719.note: Instead of black beans, boiled rajma or corn kernels can be used.

ing: ghee – 5 teaspoons (oil can also be used)
Wheat dough – for sealing the handi
steps: First, soak the rice for 30 minutes.
Now take about 3-4 cups of water in a vessel.
Add bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon, pepper, cardamom, salt, and ghee to it and let it boil for a while.
Then add the soaked rice to it, boil it up to 80% for 6-7 minutes, and let it cool.
Now take chopped potatoes, French beans, cauliflower, and carrot in a bowl.
Then add curd, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, and garam masala to it and mix everything well.
Now heat 2-3 teaspoons of ghee in a kadhai, when it is slightly warm, roast the cashews and take them out.
Now in the same ghee, make a tempering of cumin seeds, large cardamom, ginger paste, and green chillies, and let it cook for a while.
Then add the mixed vegetables and let them cook on low heat, taking care that the vegetables are not completely cooked.
Let the vegetables remain slightly crunchy.
Pour about two spoons of the rice cooking water into it and let it cook for a while.
Now take an earthenware handi (pot) in which we will steam the biryani.
Apply some ghee on the inner side of the handi and now we will make layers of the sautéed vegetables and rice in it.
Put about a spoonful of vegetables in the handi, then put rice on top of it, fill the whole handi this way.
Finally, keep a layer of rice on the handi and top it with a teaspoon of ghee, cashews, some garam masala, mint leaves, and coriander, and close the handi.
Seal and pack all around with the prepared wheat dough.
Let it cook on very low heat for about 10-15 minutes.
Then remove from the gas and let it cool down for a while.
After 10-12 minutes, remove the dough from around, open the handi, and gently take out the biryani with a spoon so that it remains separate and the rice does not break.
Serve hot.
720.note: A non-stick pan with a lid can be used instead of an earthenware handi. Oil or half-and-half oil and ghee can be used instead of ghee. Adding lemon while making rice makes the rice white and separate.

steps: First, take about 3-4 cups of water in a vessel.
Add salt and ghee to it, then add cleaned rice and boil it up to 80% for 6-7 minutes, and let it cool.
Now take some ghee and oil in a pan and make a tempering of mustard and cumin seeds.
Add cloves, bay leaf, cardamom, black cardamom, cinnamon, ginger paste, and chillies to it and mix.
Then add chopped potatoes, cauliflower, carrot, French beans, and green peas after cleaning them properly.
Now cover the pan and let all the vegetables cook on low heat.
After the vegetables are cooked, add salt, garam masala, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, curd, and rice and stir.
Now add saffron dissolved in milk.
Pour this mixture into the pulao and mix well.
Vegetable Pulao is ready.
721.note: Adding lemon while making rice makes the rice white and separate.

steps: First, boil the rice and keep it ready.
Now, heat butter in a kadhai.
Then add ginger-chilli paste, capsicum, tomatoes, potatoes, boiled peas, and turmeric powder, and mix well.
Next, add pav bhaji masala, red chilli powder, and salt, and mix.
Then add the prepared rice and let it cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
Finally, add lemon juice, stir, and turn off the gas.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves on top and serve hot.
725.note: Be careful not to break the rice grains while mixing. If making rice in a cooker, take 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. If making rice in a vessel, take 3–4 cups of water for 1 cup of rice. Adding lemon to the rice will make the grains separate.

steps: First, take a kadhai and add 1 teaspoon of ghee.
Once the ghee is hot, add the thuli and roast it on low flame until it turns pink.
Then remove the thuli into a bowl.
Now, heat one teaspoon of ghee in a cooker and make a tempering (vaghar) with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies.
Then add finely chopped cabbage, carrot, capsicum, green peas, and tomatoes.
Next, add turmeric powder, salt to taste, coriander-cumin powder, and red chilli powder, and mix well.
Then add the roasted thuli along with 3 cups of water, mix everything well, and let the cooker whistle for 3 times.
Afterward, transfer the thuli to a bowl and garnish with fresh coriander leaves on top. Thuli is ready.
726.note: Thuli can be eaten with sweet-and-sour kadhi or with curd. It can also be made without adding any vegetables.

steps: First, roast the semolina (rava) on low heat.
Now, heat oil in a kadhai and roast the urad dal, peanuts, and cashews.
Mix all the ingredients well.
Then, heat oil in the kadhai and make a tempering (vaghar) using mustard seeds, ginger, and curry leaves.
Next, add the peas and let them cook for a short while.
Now, add the roasted semolina (rava) and all the ingredients, and mix well.
Then add water, cover the kadhai with a lid, and let it cook for 5 to 10 minutes.
Rava upma is ready.
Now garnish with fresh coriander leaves on top and serve hot.
First, mix the dal and rice and wash them.
In a pressure cooker, add 2 to 3 glasses of water, the dal-rice mix, and salt to make khichdi.
Add ghee to a kadhai.
Once the ghee is hot, add cumin seeds, ginger, curry leaves, dry red chillies, and cashews, and roast until they turn pink.
After the khichdi is cooked, add this tempering to it and mix well.
Pongal is ready.
First, wash the dal and rice in water and soak them for 30 minutes.
Now, take oil in a cooker and add ghee to heat it.
Then add mustard seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon, and cloves.
Now add the soaked rice and tuver dal along with 4 bowls of water.
Then add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, and sugar, and mix.
Close the cooker and let it whistle 3-4 times.
Hot khichdi is ready, you can serve it by adding ghee on top.
First, wash the rice and moong dal in a cooker.
Then add water, turmeric, and salt to it and mix.
Now close the cooker lid, place it on the gas stove, and let it whistle 5 times.
Then serve it hot in a dish by adding 1 teaspoon of ghee on top.
Prepare moong dal khichdi in this way.

ing: Ginger - green chilli paste – to taste
steps: Wash the moong dal and soak it in water for 5 minutes.
Put ghee in a cooker and place it on the gas stove.
When the ghee becomes hot, add cumin, curry leaves, and ginger to it and mix.
Let it cook for a while, then add green chilli.
After 1 minute, add finely chopped tomatoes. Let the tomatoes become a little soft.
Then add chopped carrot and peas and sauté for 2–3 minutes.
Then take the moong dal out of the water and add it to the above mixture.
Then add turmeric and leave it for 2–3 minutes.
Then add oats and salt and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add water and mix (add water according to the way it is used in khichdi).
Keep the gas medium and let the cooker whistle 2 times.
Then take out the khichdi, garnish it with chopped fresh coriander leaves, and serve hot.
Wash and prepare the quinoa.
Then add ghee for tempering (vaghar).
After that, add cumin seeds, dried red chillies, whole black pepper, cloves, cashews, ginger, chillies, and turmeric to temper it.
Add potatoes, carrots, peas, and salt to it and sauté.
Now add quinoa to it.
Then add chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder, and water, and let it boil on medium gas for 20 minutes.
Once the water has completely evaporated, turn off the gas.
First, combine rice and moong dal and wash them 3 to 4 times with water.
Then put the rice and moong dal in a pressure cooker and add water and salt to it.
Now, after 4 to 5 whistles, turn off the gas and let the cooker cool down for a while.
Then open the cooker, add ghee, and mix well.
So the hot Kutchi khichdi is ready.

ing: cloves, cinnamon, black pepper, bay leaf – 1-2 pcs
steps: Take rice and dal in a bowl and wash them with water.
Put oil and ghee in a pressure cooker.
After it becomes hot, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, cloves, cinnamon, black pepper, bay leaf, ginger paste, and chillies to heat.
Then add tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, capsicum, and peas to it and mix.
Then add the rice-dal and mix.
Add 8 cups of water to it, close the cooker, and after 3 to 4 whistles, turn off the gas.
Then take it out on a plate and serve hot.
734.note: Tuver dal can also be used instead of moong dal. You can use vegetables of your choice.

steps: First of all, wash the tuvar dal and rice, and soak them separately in bowls for two hours.
Now boil both in separate vessels in such a way that the rice and tuvar dal remain separate and distinct.
Now heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and bay leaf, and saute.
Now add peas, carrot, raisins, and cashew pieces to it and cook for a short while.
After a little while, add turmeric and all the other spices to it and mix well.
Now add the boiled rice and tuvar dal to it and mix everything properly.
Turn off the gas and garnish it with pomegranate and fresh coriander leaves on top.
Serve the fruit khichdi hot with kadhi and papad.
First of all, wash the tuvar dal twice in a pressure cooker and boil it by adding 2 glasses of water.
Then open the cooker and blend it using a blender.
Now put it in a deep vessel to boil by adding 2 glasses of water, salt, turmeric powder, coriander-cumin powder, jaggery, green chillies, and ginger.
On the other side, heat oil in a pan and prepare a tempering (vaghar) of mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, and curry leaves.
After a little while, add tomatoes to it, and when the tomatoes are sautéed properly, add red chilli powder.
Now add this tempering into the boiling tuvar dal.
Let it boil for 15 to 20 minutes, then add half a lemon and let it continue boiling.
After a short while, turn off the gas and add fresh coriander leaves to garnish it.
First, wash the moong dal and put it in a pressure cooker to boil by adding one glass of water, close the lid, and let it whistle twice.
In another pan beside it, heat ghee, add cumin seeds and let them splutter, then add ginger-green chilli paste and bay leaf, and saute.
Then immediately add finely chopped tomatoes and a little salt to it and saute until the ghee separates.
Once sauteed, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, and salt.
When all the spices are sauteed properly, add the boiled dal to it.
Then add about half a glass of water and let it simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
Afterwards, add fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.
Mix all three dals together, wash them, and soak for 5 to 10 minutes.
Then put slightly less than 2 glasses of water in the cooker.
Add turmeric powder and salt to it, mix well, close the cooker lid, and boil for 4 whistles.
Then put ghee and oil to heat in a kadhai.
Do the tempering with dry red chillies, cumin seeds, curry leaves, ginger-green chilli paste, and finely chopped tomatoes.
Then when it is sauteed well, add all the boiled dal to it.
If the dal looks too thick, add measured water and let it boil.
After boiling for about 5 minutes, turn off the gas.
Then transfer it to a serving vessel and put fresh coriander leaves and kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) on top.

ing: green chillies (cut into two halves) – 4-5 pcs
steps: First of all, put the soaked masoor dal in a cooker along with chopped ginger and salt.
Add 3 cups of water to it and boil until two whistles are released.
Heat oil in a kadhai, add cumin seeds, bay leaf, and tomatoes, and saute nicely.
After the oil separates, add green chillies, red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder, garam masala, and salt on low flame.
After that, saute properly.
Once the tempering is ready, add the boiled masoor dal to it and add water as required.
Then add fresh coriander leaves and boil for 5 minutes.
739.note: Be careful while adding salt because salt was already added while boiling the dal.

steps: Mix all three dals in a pressure cooker, wash them, add 1 ½ glasses of water, half a spoonful of oil, a pinch of turmeric powder, and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles.
After boiling the dal, heat oil in a pan.
Once the oil is hot, add cumin seeds, ginger paste, green chillies, bay leaf, cloves, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and then chopped tomatoes; sauté them.
When the tomatoes become soft and release oil, add the boiled dal, mix everything well, and stir.
Then add 1/2 glass of water and let it boil for 4-5 minutes.
Finally, add lemon juice and fresh coriander leaves, and serve hot.
Put water in a pressure cooker, add urad dal, a little salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of oil, and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
Heat oil in a pan, and when it becomes hot, add cumin seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies paste, and stir for 30 seconds.
Then add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and the urad dal along with about half a cup of water.
If you want to make it thinner, you can add a little more water.
Add salt if needed, boil the dal for 5 minutes, add coriander leaves, and the dal is ready.
Serve hot with bhakhri or bajra rotla.
Wash the spinach leaves, stack them together, roll them, and chop them finely.
Then boil them in boiling water for 1 minute, transfer them to a bowl, and cool them down with cold water.
Now take chana dal, toor dal, and masoor dal in a cooker, add water, salt, and turmeric powder, and cook for 4-3 whistles.
Take oil in a pan, temper with cumin seeds, and add ginger, chillies, and tomatoes to it.
Then add red chilli powder and coriander-cumin powder and sauté until the tomatoes become soft.
Then add spinach, sauté for a while, and then add the boiled dal.
Then add a little water and let it cook.
Then add garam masala, lemon juice, boil it, and add some fresh coriander leaves.
Boil for 5 minutes and transfer it to another vessel.
Now to temper again from the top, heat ghee in a small pan.
Add cumin seeds, dry red chillies, and red chilli powder to make the tempering.
Pour it over the prepared dal and serve hot after garnishing with fresh coriander leaves.
First, add gram flour (besan) to the buttermilk and mix well.
For tempering, take equal proportions of oil and ghee in a pan, and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and fenugreek seeds.
Then add chillies and pour in the prepared buttermilk and flour mixture.
After that, add turmeric powder, salt to taste, and a little water, and boil the kadhi until it thickens.
In a mixer, add chillies, fresh coriander leaves, curry leaves, wheat flour, curd, grated dry coconut, and water, and grind them.
Then heat oil in a pan, temper with cumin seeds, and add the prepared mixture to it.
Add salt to taste and water, boil it well, and serve it hot.
First, dry roast the wheat flour as it is (without ghee) so that no lumps are formed.
Grate the jaggery, add water as needed, and put it on the stove to boil.
Once it starts boiling, add the roasted flour and whisk it well using a churner.
Now add dry ginger powder, fennel seeds, and coconut, and let it boil.
After a while, add cardamom powder, mix well, and turn off the gas.
Now heat ghee in a tempering pan and add cinnamon and cloves.
Once it crackles, add it to the kadhi.
Boil for a little while and turn off the gas.
Hot and delicious jaggery kadhi is ready.
First, soak the kokum in warm water for 2 to 3 minutes.
Then add gram flour (besan) to it and mix well.
Now heat ghee in a vessel.
Then add green chillies, curry leaves, cumin, and red chilli powder and sauté them.
Next, add the kokum mixture along with turmeric, jaggery, salt to taste, and water as required, and boil on low heat.
Mix in fresh coriander leaves.
Hot kokum kadhi is ready.
First, roast 200 grams of gram flour (besan).
Once cooled, add turmeric, salt, coriander-cumin powder, and 2 teaspoons of oil, mix well, and stuff it into slit green chillies.
Then take buttermilk in a bowl, add 50 grams of gram flour (besan) and turmeric, mix well, and bring it to a boil.
Then add salt, jaggery, ginger, and chillies, and boil for 2-3 minutes.
Next, add the stuffed chillies and let them cook.
Then heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and garam masala.
Add this tempering to the kadhi and serve hot.
First, cut the drumsticks into 3-inch sized pieces and wash them.
Now put the chopped drumsticks in a cooker, add turmeric and salt to taste, and boil them.
Now take buttermilk in a bowl and mix gram flour (besan) into it.
Heat oil in a pan and temper with cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, and curry leaves.
Now add turmeric and stir again, then pour the buttermilk mixture into the tempering.
When the kadhi starts to boil, add the drumstick pieces and let the kadhi boil again.
Now garnish with fresh coriander leaves on top and serve hot.
First, wash the brinjals and chop them into small pieces.
Then heat oil in a pan, temper with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and green chillies, and add the chopped brinjals.
Next, add red chilli powder, turmeric, and coriander-cumin powder, mix well, add half a cup of water, and let it cook on low heat.
In a bowl, add buttermilk and gram flour (besan) and mix well.
Now add the buttermilk-besan mixture to the tempered brinjals, stir continuously, and let it boil.
Then add fresh coriander leaves and serve the hot brinjal kadhi.
First, wash the okra, wipe them dry, and chop them into round slices.
Next, take buttermilk in a bowl, add gram flour (besan) to it, and mix well.
Then, heat oil in a kadhai, add mustard seeds, red chilli powder, and ginger-chilli paste for tempering, and mix in the okra.
After that, add salt and turmeric powder, cover, and let it cook.
Then, add the buttermilk mixture and stir continuously on low heat.
Hot and fresh okra kadhi is ready.
Heat oil in a pan.
Once the oil is slightly hot, add turmeric powder and red chilli powder, and immediately add the curd so the chilli does not burn.
Then add salt, mix well, and take it off the heat.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve.
Wash all the dals and put them in a pressure cooker to boil.
Once cooled, do not stir the dal.
Heat ghee or butter in a vessel and add cumin seeds.
Make a ginger-chilli paste, add it to the vessel, and sauté.
Then add tomato pulp and the boiled dal.
Add salt, red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder, garam masala, and cinnamon-cloves powder, and bring to a boil.
Finally, add butter and turn off the heat.
752.note: After boiling the dal, leave it as it is; do not puree it with a blender.

ing: tamarind (imli) – 1 teaspoon (make a paste of it in 1/2 cup water)
steps: First, take water, tamarind paste, turmeric powder, pureed tomato, jaggery, chopped fresh coriander leaves, salt, and curry leaves in a vessel.
Heat on high flame for 2-3 minutes and let it boil on medium flame for 7-8 minutes.
Then add cumin powder and black pepper powder, and let it simmer.
While it simmers, take ghee in a tempering pan.
Once the ghee is hot, add mustard seeds; when they splutter, add cumin seeds, dry red chilli, and curry leaves for tempering.
Pour the tempering into the rasam and turn off the heat.
Sprinkle fresh coriander leaves on top.
Rasam is ready.
753.note: Adjust the tamarind and jaggery according to how sour or sweet you prefer it.

ing: sweet neem leaves (curry leaves) – as required
steps: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with 6 cups of water to boil. Once boiled, blend it into a paste using a blender.
Heat oil in a kadhai, and add mustard seeds, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, and sweet neem leaves for tempering.
Now add pieces of boiled potato and chopped tomato.
Then add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, tamarind pulp, sambar masala, and garam masala, mix well, and let it boil.
Now add the dal paste and stir well.
Let it simmer on medium heat for 5-7 minutes.
Turn off the heat, garnish with green fresh coriander leaves, and serve.
Sambar is ready. It can be served with dosa, uttapam, and medu vada.
754.note: Boiled vegetables like eggplant, drumsticks, tomatoes, pieces of yam, or pieces of bottle gourd can be added as convenient. The boiled dal can be blended smoothly using a hand mixer.

steps: Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half, add half a cup of water in a pressure cooker and boil them.
After boiling, blend them using a blender.
Strain this mixture through a large strainer.
Crush all the spices, place them in a cloth and tie a bundle.
Now heat ghee in a pan, put the tomato gravy to boil in it and place the spice bundle in it.
Once the gravy becomes appropriately thick, dissolve the cream and corn flour in a little water and add it.
Then boil for 5 minutes.
After a short while, add sugar and salt.
Squeeze the spice bundle, remove it, and serve the soup piping hot.
Add chopped bottle gourd, carrot, tomatoes and other vegetables in a cooker along with water.
Add 2 teaspoons of yellow moong dal and after 3 whistles turn off the gas and let the cooker cool down.
Then run a blender in the cooker to make it smooth. While straining, add the leftover water back into the soup.
Heat 1 teaspoon of ghee in a vessel and add the bottle gourd mixture to it.
Add salt to taste and 1 teaspoon of black pepper powder, and boil on low heat for 5-6 minutes.
Turn off the gas, add 1 teaspoon of cream to it, and serve the soup.
756.note: Can also be made without adding yellow moong dal, which will be considered farali (allowed during fasting).

ing: Salt, black pepper powder - to taste
steps: Wash the spinach leaves thoroughly and chop them finely.
Chop the tomatoes and carrots finely.
Take 4 cups of water in a pan and put it to heat.
When the water boils, add the spinach leaves, ginger, and pieces of tomato and carrot to it.
Once everything is boiled, turn off the gas, let it cool, blend it smooth with a blender, and strain it through a sieve.
Then take it in a pan and put the soup to heat on medium heat.
Once the soup boils well, add black pepper powder and salt, mix well, and turn off the gas.
Now take some soup in a bowl, add some cream and a few bread pieces to it, and serve hot.
Mix corn flour in half a cup of water.
Heat butter in a pan, add ginger paste and all the chopped vegetables, mix and sauté for 2-3 minutes. Then cover with a lid on low heat and let the vegetables cook for 3-4 minutes.
Afterwards, add 3-4 cups of water, corn flour water, black pepper powder, chilli sauce, and salt, and boil the soup.
Keep the soup on the gas on low heat for 5-7 minutes and remove it.
Finally, add lemon juice and fresh coriander leaves and serve the hot soup.

ing: Salt, cinnamon, black pepper powder - to taste
steps: Peel and wash the carrots, remove the white core in the center, and chop them finely.
Peel and finely chop the potatoes.
Heat butter in a pan, add bay leaf, and pour 4-5 cups of water to boil.
When the water boils, add ginger, potatoes, and carrot pieces to it.
Once all the vegetables are boiled, turn off the gas, let it cool, blend smooth with a blender, and strain through a sieve.
Then put the soup to heat in a pan.
When the soup boils and thickens slightly, add cinnamon-black pepper powder and salt, mix well, and turn off the gas.
Pour the soup into a bowl, add a little cream, fresh coriander leaves, and a few bread pieces, and serve the soup hot.

ing: cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, Black pepper powder – 1 teaspoon
steps: Dissolve corn flour, one teaspoon of butter, salt, and black pepper powder in cold milk, stir continuously on low heat until it thickens to prepare the white sauce.
Heat butter slightly in a vessel and add all the vegetables to it (do not add boiled macaroni). Add salt, pepper, mix well, then pour half the water and let the vegetables cook.
Take care not to overcook the vegetables.
In a separate vessel, chop the tomatoes, pour the remaining water, and boil them thoroughly.
Then grind them in a mixer to make a puree and strain the puree.
Add the tomato puree to the boiled vegetables.
Then dissolve 2 teaspoons of corn flour in water and add it to the soup.
Add boiled macaroni, red chilli powder, sugar, white sauce, ajinomoto, and cinnamon, cloves, cardamom powder to the soup, heat and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Macaroni Minestrone Soup is ready.
Sprinkle a little cheese while serving.
First, pour about 1 ½ cups of water into the grated corn and about 1/2 cup of water into the corn kernels, and boil both separately in a cooker.
Once the cooker cools down, prepare a thick pulp from the grated corn.
Now heat butter in a vessel on the gas on low heat.
Add maida (all-purpose flour) to it and mix well.
Then slowly pour milk into it while stirring.
Add the corn pulp to the white sauce prepared this way.
Add sugar, salt, and pepper powder to it.
While serving, add the remaining half of the corn kernels into each cup as appropriate and pour the heated corn soup over it.
Add 1 teaspoon of cream to each cup.
761.note: French beans can also be added to this soup. Instead of maida, corn flour dissolved in water can also be used.

steps: First, heat oil in a vessel, add green chillies and ginger paste, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Then add finely chopped cabbage, carrot, and capsicum, and sauté in oil for 3-4 minutes.
Now add vegetable stock and bring it to a boil for a while.
Then add tomato sauce, soya sauce, red chilli sauce, and fresh coriander leaves, mix well, and boil for 2-3 minutes.
Next, add salt and corn flour mixed in 1/4 cup of water to the soup, and boil until the soup becomes slightly thick.
Then take the soup off the heat, add black pepper powder, and mix.
Pour the soup into a bowl, add fried noodles, and serve hot. Method for making vegetable stock:
Take 2 glasses of water in a vessel.
Then chop and add 200 grams of carrots, 200 grams of cabbage, and other vegetables into it.
Now boil it for 20 minutes.
Remove it from the gas and separate the vegetables.
The liquid remaining in it is called vegetable stock. Method for making fried noodles:
First, boil the noodles in water.
Once the noodles are boiled and ready, strain them from the water, separate them, and dry the noodles.
Then add 1/2 teaspoon of corn flour, mix well, and then fry them.

ing: Cumin, salt, black pepper - to taste
steps: Heat oil in a large pan on medium heat.
Sauté capsicum, carrot, and red chillies in it for 3 minutes.
Add tomato pieces, tomato sauce (vegetable boiled water/vegetable broth), chilli, cumin, and pepper to taste, and stir for 2 minutes.
Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
Add corn kernels and rajma beans and boil.
Keep until the beans are tender, then remove, stir, and serve.
Boil macaroni in plenty of water with a little salt added for 4 whistles in a cooker.
Heat ghee in a vessel, sauté maida (all-purpose flour), and slowly stream in milk to make a white sauce-like consistency.
Now add salt, pepper powder, and sugar to it.
Once the cooker cools down, immediately remove the macaroni and wash it with cold water.
Add the macaroni to the freshly prepared white sauce.
Then add chopped pieces of capsicum and bring to a boil.
764.note: If you want to make vegetable macaroni, boil and add french beans, carrots, and peas.

ing: White black pepper – a small pinch
steps: Fry the corn tortillas in olive oil on medium heat.
Until they turn light golden color and become crispy.
Then add ginger and chilli to it and cook for 2 minutes.
Now add half of the corn kernels, add all other ingredients except cheese and coriander.
Now let it cook for five minutes.
Then take it off the gas. Now blend it with a blender so that it looks like a puree.
Now put the soup back on the gas on low heat and add the remaining corn kernels.
Heat on the gas for a while.
Now remove the soup from the gas and serve in a bowl.
Garnish it on top with chopped fresh coriander leaves and cheese.
Boil the broccoli for 2 minutes.
Peel all the almonds, cut them into thin long slices and roast them on a griddle on low heat until brown.
Heat butter in a pan, add maida (all-purpose flour) to it, stir and roast, and once maida (all-purpose flour) is roasted, add milk.
Put boiled broccoli and some roasted almonds in a mixer and make a paste.
When the milk thickens, strain it through a large strainer.
Then add the broccoli paste to it and stir for 2 minutes and finally add salt and turn off the gas.
Soup is ready. Serve the soup in a bowl and put some almonds on top.
766.note: Even if you do not add all-purpose flour in this soup, the soup becomes thick.

steps: First, heat oil in a pan and add crushed ginger and chilli to it then sauté it.
Now add finely chopped vegetables like carrot, cabbage, capsicum and french beans.
Sauté it for 2 minutes.
Now add 4 cups of water, soy sauce, vinegar and chilli sauce to it.
Then add pepper powder, sugar and salt and boil for 3 minutes.
Now prepare corn flour slurry by mixing 2 teaspoons of corn flour in 1/4 cup of water and mix it well into the soup.
Boil until the soup becomes slightly thick.
First cut the drumstick into long pieces and divide them in half.
Take water in a bowl and cook the drumstick until it is boiled.
Strain when cool.
Extract the mawa (khoya) of the drumstick
Heat ghee, and cook ginger paste and drumstick mawa (khoya) in it
Then make it creamy and smooth with a blender
Now take drumstick mawa (khoya) and some water in a pan.
Then add cumin powder, salt and pepper powder.
Boil it for 5 minutes.
Add fresh coriander leaves to it and mix well.
Soak sabudana in plain water for 2 hours.
First take corn flour and rice flour, sieve it and fill it in a vessel.
Now take water measured by the same vessel. (Take double the water of the flour measure)
Put water to boil then add salt, coarsely crushed ajwain (carom seeds), cumin, green chillies and sabudana.
When it boils for about five minutes, add papad khara.
Before adding the flour, boil the water on full flame for 10-15 minutes.
After the water boils, slowly add both the mixed flours to it, and stir with the help of a rolling pin, take special care that no lumps of flour remain, mix it nicely.
Now this flour has to be steamed again. Make large balls like muthia (keep applying water to hands so that the flour does not stick to hands and does not feel hot)
Put water to heat in a steamer and when steam starts coming out from it, steam the prepared balls in it on full flame for 10-15 minutes.
Now take the steamed balls on a thick plastic bag and knead by adding some oil for 4-5 minutes.
Make small dough balls like roti dough from the kneaded dough and keep them covered so that they do not get cold.
Put plastic on both sides in the papad machine and place the dough ball in the middle and press.
Dry the papads on a cotton cloth in medium heat for 1 day and low heat for 2 days.
In about two days the papads will dry and become ready for frying or roasting.

ing: water – double the quantity of the flour
steps: Soak the sago in plain water for 2 hours.
First, take the rice flour, sieve it, and put it in a vessel.
Now measure the water using the same vessel (take double the amount of water compared to the flour measurement).
Put the water to boil, then add salt, coarsely crushed ajwain (carom seeds), cumin seeds, green chillies, and sago.
Boil for about five minutes, then add the papad khar.
Before adding the flour, boil the water on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
After the water boils, gradually add the rice flour while stirring with a rolling pin (or wooden spatula), taking special care that no lumps of flour remain, and mix it very well.
Now this dough needs to be steamed again. Make large muthia-like balls (keep dipping your hands in water so the dough doesn't stick to your hands and doesn't feel hot).
Put water to heat in a steamer (dhokliyu), and once steam starts coming out, steam the prepared balls in it on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
Now take the steamed balls onto a thick plastic bag, add a little oil, and knead for 4-5 minutes.
From the kneaded dough, make small dough balls the size of roti dough balls and keep them covered so they do not cool down.
Place plastic on both sides in the papad machine, put the dough ball in the middle, and press it.
Dry the papads on a cotton cloth in medium sunlight for 1 day and low sunlight for 2 days.
In about two days, the papads will be dry and ready to be fried or roasted.

ing: water – double the quantity of the flour
steps: First, take the wheat flour, sieve it, and put it in a vessel.
Now measure the water using the same vessel (take double the amount of water compared to the flour measurement).
Put the water to boil and add salt, coarsely crushed ajwain (carom seeds), cumin seeds, and green chillies to it.
Boil for about five minutes, then add the papadiyo khar.
Before adding the flour, boil the water on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
After the water boils, gradually add the wheat flour while stirring with a rolling pin, taking special care that no lumps of flour remain, and mix it very well.
Now this dough needs to be steamed again. Make large muthia-like balls (keep dipping your hands in water so the dough doesn't stick to your hands and doesn't feel hot).
Put water to heat in a steamer, and once steam starts coming out, steam the prepared balls in it on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
Now take the steamed balls onto a thick plastic bag, add a little oil, and knead for 4-5 minutes.
From the kneaded dough, make small dough balls the size of roti dough balls and keep them covered so they do not cool down.
Apply oil to the plastic on both sides in the papad machine, put the dough ball in the middle, and press it.
Dry the papads on a cotton cloth in medium sunlight for 1 day and low sunlight for 2 days. In about two days, the papads will be dry and ready to be fried or roasted.

ing: urad dal flour – 1 ½ cups (200 grams)
moong dal flour – less than 1/2 cup (50 grams)
steps: Crush the black pepper coarsely, put it in half a cup of water, and soak it for 15 to 20 minutes. Add papadiyo khar to this water and mix well. To make the dough:
Take urad dal flour in a large bowl. Add moong dal flour, salt, and 2 teaspoons of oil to it and mix well.
After this, by adding the black pepper water little by little, prepare a stiff dough.
Cover the dough and keep it for half an hour; the dough will set and be ready.
After the dough is set, apply a little oil to your hands and knead it to make the dough soft.
It takes about half an hour to mash the dough. To make dough portions:
When the dough becomes soft, prepare two pieces of dough. Then take one piece of dough, elongate it with your hands, and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
Take these pieces in a large bowl and keep them covered so they do not dry out.
Similarly, make dough balls from the remaining dough. To roll the papads:
Apply oil on the rolling board, place a dough ball, and roll it out.
Then gently pick it up and place it on a cloth.
Roll out and prepare all the papads this way. About 20 papads will be prepared. To dry the papads:

To dry the papads in the shade, dry them under a fan for 1 hour, flip them, and then dry the other side. After keeping them for 2-3 hours, the next day dry them in the sunlight for 1 hour and store them in a container.
Then you can enjoy the papads by frying or roasting them.
772.note: You can also make papads using only urad dal flour.

steps: First, fry the urad papads.
Now arrange finely chopped tomatoes and capsicum on top of them, and squeeze lemon juice over it.
Now garnish with sev and fresh coriander leaves on top and serve.

ing: water – double the quantity of the flour
steps: First, take the jowar flour and rice flour, sieve them, and put them in a vessel.
Now measure the water using the same vessel (take double the amount of water compared to the flour measurement).
Put the water to boil and add salt, coarsely crushed ajwain (carom seeds), cumin seeds, green chillies, and sago to it.
Boil for about five minutes, then add the papadiyo khar.
Before adding the flour, boil the water on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
After the water boils, gradually add both the mixed flours while stirring with a rolling pin, taking special care that no lumps of flour remain, and mix it very well.
Now this dough needs to be steamed again. Make large muthia-like balls (keep dipping your hands in water so the dough doesn't stick to your hands and doesn't feel hot).
Put water to heat in a steamer, and once steam starts coming out, steam the prepared balls in it on high heat for 10-15 minutes.
Now take the steamed balls onto a thick plastic bag, add a little oil, and knead for 4-5 minutes.
From the kneaded dough, make small dough balls the size of roti dough balls and keep them covered so they do not cool down.
Apply oil to the plastic on both sides in the papad machine, put the dough ball in the middle, and press it.
Dry the papads on a cotton cloth in medium sunlight for 1 day and low sunlight for 2 days.
In about two days, the papads will be dry and ready to be fried or roasted.
First, put water to heat in a vessel; once it comes to a boil, add salt and kharo.
Gradually keep adding the flour while stirring with a wooden spatula.
Stir very well so there are no lumps in the flour.
Add enough oil so that the flour does not stick to the vessel.
Then make farfar using a sev maker onto a cloth or plastic sheet and dry it in the sun for one day.
Store the farfar in an airtight container.
Fry in oil before using.
776.note: Apply oil to the sev maker before making farfar so that the flour does not stick to the maker and wafers can be made easily.

steps: First take set ghee. If the ghee is thin, place it in the refrigerator to let it thicken.
Add powdered sugar and vanilla essence to it.
Then whisk for two minutes or until mixed well.
In a sieve, mix maida (all-purpose flour), cashew powder, cashews, custard powder, baking powder, and salt, and sift well.
Mix the flour using a spoon.
Then prepare the dough without applying too much pressure.
Make small balls from the prepared dough and gently shape them into curved biscuits.
Now let them cook in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 10 to 12 minutes.
Combine saffron and warm milk in a small bowl and mix well. Keep aside.
In a bowl, mix ghee and sugar until creamy.
Add the saffron-milk mixture and cardamom powder, and mix very well using a spoon.
Add the flour and milk to it and make a soft dough.
Divide the dough into 2 equal parts.
Take one part of the dough and roll it out.
Evenly sprinkle some pistachios, saffron strands, and almonds on top, and roll it again lightly so that the almonds stick well to the dough.
Using a sharp knife or cookie cutter, cut into equal square pieces, arrange them on a baking tray, and let them cook in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.

ing: for cooker baking – 1 ½ cups salt / sand
steps: First take the butter and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Whisk for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift wheat flour / maida (all-purpose flour), cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add the milk and chocolate essence, and then knead until this mixture is mixed well.
The cookie dough is ready, now place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Prepare small, slightly flat round shapes like cookies.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Arrange the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let them bake on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, or alternatively bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
779.note: When using a cooker, remove the cooker whistle and gasket. For garnishing, marks can be made on the prepared balls by pressing with a fork.

ing: for cooker baking: 1 ½ cups salt / sand
steps: First take the butter and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Whisk for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift wheat flour / maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add grated coconut.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add the milk and vanilla essence, and then knead until this mixture is mixed well.
The cookie dough is ready, now place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Prepare small, slightly flat round shapes like cookies.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Arrange the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let them bake on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, or alternatively bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
First, take the mixture of butter and sugar in a large bowl.
Whisk for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the walnut pieces.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and mix. Additionally, add the milk and vanilla essence.
Then knead this mixture until well combined. The cookie dough is ready, now place it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Prepare small, slightly flat and round balls in cookie shapes.
To stick walnut pieces on top of them, add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes, arranging the biscuits on a plate leaving some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
Or alternatively, bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
781.note: When using a cooker, remove the whistle and gasket (ring) of the cooker.

steps: First roast the peanuts for 10 minutes and remove their outer skins.
Keep 15 half-pieces of peanuts aside.
Now coarsely grind the roasted peanuts in a mixer.
Now add powdered sugar, peanut powder, flour, peanut oil, and salt in a bowl.
Mix it well with your hands. Now prepare small balls from it.
Press a peanut half onto each ball.
Then warm the milk slightly and apply it to the prepared balls.
Preheat the oven at 150 degrees for 20 minutes.
Now bake the biscuits in it for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Then let them cool completely, afterwards store them in an airtight container.
782.note: These biscuits can stay good in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

steps: Take soft butter in a bowl and whisk for one minute.
Now add sugar to the butter and mix.
Whisk until the mixture turns creamy white.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour) and salt.
Now add it to the sugar and butter mixture and mix using a spoon.
Now mix the flour without applying too much pressure and make a dough.
Now take a small lump of dough and make it flat and slightly even.
Now arrange them on a tray. Bake at 180 degrees Celsius temperature for 12-15 minutes.
Take butter, sugar, and honey in a bowl and mix until creamy.
Add flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, salt, and mix well.
Drop a few drops of milk and incorporate into the flour. Roll the prepared dough 2cm thick in a plastic sheet.
Cut rectangular strips like Bourbon biscuits. Place butter paper on a baking tray and arrange them in lines.
Make holes using a fork, sprinkle sugar on the biscuits.
Bake in a 190 degree preheated oven for 9 to 12 minutes.
Now for making cream, take all ingredients in a blender and blend until creamy.
Now apply cream on one side of a biscuit, place another biscuit on top of it, and keep in the fridge for a while.

ing: Sliced or whole almonds for garnish
steps: Whip the butter with a hand mixer until creamy.
Add sugar to the above mixture and whip again until smooth.
Slowly keep adding maida (all-purpose flour), almond flour, and cardamom to the above mixture.
Keep the mixer running until the dough comes together.
Make one or two large lumps from the dough, press them slightly with your palm to flatten them, wrap in plastic and keep in the freezer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Take the dough lumps out from the freezer, dust a flat surface with a little maida (all-purpose flour), and roll out flatbreads of 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut biscuits in various shapes using a cookie cutter.
Line a baking plate with wax paper and arrange the cut biscuits separately on it.
Put decoration almonds on them. Bake in the oven at 180 degrees for 20–22 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and let them cool on the same plate for 5 minutes. Then transfer to another plate.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
Grease a baking tray with a little ghee and keep it ready.
In a bowl, mix butter and sugar and whisk until completely smooth and fluffy.
Now gradually add the flour and custard powder while stirring.
Then make equal small balls of the prepared mixture and arrange them on the baking tray keeping some space between them.
Now gently press them down with the help of a fork.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes and check with a toothpick.
Now take the biscuits out and let them cool.
Meanwhile, to prepare the cream, mix butter and sugar and whisk it.
Now take one biscuit, apply cream on it, and place another biscuit on top.
Prepare all the cream biscuits in this way.

ing: wheat flour or maida (all-purpose flour) flour – 200 grams
steps: First, take butter in a bowl. Then whip the butter until it becomes white and creamy.
Now sift wheat flour or maida (all-purpose flour) flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda using a sifter.
Sift the flour making sure there are no lumps.
Now add 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds to it and mix well.
Prepare a stiff mixture.
Add 3 teaspoons of milk and start kneading the dough.
After the dough is mixed well, shape it into an oval dough log.
Wrap it in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Cut thick biscuit-shaped pieces and place them on a tray for baking. Sprinkle a little cumin seeds on top and gently press.
Bake in a 180 degree preheated oven for 15 minutes.
First of all, mix butter and whipping cream in a large bowl.
Now add maida (all-purpose flour) to it and prepare the dough.
Let the prepared dough rest for 15 minutes.
Then roll the dough into a thin sheet.
Cut it into square or round shapes using a cutter or knife.
Then arrange them on a baking tray and make holes using a fork.
Bake the biscuits for 7-8 minutes in a preheated oven at 180 degrees, but do not let them turn brown.
788.note: Place the biscuits close to each other while baking.

ing: for cooker baking – 1 ½ cups salt/sand
steps: First of all, mix butter and sugar in a large bowl.
Stir for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift wheat flour/maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add finely chopped almonds, pistachios, cashews, dates, and raisins.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add milk and vanilla essence. And then knead until this mixture is well combined.
The cookie dough is ready, now put it in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round biscuits the size of a small ball.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the biscuits on a plate leaving some space between two biscuits.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Alternatively, bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
789.note: When using a cooker, remove the whistle and ring of the cooker. For garnishing, chopped almonds, pistachios, cashews, dates, and raisins can be placed on the prepared balls before cooking and baked.

ing: plain flour for rolling (maida (all-purpose flour)) – as required
steps: Combine saffron and warm milk in a small bowl, mix well, and keep aside.
Mix ghee and sugar in a bowl until well creamed.
Add the saffron-milk mixture, cardamom powder, and nutmeg powder and mix very well.
Mix finely chopped almonds and pistachios into it.
Add plain flour/maida (all-purpose flour) and milk and knead a soft dough.
Divide the dough into 2 equal parts.
Roll out one portion of the dough to about 125 mm size on a platform using plain flour.
Evenly sprinkle some pistachios, saffron strands, and almonds on top of it.
Then roll gently again so that the almonds stick well into the dough.
Cut 25mm square pieces using a sharp knife or cookie cutter.
Let it cook in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.
790.note: If the dough is put in the fridge for 30 minutes after kneading, the biscuits hold their shape evenly.

steps: In a bowl, mix butter, sugar, vanilla essence, and brown sugar well until creamy.
Mix maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon powder, and sieve well.
Now add this mixture to the butter mixture to prepare the dough.
Then add the oats and sweet chocolate chips to it and knead the dough properly.
Now prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls the size of a small ball.
Now garnish the top of those balls with oats and chocolate chips and arrange them on a butter-greased baking tray.
Let them cook in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 8 to 10 minutes. Then check.
If the biscuits are not ready properly, let them bake again for another 5 minutes.
Mix maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and cashew pieces.
Now mix butter and sugar until soft and white.
Ensure that no lumps remain.
Now add vanilla essence and honey to it and mix well.
Then add the dry mixture containing maida (all-purpose flour) to the butter mixture.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for at least 15 minutes.
Prepare small, slightly flat balls, place them on a baking tray, and let them bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
792.note: Always use room temperature butter while baking. If you are not using a non-stick baking tray, you should put butter paper in the baking tray or grease the tray, dust it with flour, and arrange the cookies.

ing: wheat flour or maida (all-purpose flour) flour – 160 grams
for cooker baking – 1 ½ cups salt or sand
steps: First of all, take the butter and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Then stir the mixture until it becomes creamy.
Now sieve wheat flour or maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Then add grated coconut to it.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add milk and vanilla essence, and then knead this mixture until well combined.
The dough for the cookie is ready, now place it in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls the size of a small ball.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the cookie dough balls on a plate with some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
793.note: While using a cooker, remove the cooker whistle and gasket. For garnish, grated coconut can be placed on the prepared balls before cooking and then baked.

steps: Mix maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, and oats.
Now mix butter and sugar until soft and white. Ensure that no lumps remain.
Now add vanilla essence and honey to it and mix well.
Then add the dry ingredient mixture containing maida (all-purpose flour) to the butter mixture.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for at least 15 minutes.
Prepare small, slightly flat balls and then garnish them with oats.
Place them on a baking tray and let them bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
Honey oats cookies are ready.
794.note: Always use room temperature butter while baking. If you are not using a non-stick baking tray, you should put butter paper in the baking tray or grease the tray, dust it with flour, and arrange the biscuits.

steps: Mix baking powder, baking soda, sugar, salt, amaranth flour, and peanut powder together.
Add ghee, mixed chopped dry fruits, cardamom powder, and vanilla essence to the flour. Combine well.
Add curd to it, mix well, and knead a soft dough. Keep it in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes.
Take out the dough from the fridge and cut thick pieces in long rectangular cookie shapes.
Place the cookies on a baking tray.
Bake the cookies in the preheated oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
Place peanut pieces 10 minutes before baking so that the peanuts stick well to the cookies.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Grease a baking tray with oil.
Mix all the dry ingredients well.
Take butter and both types of sugar in a bowl and whisk until completely smooth.
Add vanilla essence, milk, and the dry ingredients to the whisked butter to make a dough, and mix in the chocolate chips as well.
Shape into one-inch balls and arrange them on the baking tray with space in between.
Place the baking tray in the freezer for 30 minutes. Remove from the freezer and place the tray in the preheated oven.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden brown from the bottom, then remove.
After 5 minutes, remove the cookies from the tray and let them cool completely. Then serve with cold milk.
796.note: Leaving the cookies on the baking tray after removing them from the oven will make them too hard or burn them. If the cookies puff up completely and then flatten down entirely, reduce the amount of butter and sugar in them.

steps: Take 100 grams of ghee in a bowl.
Then combine powdered sugar, brown sugar, cocoa powder, vanilla essence, baking powder, salt, and maida.
Then add milk and chocolate chips, and bring everything together.
Now take a baking tray and apply ghee on top of it.
After that, shape the mixture into small balls and place them loosely apart on the baking tray.
Set the oven to preheat at 130 C (266 F), and place the prepared baking tray to bake for 12 to 15 minutes.
After baking, let it cool for 5 minutes.
Now the chocolate cookies are ready.

ing: cinnamon powder and cardamom – as needed
steps: Coarsely crush all the aforementioned dry fruits (cashews, almonds, pistachios) into slightly larger pieces.
Lightly roast the oats on medium heat for just a short while, only until the raw moisture is removed.
Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F).
Prepare a 25 cm x 40 cm baking sheet by applying oil.
If you have this size, any square or rectangular baking pan can be prepared.
Now, in a large bowl, mix oats, grated dry coconut, dry fruits, sesame seeds, dates or raisins, and add cinnamon powder and cardamom to taste.
In another bowl, add tahini or peanut butter and honey or maple syrup, and warm it up slightly (in the microwave or on full flame for about 1 min).
Now add vanilla essence and mix well, then add the oats and dry fruit mixture into it.
Now stir and mix everything together.
Pour this mixture into the prepared baking pan and spread it out nicely.
If you took a large pan, spread the mixture only in the area required to make the desired number of pieces, so that the bars do not become too large or overly thick.
Now, if the oven has heated to 175°C (350°F), place the baking pan in the oven.
Leave the pan in the oven for 20 minutes or until the side edges turn a golden brown color.
Do not let them get too brown; now take the pan out.
The mixture will still feel a bit soft from the center but will become firm after cooling.
Allow the mixture to cool down and cut it into 1″x 4″ sizes.
798.note: If you like slightly harder bars, shape or cut the mixture by hand into your desired shape before putting it in the oven, and then bake in the oven on both sides for 15 minutes.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee/butter and the sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Whisk slowly with a beater for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, semolina (rava), baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt, and prepare the mixture.
Add the flour mixture into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Then add milk and knead this mixture until it is properly combined.
Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare small ball-sized, slightly flat and depressed rounds.
Stick sliced cashews, pistachios, and almonds on top.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the biscuit dough balls on a plate with some space in between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
Alternatively, bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
799.note: When using a cooker, remove the whistle and gasket ring of the cooker.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee / butter and the sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Whisk slowly with a beater for 2 minutes or until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, rava, baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt, and prepare the mixture.
Add the flour mixture into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Then add milk to it and knead this mixture until it is properly combined.
Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare small ball-sized, slightly flat and depressed rounds.
Stick sliced cashews, pistachios, and almonds on top.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the biscuit dough balls on a plate with some space in between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
Alternatively, bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
800.note: When using a cooker, remove the whistle and gasket ring of the cooker.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee or butter, vanilla essence, and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Slowly whisk using a beater until the vanilla essence mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, rava, baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add milk and then knead until this mixture is mixed well.
Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls of the size of a small ball.
Stick sliced cashews, pistachios, and almonds on top of them.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the dough balls for the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
801.note: While using the cooker, remove the whistle and rubber gasket of the cooker. Fine wheat flour can also be used instead of maida.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee or butter, orange essence, and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Slowly whisk using a beater until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, rava, baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add milk and then knead until this mixture is mixed well. Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls of the size of a small ball.
Stick dry orange pieces on top of them.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the dough balls for the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
802.note: While using the cooker, remove the whistle and rubber gasket of the cooker. Fine wheat flour can also be used instead of maida.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee or butter, pineapple essence, and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Slowly whisk using a beater until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, semolina (rava), baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally add milk and then knead until this mixture is mixed well. Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls of the size of a small ball.
Stick dry pineapple pieces on top of them.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the dough balls for the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
803.note: While using the cooker, remove the whistle and rubber gasket of the cooker. Fine wheat flour can also be used instead of maida.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee or butter, chocolate essence, and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Slowly whisk using a beater until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, rava, baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally, add milk then knead until this mixture is mixed well. Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls of the size of a small ball.
Stick choco chip pieces on top of them.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the dough balls for the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
804.note: While using the cooker, remove the whistle and rubber gasket of the cooker. Fine wheat flour can also be used instead of maida.

ing: salt / sand – 2 cups for cooking in a cooker
steps: First, take chilled ghee or butter and sugar mixture in a large bowl.
Slowly whisk using a beater until the mixture becomes creamy.
Now sift maida (all-purpose flour), besan flour, semolina (rava), pista powder, baking powder, cardamom powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the flour into the butter and sugar mixture and stir.
Additionally add milk and then knead until this mixture is mixed well. Prepare a soft dough.
Prepare slightly flat and flattened round balls of the size of a small ball.
Stick pista slices on top of them.
Add salt or sand inside the cooker and preheat for 10 minutes.
Place the dough balls for the biscuits on a plate keeping some space between them.
Cover the cooker lid and let it bake on medium-low flame for 15 minutes.
Or bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees temperature for 15 minutes.
805.note: While using the cooker, remove the whistle and rubber gasket of the cooker. Fine wheat flour can also be used instead of maida.

steps: Soak the cashews in hot water for two minutes and remove them.
Then spread them on a cloth and pat them dry.
After drying the cashews, grind them finely.
Add powdered sugar and cardamom powder to the ground cashews and mix well.
Now add saffron strands to water.
Prepare a stiff dough like bhakri from the prepared cashew mixture using the saffron water.
Now make small, thick puris from it.
Now preheat the oven to 180°c.
Now bake the puris made in the preheated oven until they turn brown.
Serve after cooling.
806.note: A little ghee can also be used while kneading the dough.

steps: Soak the almonds in hot water for two minutes and remove them.
Then spread them on a cloth and pat them dry.
After drying the almonds, peel them and grind them finely.
Add powdered sugar and cardamom powder to the ground almonds and mix well.
Now add saffron strands to water.
Prepare a stiff dough like bhakri from the prepared almond mixture using the saffron water.
Now make small, thick puris from it.
Now preheat the oven to 180°c.
Now bake the puris made in the preheated oven until they turn brown.
Serve after cooling.
807.note: A little ghee can also be used while kneading the dough.

steps: Soak the cashews in hot water for two minutes and remove them.
Then spread them on a cloth and pat them dry.
Now grind the cashews and pistachios finely.
Add powdered sugar and cardamom powder to the ground cashews and pistachios and mix well.
Now add saffron strands to water.
Prepare a stiff dough like bhakri from the prepared cashew-pistachio mixture using the saffron water.
Now make small, thick puris from it.
Now preheat the oven to 180°c.
Now bake the puris made in the preheated oven until they turn brown.
Serve after cooling.
808.note: A little ghee can also be used while kneading the dough.

steps: First of all, set the oven to pre-heat at 200 degrees.
In a vessel, add baking powder, salt, and baking soda to maida (all-purpose flour), and sift the maida (all-purpose flour) 2-3 times using a sieve.
Now apply a little ghee in the cake mold, dust with flour, spread it, shake off the excess flour, and keep the mold aside.
Now in another vessel, mix butter, powdered sugar, and lemon juice, and whisk until very light.
After the sugar dissolves properly, add milk, vanilla essence, yellow color, and condensed milk, and whisk again for some time.
Then gradually keep adding maida (all-purpose flour) and keep stirring the mixture.
Then add mango pulp and mix well.
Next, quickly whisk the batter in one direction only for 8-10 minutes.
Now pour the batter into the cake mold, put mango pieces on top, and level it by tapping so that there are no bubbles in the batter.
Then place the cake mold in the pre-heated oven in convection mode for 25-30 minutes.
After the time is over, take out the cake, take a toothpick or a knife, and check by inserting it into the center of the cake.
If it comes out clean, it means the cake is ready.
If the cake seems uncooked, put it back in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Once the cake cools down a bit, take it out, let it cool slightly, and use it for eating.
809.note: Instead of ready-made mango pulp, grated Kesar mango pulp can also be taken. Increase or decrease the measurement of sugar according to the taste of the mango.

steps: Set the oven to pre-heat at 180-200 degrees.
In a bowl, mix maida (all-purpose flour), cocoa powder, chocolate powder, baking powder, salt, and baking soda, and sift the maida (all-purpose flour) 2-3 times using a sieve.
Now in another bowl, mix butter, powdered sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla essence, and whisk well for 5-7 minutes.
After the sugar dissolves properly, add a little milk and condensed milk, and mix.
Then slowly add maida (all-purpose flour) and mix.
If the batter becomes thick, add a little milk again to make a thin batter as required.
Then stir the batter quickly in one direction for 5-7 minutes.
Now apply a little oil in the cake mold, dust with flour, spread it, and shake off the excess flour.
Now pour the prepared batter into the mold and level it by tapping so that there are no bubbles in the batter.
Then place the cake in the pre-heated oven and keep it in convection mode for 25-30 minutes.
After the time is over, take out the cake and check by inserting a toothpick.
If the cake seems uncooked, put it back in the oven on convection for 5-7 minutes.
Once the cake cools down a little, take it out, cover it, and let it stay for an hour.
After the cake cools down a bit, place it in the fridge for an hour. Method of icing:
Add powdered sugar to the cream and mix it well to whip it.
Stir until it becomes completely thick.
Cool the cake in the fridge for an hour before doing icing on it.
Then divide the prepared icing into two parts.
Melt the chocolate.
Add vanilla essence to one part and mix, and add the melted chocolate to the second part and mix well.
Now place the cake on a plate, and do icing with chocolate cream on top and around it.
Then decorate it with white cream.
Once the cake is ready, place it in the fridge, let it cool slightly, and serve.
810.note: Instead of dark chocolate for icing, cream with your favorite flavor can also be taken. If you want to take milk powder instead of condensed milk, mix it into the dry maida.

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 to 200 degrees.
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in a bowl, add baking powder, salt, and baking soda to it, and sift the maida (all-purpose flour) 2-3 times using a sifter.
Now, grease the cake mold with oil, dust it with flour, and keep the mold aside.
Now, in another bowl, mix butter and powdered sugar, and whip until very light.
Once the sugar is dissolved properly, add condensed milk and pineapple essence to it, and whip again for a short while.
Then, gradually add maida (all-purpose flour) to it while stirring the mixture.
Next, add pineapple pulp and water / milk as needed, and mix well.
After that, quickly whip the batter in a single direction for 8-10 minutes.
Now, spread golden syrup at the bottom of the cake mold.
Then arrange pineapple slices on top of it, placing a cherry in the middle.
Afterwards, pour the batter into it, tap lightly, and level it.
Then place the cake mold in the preheated oven on convection mode for 30-35 minutes.
When the time is up, take the cake out, take a toothpick or a knife, insert it into the center of the cake, and check.
If it comes out clean, it means the cake is ready.
Once the cake cools down a bit, unmold it onto a plate, cut it into pieces, and serve.
811.note: Honey can also be used instead of golden syrup.
