steps: Preheat the oven to 180 to 200 degrees.
In a bowl, add baking powder, salt, and edible soda to maida (all-purpose flour), and sift the maida (all-purpose flour) 2-3 times using a sifter.
Now, apply a little ghee to the vessel intended for making the cake, dust it with flour, spread it around, shake off the excess flour, and keep the vessel aside.
Now, in another bowl, mix butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla essence, and whip until very light.
Once the sugar dissolves properly, add milk and condensed milk to it, and whip again for a short while.
Then, gradually add maida (all-purpose flour) to it while stirring the mixture.
Once all the maida (all-purpose flour) is mixed, add grated carrot and apple, and mix well.
Then quickly whip in a single direction for 8-10 minutes.
Now, pour the prepared batter into the cake mold, tap lightly, and level it evenly.
Then place the cake mold in the preheated oven on convection mode for 25-30 minutes.
When the time is up, take the cake out, take a toothpick or a knife, insert it into the center of the cake, and check.
If it comes out clean, it means the cake is ready.
If the cake feels uncooked, put it back in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Once the cake cools down a bit, take it out, cover it, and let it rest for an hour or so.
812.note: This cake tastes very good without any icing.

steps: First of all, blend strawberries in a food processor or blender to make a puree.
You should have about 1/2 cup of puree.
Heat the puree in a pan on the gas over medium heat.
Let it heat on low flame, stirring continuously, until the mixture thickens and reduces to about 3/4 cup.
Now pour it into a large measuring cup and let it cool.
Preheat the oven to 176 degrees.
Now place wax paper at the bottom of the cake pan and spray oil on the sides of the pan.
Then in a large bowl, mix strawberry puree, sour cream, milk, and vanilla essence thoroughly.
Now separate 1 cup of this mixture into another bowl.
The other 1 ½ cups should remain in the other bowl.
Now combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add butter one spoonful at a time and start the mixer on the lowest speed. Let the mixture mix well before adding the second spoonful of butter.
Now add the 1-1/2 cup strawberry mixture first and mix on low speed.
Increase the mixer speed from low to medium until everything comes together and mix for 1 minute.
Now add the remaining 1 cup of strawberry mixture.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl, add pink food color, and mix with the blender on fast or medium speed for about 10–15 seconds.
Now divide the batter into 3 separate pans and place in the oven for 24–26 minutes, or check by inserting a toothpick.
Now take the cake out of the oven and let it cool. Method to make frosting:
First add freeze-dried strawberries to the food processor and grind.
In a large bowl, mix cream cheese and butter together thoroughly.
Gradually add powdered sugar and half of the vanilla essence, and mix well.
Gradually add the remaining powdered sugar and strawberry powder, and mix until smooth.
Add a little salt for taste.
Level the dome-shaped top of the cake with a large knife.
Now place 1 cake on the plate or cardboard base where you want to decorate the cake.
Add about 1 cup of cake frosting on top and spread evenly.
Then scatter half of the chopped strawberries and press them into the frosting.
Place the second cake on top, spread another cup of frosting, and add the remaining chopped strawberries.
Place the third cake on top of that and apply a nice layer of the remaining frosting on the top cake.
Now apply the remaining frosting to the sides of all three layers as well.
Add a few strawberries on top for decoration and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

ing: cooking oil (odorless, Safola oil works) – 1/2 cup
sugar syrup – 50 grams sugar + 100 ml water
steps: Cake:
Sift together maida (all-purpose flour), baking soda, baking powder, cocoa powder, and sugar using a sifter in a bowl.
Mix everything nicely.
Take room temperature milk in a bowl, add lemon juice or vinegar to it, and keep it aside for 5 minutes.
Now take the sifted maida (all-purpose flour) mixture in a large bowl, add cooking oil, and stir well.
Then add the prepared milk mixture and stir uniformly so that not a single lump of dry flour remains.
Take a 7-inch cake mold, prepare it by greasing with oil and dusting with flour.
Pour the prepared cake mixture into the cake pan and tap lightly to level it.
Preheat the oven beforehand at 180 degrees for 10 minutes.
Place the prepared cake mixture in the preheated oven at 180 degrees for 25-30 minutes, checking once at 20 minutes.
Check by inserting a toothpick or knife; if it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
Otherwise, let it bake for another 5-10 minutes. For decoration:
Take whipped cream in a vessel and place the bowl containing whipped cream over another large bowl filled with ice cubes.
Then whip it using a beater machine first on medium and then gradually on high speed.
Once the cream thickens, understand that the cream is ready.
Next, cut the cooled cake horizontally in the middle into two parts and apply sugar syrup to them.
Then spread cream over that cake.
Afterwards, place the second part of the cake on top, apply sugar syrup to it as well, and apply cream again.
Then decorate with cream.
Different edible food colors can be added to the cream for cake decoration.
Apply grated chocolate to the sides of the cake.
Decorate again with cream, add cherries, and place the cake in the fridge for 20-30 minutes to set.
It can then be used.
Put the milk to boil in a large and heavy-bottomed pot.
Stir the milk continuously so that it does not stick to the bottom.
Boil the milk until it reduces to one-third of its quantity.
The boiled milk will reach the consistency of loose mawa (khoya).
After that, combine lemon juice and water, add it to the thickened milk, stir once, and then let it set.
Stir after approximately 2-3 minutes.
Then add sugar and keep stirring continuously until it becomes thick like mawa (khoya) without sticking.
Once it becomes thick like mawa (khoya), remove it from the gas and add cardamom powder.
Take a steel container, apply ghee inside it, transfer the prepared mawa (khoya) into it, and let it set at room temperature for 24 hours.
Run the edge of a knife along the inside of the container and invert the container to remove the set cake.
815.note: The milk cake can be garnished by placing pistachios on top.

ing: Sugar syrup - 50 grams sugar + 100 ml water
steps: For cake:
Break the biscuits into small pieces, put these pieces and sugar in a mixer jar and crush them into a fine, flour-like powder.
Preheat the cooker 10 minutes in advance by adding salt or sand to it. Remove the whistle and ring of the cooker and place a stand inside it.
Take the crushed biscuit powder in a vessel, add milk to it, and mix well using a beater.
Then add Eno to it and mix nicely again.
Prepare a cake mold by applying oil and dusting with flour, place butter paper in the middle of it, and pour the prepared cake mix into it.
Place the prepared cake mold in the cooker, close the cooker, and let it cook for 30 minutes.
In 30 minutes the cake will be cooked and ready. Check the cake with a knife; if the knife comes out clean, the cake is cooked nicely.
Let the cake cool for 30 minutes.
Prepare sugar syrup by adding a little water to 2 teaspoons of sugar. For decoration:
Take whipping cream in a vessel, take ice cubes in another large vessel, and place the bowl with whipping cream on top of it.
Then add chocolate powder to it and whip it using a beater machine, first at medium and then gradually at high speed.
When the cream becomes thick, understand that the cream is ready.
Then apply sugar syrup on the cooled cake, and then place the cream and spread it.
Then place the cake in the fridge to set for 20-30 minutes.
Then it can be used.
816.note: You can use biscuits of your choice. The biscuit powder should be completely fine like flour. Nuts of your choice can be added to the cake mixture. To make this cake in an oven, preheat the oven at 180 degrees for ten minutes. Then put it to bake for 35 minutes, check once after 25 minutes, and if needed, let it cook for another 10 minutes.

steps: Preheat the oven at 180 ◦C / 350 ◦F for 15 minutes.
Ready the cupcake pan.
Mix sugar and curd together until the sugar dissolves.
Then add oil and vanilla essence to it and mix well.
In another bowl, mix maida (all-purpose flour) flour, corn flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Then combine all of that and the curd mixture and mix.
Mix in such a way that there are no lumps inside.
If the batter feels a little thick, add water accordingly.
Do not make the batter too thin or thick, keep it medium.
Then pour it into the cupcake tray by placing cupcake paper liners (the ones that look like paper bowls), filling the batter up to one-third of the paper.
Then place it in the oven for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, take it out and check by inserting a toothpick or knife.
If flour does not stick to the toothpick or knife, your cupcake is ready.
Then top the cupcake with whipping cream as shown in the picture.

ing: Lemon juice - 1 pcs or vinegar – 1/2 spoon
steps: Take maida (all-purpose flour), baking soda, baking powder, cocoa powder, and sugar in a vessel, sift everything through a sifter, and mix everything nicely.
Take room temperature milk in a bowl, add lemon or vinegar to it, and keep it aside for 5 minutes.
Now take the sifted maida (all-purpose flour) mixture in a large bowl, add cooking oil to it, and stir well.
Then add the prepared milk mixture and stir uniformly so that not a single lump of dry flour remains.
Take a 7-inch square cake mold and prepare it by applying oil and dusting with flour.
Take the prepared cake mixture in the cake pan and tap it a little to make it even.
Preheat the oven in advance at 180 degrees for 10 minutes.
Place the prepared cake mixture in the oven at 180 degrees for 25-30 minutes, checking once at 20 minutes.
Check by inserting a toothpick or knife; if it comes out clean, consider it baked, otherwise let it cook for another 5-10 minutes.
After the cake is ready, prepare rectangular pieces of it, approximately 6 pcs will be made.
Take one piece, cut it from the middle, and apply sugar syrup on both parts.
Apply cream, apply sugar syrup on the other part, place it on top, and apply cream nicely again.
Garnish the very top with grated chocolate and cherry.
818.note: Pastry can also be garnished with readily available chocolate syrup.

steps: Method for crust:
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Crust ingredients – mix butter, sugar, and biscuit crumbs, and press and spread them into a round pan.
Now bake it at 180°C for 8 minutes. Method for filling:
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix cream cheese and sugar until completely smooth.
Now add milk, lemon juice, corn starch, vanilla essence, and salt to it and mix for 2-3 minutes.
Now spread this mixture on top of the crust in the pan.
Then bake it at 180°C for 40-45 minutes.
Remove from the pan and let it cool. The cheese cake is ready.
First wash the guavas, then chop them and boil them in half a cup of water, then let them cool.
Now make juice in a mixer, strain it through a strainer, and add water if felt necessary.
Now take the prepared juice in a large vessel.
Add curd, lemon juice, sugar, and ghee to it and mix.
Then add semolina (rava) to it and stir quickly.
Add maida (all-purpose flour), cocoa powder, powdered sugar, nutmeg powder, and baking soda to it, stir, and leave for 2 minutes.
Grease the cake tin with ghee or butter.
Add the prepared mixture to it.
Now bake in a pre-heated oven at 180C temperature for 30-35 minutes.
Then check by inserting a knife into the cake; if the mixture sticks to the knife, bake a little longer.
After it is ready, let it cool for a while, once cooled, cut it and enjoy it with milk.
820.note: It is extremely important to remove the guava seeds. Open the oven after 25 minutes and check if the mixture is baked. This cake can also be made in a cooker.

steps: Method for whip cream:
Mix heavy cream, sugar, vanilla extract, and finely grated lemon zest thoroughly in a mixer. Method for the cake:
Mix 3 spoons of sugar into the strawberries and place in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
In a bowl, combine maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, baking soda, remaining 2 spoons of sugar, and salt.
Add heavy cream and mix well until everything comes together.
Grease an 8-inch square pan with oil, place the mixture in it, and keep it in the oven until golden in color, for 18 to 20 minutes.
Now remove the cake from the oven and set it aside to cool slightly. Then cut it into six horizontal slices.
Now take the strawberries that were kept in the fridge, take them out, and spread them with their juice using a spoon over one cake slice.
Then spread whip cream over it. Similarly, spread strawberries and whip cream over all the cake slices.
And on the top slice, place a little whip cream, mound it slightly like a hill, and place strawberries on top. As shown in the picture
Combine maida (all-purpose flour) and salt in a bowl.
Add cold ghee to it and combine using a fork.
Gradually add cold water while gathering the dough. The dough should not be too soft or too hard.
Make small balls from this dough, cover them, and keep them in the fridge for 2 hours.
Peel the apples and cut them into long slices.
In a bowl, combine apples, sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon powder, nutmeg powder, and lemon juice, and keep it in the fridge for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 200 C (400 F).
Take the pie dough (small balls) from the fridge, divide each into two, and roll out rotlas 3 mm thick.
Then spread it over the pie dish and trim the excess from the edges.
Then spread the apple filling mixture over it.
Then roll out another rotla, spread it over the top, trim the excess from the edges, and seal the edges.
Then brush ghee over it and sprinkle sugar. Make small slits on top.
Bake in the oven for 20 to 30 minutes until it turns brown.
Afterwards, let it cool and serve with ice cream.
Now the apple pie is ready!
Boil the pumpkin and mash it.
Add nutmeg, cinnamon powder, sugar, and corn starch to the mashed pumpkin, mix well, and set aside.
Then take maida (all-purpose flour) in a bowl, add butter, a spoonful of sugar, and salt, and knead a dough.
Let the maida (all-purpose flour) dough rest for up to 2 hours.
Then preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
Knead the maida (all-purpose flour) dough well and roll it out like a large bhakhri.
Apply a little butter to the pan in which the pie is to be made, spread this bhakhri, and cover the entire pan.
Put the pan in the oven to bake for 5 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and spread the pumpkin mixture that was prepared over it.
Then put the whole pan back into the oven to bake.
Bake for 30 minutes until it turns golden brown.
After baking, leave it outside to cool. Cut into pieces only after it cools down.
Then offer it to Maharaj.
Take salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and milk powder in a cup, pour water into it, stir, and set aside.
Take wheat flour in another bowl, add yeast, pour the prepared mixture into it, knead a roti-like dough, and let it rest covered for an hour.
Then press the dough with your hands, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter, mix well using your hands, stretch the dough as much as it stretches, and then mix.
Then divide the dough into four equal parts, take one part, and press it with your fingers to flatten it like a pizza base.
Then press it with your hands and roll it back into a round roll.
Make all the remaining rolls in this way.
Then place butter paper on an oven tray and dust a little flour.
Then place the prepared dough rolls and let them rest covered with a piece of cloth for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes.
Then put the dough to bake for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, remove from the oven, cover with a cloth again, and let it cool.
After cooling, cut into equal pieces using a knife. It will make approximately 35 pcs.
Arrange all the toasts on the oven tray and keep them at 180 degrees for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, flip them over and bake for another 15 minutes.
Once they turn golden brown, they are ready.
Take salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and milk powder in a cup, pour water into it, stir, and set aside.
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in another bowl, and add yeast and cumin seeds.
Pour the prepared mixture into it, knead a roti-like dough, and let it rest covered for an hour.
Then press the dough with your hands, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter, and mix well using your hands. Stretch the dough as much as it stretches and then mix.
Then divide the dough into four equal parts, take one part, and press it with your fingers to flatten it like a pizza base.
Then press it with your hands and roll it back into a round roll.
Make all the remaining rolls in this way.
Then place butter paper on an oven tray, dust a little flour, and then place the prepared dough rolls.
Let them rest covered with a piece of cloth for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes and put them to bake for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, remove from the oven, cover with a cloth again, and let it cool.
After cooling, cut into equal pieces using a knife. It will make approximately 35 pcs.
Arrange all the toasts on the oven tray and keep them at 180 degrees for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, flip them over and bake for another 15 minutes.
Once they turn golden brown, the cumin toast is ready.
Take salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and milk powder in a cup, pour water into it, then stir it and keep it aside.
Put maida (all-purpose flour), yeast, and dried black grapes in another bowl.
Add the prepared mixture to it, knead a dough like roti, and let it cover and rest for one hour.
Then press that dough with your hands, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter to it, and mix well using your hands. Stretch the dough as much as it stretches and then mix it.
Then divide that dough into four equal parts, take one part, press it with your fingers, and flatten it like a pizza base.
Then press it with the help of your hands and roll it round again.
Make all the remaining rolls in this way.
Then place butter paper in the oven tray and sprinkle a little flour.
Then place the prepared dough, and let it rest covered with a piece of cloth for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes and put it to bake for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, take it out of the oven, cover it with cloth again, and let it cool.
After cooling, cut it into equal pieces with the help of a knife. It will make about 35 pcs.
Arrange all the toasts in the oven tray and keep them at 180 degrees for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, flip them again and bake for 15 minutes.
Once golden brown, the tutti frutti toast is ready.
Apply cheese spread on the tutti frutti toast and place chopped grapes, cherries, strawberries, etc.
Baking for 10 minutes will make the fruit toast ready.
Take salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and milk powder in a cup, pour water into it, then stir it and keep it aside.
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in another bowl, add yeast to it, add the prepared mixture to it, knead a dough like roti, and let it cover and rest for one hour.
Then press that dough with your hands, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter to it, and mix well using your hands. Stretch the dough as much as it stretches and then mix it.
Then divide that dough into four equal parts, take one part, press it with your fingers, and flatten it like a pizza base.
Then press it with the help of your hands and roll it round again.
Make all the remaining rolls in this way.
Then place butter paper in the oven tray and sprinkle a little flour.
Then place the prepared dough, and let it rest covered with a piece of cloth for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes and put it to bake for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, take it out of the oven, cover it with cloth again, and let it cool.
After cooling, cut it into equal pieces with the help of a knife. It will make about 35 pcs.
Arrange all the toasts in the oven tray and keep them at 180 degrees for 15 minutes; after 15 minutes, bake again for 15 minutes.
Once golden brown, it is ready.
Take 1/2 cup of warm water, dissolve sugar in it, add yeast, and place it in a warm place.
Then add flour, sugar, and oil, knead the dough with warm water, and keep it covered with a damp cloth.
Now press and knead the dough, then set it aside to rise again.
After it rises the second time, give it a bread-like shape and place it in the oven tray.
Now apply milk on top of it and put it in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes.
Afterwards, take it out and let it cool.
Once cooled, slice the bread into pieces about 1/4 inch thick.
Now keep it again in the oven at about 150°C until it turns light brown.
Enjoy the prepared rusk with milk.
Mix sugar and yeast in lukewarm milk and keep stirring until it froths.
Combine maida (all-purpose flour), salt, oil, mawa (khoya), and yeast milk to knead a soft and sticky dough.
Then add powdered sugar and melted butter to the prepared dough and knead.
Then cover the dough and keep it aside for 30 minutes until the yeast activates.
Now knead the risen dough, prepare long cylindrical dough balls, place them on a baking tray, cover with a cloth, and set aside for 20 minutes.
Now bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
Then, when the prepared bread cools down, cut it into 1-inch pieces and arrange them on a baking tray.
Now bake again on one side in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 10 minutes.
Then flip the toast and bake the other side for another 10 minutes.
Crunchy and soft mawa (khoya) toast is ready.
Take 2 big spoons of custard powder, 2 big spoons of bura (powdered sugar), cinnamon powder, and vanilla essence in a wide bowl.
Then slowly add 125 ml (1/2 cup) of milk to it.
Stir until everything dissolves in the milk.
Heat a griddle (tava) for 2 minutes, and once it is hot, apply about 1/2 spoon of salted butter on it.
Take a slice of bread, dip it in the prepared milk, and roast it in the spread butter. (Stir the milk every time before dipping the bread)
Roast the bread applying butter on both sides until golden brown.
835.note: If custard powder is not at home, cornstarch can also be used. Hot French toast can be served with maple syrup, cinnamon powder, and powdered sugar, or with chocolate spread and fruits like strawberries and bananas.

steps: Take salt, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and milk powder in a cup, pour water into it, stir well, and keep it aside.
Take maida (all-purpose flour) in another bowl and add yeast and tutti frutti to it.
Now add the prepared mixture to it, knead like roti dough, and let it rest covered for one hour.
Then press the dough with your hands, and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar and melted butter to it.
Mix well using your hands; the dough should be mixed such that it is stretchy.
Then divide the dough into four equal parts, take one part, press it with your fingers, and flatten it like a pizza base.
Then press it with your hands and roll it back into a round cylinder shape.
Make all the remaining ones in the same way.
Next, place butter paper in an oven tray, dust a little flour, place the prepared dough pieces on it, and let them rest covered with a piece of cloth for 20 minutes.
Now preheat the oven at 180C degrees for 10 minutes and place the tray to bake for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, take it out from the oven, cover it with a cloth again, and let it cool down.
After it cools down, cut it into equal pieces using a knife. It will make about 35 pcs.
Arrange all the toasts on the oven tray and keep them at 180C degrees for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, flip them over and bake for another 15 minutes.
Once golden brown, the tutti frutti toast is ready.

ing: basil chopped – for garnishing on top
steps: Mash the avocado to make a paste.
Then add lemon juice, salt, black pepper powder, and coriander to it and mix well.
Then spread it over the toasted bread.
Place tomato slices on top of it.
Then sprinkle some basil over it.
Then drizzle some olive oil on top.
Method for white sauce:
Put 150 ml of milk to heat in a pan. Add 1 clove to it.
Heat until it comes to a boil. Now turn off the gas and remove the clove from it.
Put butter in another pan and heat it. Add maida (all-purpose flour) to it and roast until it turns slightly pink.
Once the flour is roasted, add the heated milk to it and mix well.
Add salt, pepper, and oregano to taste, and stir on the gas until it thickens slightly. Then remove it from the gas. Method for chilli cheese toast:
Finely chop the capsicum and pickled chillies, add white sauce to them, and mix well.
Apply butter to both sides of all the bread slices and arrange them on an oven plate.
Spread the prepared mixture over them. Sprinkle cheese on top.
Add chilli flakes and oregano on top. A few extra pickled chillies can also be placed.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius and place the plate in it to bake for 10 minutes.
Cut the toast into a triangle shape from the middle and serve.
838.note: If an oven is not available, they can also be toasted in a covered non-stick pan.

steps: Roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Then neatly trim the edges from all four sides of the sheet.
Then cut it into khari shapes using a cutter.
Cut into 3 equal parts and slice half-inch wide strips.
Arrange those strips in a baking tray with some distance between them.
Now gently press whole cumin seeds onto them with light hands.
Preheat the oven at 250 degrees for 10 minutes in advance, and then bake the khari for 30 minutes.
Let the baked khari cool for one hour, then preheat the oven again at 100 degrees.
Bake the khari again at 100 degrees temperature for 20-25 minutes.
The khari will become crispy and golden brown on top. That means it is ready.

ing: salted butter for binding the dough – 15 grams
salted butter (to apply on the dough sheet) – 100 grams
steps: Mix salt and about 15 grams of salted butter into maida (all-purpose flour) and mix the dough well.
Then knead the dough using very cold water, adding water little by little.
Knead a dough that is harder than roti and softer than paratha.
Knead the dough well for 10 to 15 minutes, stretch the dough and bring it back together, keep kneading like this so the dough becomes very soft.
Make a dough ball and roll out a thin and even square roti from all sides. (Dry flour can be used to roll the roti)
Mash 30 to 35 grams of salted butter until smooth, then apply it evenly over the roti.
Now fold the roti: take one edge of the roti and bring it to the center, then take the other edge and place it over the first fold.
Keep it in the fridge for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, take it out from the fridge, apply salted butter again, and roll it out in the same way as above.
Keep it in the fridge for another 15 minutes and roll it out in the same way.
Now roll it out for the last time, take the first edge and put it in the center, and bring the other edge to the center as well, folding it like a book.
This will prepare a puff pastry dough.
Now, to roll out the khari, roll the dough sheet three times, and after rolling, roll it a little thicker on the fourth time.
Then neatly trim the edges from all four sides of the sheet. Then cut it into khari shapes using a cutter.
Cut into 3 equal parts and slice half-inch wide strips, arrange those strips in a baking tray with some distance between them.
Preheat the oven at 250 degrees for 10 minutes in advance, and then bake the khari for 30 minutes.
Let the baked khari cool for one hour, then preheat the oven again at 100 degrees.
Bake the khari again at 100 degrees temperature for 20-25 minutes.
The khari will become crispy and golden brown on top. That means it is ready.

ing: kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) – 1 tea spoon
steps: Roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Then sprinkle kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) over it, fold it again, and roll it out.
Then neatly cut the edges from all four sides of the sheet.
Then cut it into khari shapes using a cutter.
Cut into 3 equal parts and slice into half-inch wide strips.
Arrange the strips on a baking tray with small distances between them.
Preheat the oven at 250 degrees for 10 minutes beforehand, and then bake the khari for 30 minutes.
Let the baked khari cool for an hour, then preheat the oven again at 100 degrees.
Bake the khari again at 100 degrees temperature for 20-25 minutes.
The khari will become crispy and golden brown on top, meaning it is ready.
While making this khari, add all the spices to the maida (all-purpose flour) dough and prepare the puff sheet.
Now roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of half an inch.
Then sprinkle kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) over it, fold it again, and roll it out.
Then neatly cut the edges from all four sides of the sheet.
Then cut it into khari shapes using a cutter.
Cut into 3 equal parts and slice into half-inch wide strips.
Arrange the strips on a baking tray with small distances between them.
Preheat the oven at 250 degrees for 10 minutes beforehand, and then bake the khari for 30 minutes.
Let the baked khari cool for an hour, then preheat the oven again at 100 degrees.
Bake the khari again at 100 degrees temperature for 20-25 minutes.
The khari will become crispy and golden brown on top, meaning it is ready.
In a bowl, mix maida (all-purpose flour), 2 spoons of vegetable ghee, salt, and cheese.
Now gradually add water to prepare a somewhat stiff dough.
Roll out the prepared dough into a large, slightly thin square roti of even thickness.
Apply frozen vegetable ghee and dry maida (all-purpose flour) properly over the roti.
Now fold the roti in a book-fold style, making sure to apply ghee on each part as you fold.
Wrap the prepared dough in foil and keep it in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Take it out from the freezer and immediately roll out a large roti again, and repeat the above process.
Now roll this prepared dough slightly thick and cut small rectangular shapes using a knife or cutter and arrange them on a baking tray.
Preheat the oven at 250 degrees for 10 minutes beforehand, and then bake the khari for 15-20 minutes.
Let the baked khari cool for an hour, then preheat the oven again at 100 degrees.
Bake the khari again at 100 degrees temperature for 20-25 minutes.
Once the khari cools down, sprinkle cheese powder over it.
Crunchy and soft cheese khari is ready.

ing: Lemon yellow food color – 1/2 tea spoon
steps: Roll the puff pastry sheet into a square of half an inch thickness and cut the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone using an aluminum cone or four folds of newspaper, wrapping aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of a cone.
Prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Starting from the pointed end upwards, wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone, preparing all cones this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray and polish the top with melted butter.
Bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and after 10 minutes gently pull out the paper cones.
Prepare all the cones this way. Method of making cream:
Add powdered sugar to lukewarm milk and mix well with a spoon; once the sugar dissolves completely, add pineapple essence and yellow color and stir well to prepare sugar syrup in this way.
Keep this mixture in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Cut the butter into small pieces, take it in a glass bowl, and whip it with a whipping machine until smooth.
Then add one spoon of the prepared sugar syrup to it, keep whipping, add all the mixture little by little, and keep whipping.
Once the cream becomes properly fluffy (light), fill it in a plastic cone and fill it into the rolls.
Roll the puff pastry sheet into a square of half an inch thickness and cut the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone using an aluminum cone or four folds of newspaper, wrapping aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of a cone.
Prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Starting from the pointed end upwards, wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone, preparing all cones this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray and polish the top with melted butter.
Bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and after 10 minutes gently pull out the paper cones.
Prepare all the cones this way. Method of making cream:
Add icing sugar to lukewarm milk and mix well with a spoon; once the sugar dissolves completely, add vanilla essence and stir well to prepare sugar syrup in this way.
Keep this mixture in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Cut the butter into small pieces, take it in a glass bowl, and whip it with a whipping machine until smooth.
Then add one spoon of the prepared sugar syrup to it, keep whipping, add all the mixture little by little, and keep whipping.
Once the cream becomes properly fluffy (light), fill it in a plastic cone and fill it into the rolls.
Roll the puff pastry sheet into a half-inch thick square and cut off the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone by folding an aluminum cone or newspaper four times.
Wrap aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of the cone. Prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone from the pointed end upwards.
Prepare all the cones in this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray and polish the top with melted butter.
Bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and gently remove the paper cones after 10 minutes.
Prepare all the cones in this way. Method of making cream:
Add icing sugar to lukewarm milk and mix well with a spoon.
Once the sugar dissolves completely, add strawberry essence and red color, and stir well to prepare the sugar syrup.
Keep this mixture in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Cut the butter into small pieces, put them in a glass bowl, and beat with a whipping machine until smooth.
Then add one spoon of the prepared sugar syrup, keep beating, add all the mixture little by little, and keep beating.
Once the cream becomes fluffy and light, fill it into a plastic piping bag and fill the rolls.
Roll the puff pastry sheet into a half-inch thick square and cut off the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone by folding an aluminum cone or newspaper four times.
Wrap aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of the cone.
Prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone from the pointed end upwards, preparing all the cones in this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray and polish the top with melted butter.
Bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and gently remove the paper cones after 10 minutes.
Prepare all the cones in this way. Method of making cream:
Whip the whipping cream with a whipping machine until it becomes thick.
Then add chocolate powder, syrup, and chips, and whip again for five minutes.
Whip until the cream becomes fluffy and light.
Then fill it into a plastic piping bag and fill the rolls.
Roll the puff pastry sheet into a half-inch thick square and cut off the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone by folding an aluminum cone or newspaper four times.
Wrap aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of the cone.
Prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone from the pointed end upwards.
Prepare all the cones in this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray and polish the top with melted butter.
Bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Take them out of the oven and gently remove the paper cones after 10 minutes.
Prepare all the cones in this way. Method of making cream:
Add icing sugar to lukewarm milk and mix well with a spoon.
Once the sugar dissolves completely, add butterscotch essence and stir well to prepare the sugar syrup.
Keep this mixture in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Cut the butter into small pieces, put them in a glass bowl, and whip with a whipping machine until smooth.
Then add one spoon of the prepared sugar syrup, keep stirring, add all the mixture little by little, and keep whipping.
Once the cream becomes fluffy and light, fill it into a plastic piping bag and fill the rolls.

ing: Sugar (can be reduced according to taste) - 65 grams
steps: Boil water, 30 grams of sugar, salt, and 25 grams of oil in a pan on medium heat, then take it off the gas.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour) to it and mix until the dough binds together.
Then make long strips like gathiya and fry them in a deep vessel (place the gathiya disc in the sev maker and fry long strips in oil).
Then spread them on a napkin.
Mix 65 grams of sugar and cinnamon powder, and roll the fried churros in it.
Now the churros are ready to eat!
Roll the puff pastry sheet into a half-inch thick square and cut off the edges from all four sides.
Now cut vertical strips of the sheet, then make a cone by folding an aluminum cone or newspaper four times.
Wrap aluminum foil paper over the paper cone in the shape of the cone.
And prepare the cones as needed in this manner.
Wrap the dough strip slightly diagonally onto the cone from the pointed end upwards, preparing all the cones in this way.
Arrange all the cones on an aluminum tray.
Polish with melted butter on top and bake at 200 degrees for 30-35 minutes.
Then take them out of the oven and gently remove the paper cones after 10 minutes.
Bake all the cones in this way. Method of making cream:
Add icing sugar to lukewarm milk and mix well with a spoon.
Once the sugar dissolves completely, add orange essence and orange color, and stir well.
Prepare the sugar syrup in this way. Keep this mixture in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Then cut the butter into small pieces, put them in a glass bowl, and whip with a whipping machine until smooth.
Then add one teaspoon of the prepared sugar syrup.
Keep whipping, add all the mixture little by little, and keep whipping.
Once the cream becomes fluffy (light), fill it into a plastic piping bag and fill the rolls.
Mix milk, sugar, and yeast together and let it rest for five minutes.
Mix maida (all-purpose flour) flour, salt, and oil in another bowl.
Then combine the milk mixture and the flour mixture to knead a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes; the more you knead it, the softer it will become.
After the dough is kneaded, apply a little oil on top of it and cover and keep it for one hour.
After one hour, roll out all the kneaded dough like a thick roti that is about half an inch thick.
Cut rounds from this roti using a donut cutter, and if you don't have a cutter, you can use a bowl or glass without a rim.
Also, you can use a bottle cap to cut the round in the center.
Shape it according to what was shown in the photo above.
Make as many donuts as you can from that roti and keep them on wax paper.
Cut a square piece of paper for each donut and place it on top of that.
Then let the donuts rest for twenty minutes, and by that time, put oil on the gas stove.
After 20 minutes, fry the donuts in the oil just like you would fry a puri, frying them on both sides until they turn light brown.
After they cool down, dip one side of the donut in chocolate for the topping.
Similarly, you can make different donuts by rolling them in white chocolate, powdered sugar, cinnamon powder, or using grated dry coconut.
In a bowl, mix one cup of flour, yeast, and lukewarm water, and let it rest for ten minutes.
Then add the remaining flour, salt, and sugar, and knead the dough. Knead the dough for ten minutes.
Then cover it and keep it aside for two hours. After two hours, divide the dough into 10 equal parts.
Then make round dough balls of each, place them on a greased oven tray, and let them rest for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, make a hole in the center of the dough ball using an index finger of both hands, rotate it in a circle, and make a hole in the center, keeping the size as shown in the photo.
After making holes in all the bagels, put water to boil on the gas. Once the water boils, lower the gas.
Place two bagels at a time in the boiling water and leave them for one minute. After one minute, flip them to the other side and leave for another minute.
Similarly, after poaching all the bagels in water on both sides for one minute, take them out and place them on a tray.
Let them rest for a short while, then brush milk on top of them.
Sprinkle a little sesame seeds on top.
Then keep the oven temperature at 200 C. Once the oven reaches the temperature, place the bagel tray in the oven and leave it for twenty minutes.
Then take them out of the oven, slice them, apply butter or cream cheese on top, and serve for morning breakfast.
Combine maida (all-purpose flour), salt, sugar, and yeast in a vessel and set aside.
In another utensil, combine milk, water, and butter. Heat the mixture until the butter melts.
After heating, add vanilla essence to it and pour it into the flour vessel. Then knead a soft dough using your hands.
Grease a bowl with oil and place the dough in the bowl. Cover the dough and let it rest to double in size or for 2 hours.
Then roll out a thick 1/2 roti from the dough.
Cut small circles using a round cutter. Place them on a tray, cover them, and let them rise for 20-30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees. Now brush the munchkins with melted butter and sprinkle a little water in the tray.
Then place them in the oven and let them bake for 13 minutes.
While the munchkins are baking, make the glaze. Combine all the ingredients for the glaze and stir well.
Take the munchkins out of the oven, immediately dip them in the glaze, and take them out onto a tray.
If you want them sweeter, glaze them again once the first layer of glaze sets.
857.note: They taste best when eaten fresh. Instead of glaze, coatings like chocolate, powdered sugar, sugar-cinnamon powder, etc., can also be used.

steps: Apply peanut butter on one slice of bread.
Apply jam on the second slice of bread.
Arrange the peanut butter-applied bread on a dish, and place the jam-applied bread on top with the jam side facing down... sandwich is ready.
Apply peanut butter on one slice of bread.
Apply jam on the second slice of bread.
Arrange the peanut butter-applied bread on a dish, and place the jam-applied bread on top with the jam side facing down... sandwich is ready.
Preheat the oven to 175°C.
Peel the apples and slice them thinly.
Now mix sugar, maida (all-purpose flour), and salt in a bowl.
Mix the chopped apples into it.
Now take a baking tray, apply butter on it, and spread the apple mixture over it.
Then combine the topping ingredients in another bowl.
First, mix oats, maida (all-purpose flour), and brown sugar, place butter on top of it, and mix.
Spread this prepared topping mixture over the apple mixture.
Now bake it at 175°C for 55 minutes (until light brown on top).

ing: buttermilk (water can also be used) – 240 grams
steps: Take buttermilk, oil, and vanilla essence in a vessel and whisk well.
Sift maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, and sugar in another vessel.
Add grated lemon zest to it, and gradually add the buttermilk mixture to prepare a batter.
Whisk the batter for about 5 minutes. Turn on the waffle machine and apply oil to it.
Then pour the batter and cook it.
Once the waffle is done, serve it with maple syrup, butter, and chocolate syrup.
860.note: If you do not have a waffle machine at home, it can also be made on a griddle like a pancake and then called a pancake.

ing: maida (all-purpose flour) and extra for dusting – 2 cups
unsalted butter (for kneading the dough) and a little more for spreading on top of the buns – 2 tablespoons
a little milk for brushing on top of the buns
small pieces of chocolate and dry fruits
steps: Dissolve sugar in lukewarm water and immediately add the yeast.
Then cover and let that bowl rest.
Do not use the yeast until it is fully risen.
This process takes about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add salt and all the other ingredients to the flour, and gradually add the yeast water into the flour while kneading the dough.
Add a little unsalted butter in between. The dough should be soft like roti dough.
Cover the dough and let it rise for 35 minutes.
Once the dough has doubled in size, make very smooth buns and let them rest in a baking tray for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, once they have risen, gently apply milk on top.
Bake in the oven until light golden.
This process takes about 10-15 minutes, but keep checking it from time to time.
Once the buns are ready, apply unsalted butter on top. Method for maska bun:
Cut the bun from the middle and apply salted butter of your choice.
Also, garnish with fruit jam, whipping cream, tutty-fruity, chocolate, small pieces of dry-fruits, and chocolate syrup.
Then close both pieces of the bun like a dabeli and offer to Maharaj.
Method to make ladyfingers:
First, preheat the oven to 350F (180 degrees), then prepare a cookie pan.
In a bowl, mix butter and sugar and stir until fluffy.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour), baking powder, and vanilla and stir; do not mix too much.
Then put this batter into a piping bag (a bag with a half-inch round tip cut) and pipe 3-inch long strips onto the cookie pan.
Then bake in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes until golden, taking care that they do not become too brown (remove them when light yellow).
Then remove them from the pan to cool and set aside to cool.
Once completely cooled, sprinkle powdered sugar.
Then keep covered at room temperature for two days. Method to make tiramisu:
Mix the whipping cream until thick (fluffy) and set aside.
Then in a bowl, mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla extract, and add to the whipping cream.
Then mix and beat with an electric mixer until smooth.
Then combine cocoa powder and milk in a bowl. Dip the prepared ladyfingers into this cocoa powder mixture (do not dip too much).
Then arrange them in an 8 x 8 inch square pan.
Then make a layer of the cream mixture on top of it.
Then place another layer of ladyfingers on top and again make a layer of the cream mixture.
Repeat this process and layer the mixture over all the ladyfingers.
Then place it in the refrigerator to chill for four hours or overnight.
Before serving, dust cocoa powder on top.
Our tiramisu is ready to serve.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.
In a bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs and butter thoroughly.
Press this mixture firmly and evenly into a deep baking pan.
Pour the condensed milk evenly over it.
Spread both types of chocolate chips and butterscotch chips on top.
Sprinkle walnuts over it and finally spread the shredded coconut.
Press everything down evenly using a spoon.
Place the prepared pan in the oven to bake for 25 minutes.
Let it cool for a while, then cut it like bars. It can be kept at room temperature.
First, place a pan on the stove for the syrup, heat water in it, and then add sugar.
Once the sugar dissolves, add lemon juice to it.
Place another pan on the stove and heat butter in it. Once it melts, add oil and mix.
Now cut the phyllo pastry according to the size of the tray.
Now apply the butter and oil mixture on top.
Then place two pastry sheets on it. Again apply the butter mixture.
Again place two pastry sheets on it. Again apply the butter mixture.
Make six layers like this. Then spread coarsely ground pistachios over it.
Place two pastry sheets on it. Again apply the butter mixture.
Again place two pastry sheets on it.
Now apply all the remaining butter mixture.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
Now place the tray in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Then take it out and pour all the sugar syrup over it.
Now the baklava is ready.
864.note: You can also use coarsely ground mixed dry-fruits along with pistachios.

steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and heat on medium flame, stirring continuously so that it does not burn.
Stir on the flame for about 15 minutes, until bubbles appear in the milk. Now its color will turn brown.
Then remove from the flame and continue stirring for another 10 to 15 minutes, making sure to stir until it cools down.
This ensures all the ingredients do not separate and it remains very smooth.
Now place parchment paper on a tray and grease it with oil so that the fudge does not stick.
Now pour the cooled mixture into a square tray. Place the tray in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours.
Take it out and cut it into your desired sizes.

ing: unsalted butter at room temperature melted – 150 grams
steps: Preparation:
Preheat the oven to 180 C for baking about 10 minutes in advance.
Keep the butter outside the fridge for 20-25 minutes before use so that it melts, or heat it for 5 minutes and then let it cool slightly.
Apply butter or oil to the baking tray/pan.
Then put butter paper on the baking tray, this makes it easier to remove the brownie from the baking tray (but this step is optional).
Apply a little butter on the butter paper. Method of making brownie:
Mix maida (all-purpose flour), bura (powdered sugar) sugar, salt, baking powder, cocoa powder all together and sieve well.
Take melted (cooled) butter in another bowl, add curd and vanilla essence to it and mix well.
In that mixed buttery mixture, gradually add the dry ingredients sieved in the first step little by little.
Mix chocolate chips and walnuts into it. Now transfer the brownie mixture into the prepared baking tray.
Then put the tray in the preheated oven and bake for about 35-40 minutes.
However, keep checking on it after 20 minutes so that it does not burn.
When you feel the brownie is ready, insert a knife into it and check; if the knife comes out clean, the brownie is ready.
Let the brownie cool down before removing it from the baking tray.
Then take it out, remove the butter paper and cut it according to your preference.
Cut one tomato into small pieces. Finely chop some basil leaves. Mix everything in a bowl.
Place the second tomato directly on the gas wire mesh/grate.
Roast the tomato until you see black spots.
Once done, put the tomato in ice-cold water.
After some time, peel the skin off the tomato.
Then cut that tomato into small pieces. Then add salt, pepper to taste, and then a little olive oil and freshly chopped fresh coriander leaves.
Mix everything and set aside for 10-15 minutes or as long as needed. To prepare the bread:
Cut the Italian bread diagonally into 1/2 inch thickness (as shown in the photo).
Brush olive oil on both sides of the bread.
Place the bread slices on the grill on low flame.
Keep turning the bread pieces.
On top of each prepared bread slice, spread the previously prepared tomato mixture.
Garnish with freshly chopped fresh coriander leaves and your bruschetta is ready to serve.
First of all, take milk in a pan and boil it on medium heat until bubbles appear.
Now mix sugar and corn starch in another bowl.
Then slowly add this mixture to the milk while stirring continuously.
Now keep stirring it and let it thicken (do not boil).
Now remove it from the gas, add vanilla essence and mix well.
Let this prepared pudding cool down.
Remove all the outer and inner peels of the oranges and cut them into medium-sized pieces.
Cut the walnuts into small pieces.
Take cool whip in a bowl, add orange and walnut pieces to it and mix well
869.note: Strawberries or pieces of your favorite fruit can be placed on top of it.

steps: In a bowl, mix cornflour, 250 ml milk and cocoa powder thoroughly.
Transfer the mixture into a kadhai and add the remaining milk.
Keep it on low heat and stir continuously. Now add sugar to it.
Stir until the sugar dissolves.
Then add cream, stir until smooth.
Now add chocolate chips to it. Stir until it melts and thickens.
Now turn off the gas, add vanilla essence and salt and stir.
Let this prepared pudding stay in the fridge for 2 hours.
First, mix the curd and sugar using a hand mixer for 5 minutes.
Then add oil, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and vanilla essence to it and mix again for 3-4 minutes.
Now slowly add maida (all-purpose flour) to it while mixing. Now mix the tutti-frutti into it.
Now put this prepared mixture into a bread pan.
Bake it in the oven at 180°C for 40 minutes. Tutti-frutti bread is ready.

ing: cinnamon and cardamom powder – to taste
badam (almonds) and akhrot (walnuts) finely chopped – 20 grams(2 tablespoons)
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F).
Now in another bowl, mix wheat flour along with baking powder, soda, almonds, walnuts, sugar, cinnamon, and cardamom powder.
Combine vanilla essence and oil with the mashed bananas and stir.
Add everything mixed with the flour into the banana mixture.
Now stir this mixture well. This mixture will be slightly loose.
If the bananas are not very ripe, adding the flour will make the mixture bind like roti dough, so if it feels like that, add 1/4 cup of milk with the mashed bananas and mix everything.
Prepare the bread pan by placing parchment paper in it or greasing it with oil.
Pour this mixture into the pan using a large spoon and place the pan in the oven for 50 minutes.
872.note: : After 50 minutes, insert the tip of a knife into the bread. If the batter does not stick, the bread is ready; if it sticks, leave it for another 10 minutes. After the bread is done, turn off the oven and keep the bread inside for a little while so that it cooks nicely, and then cut it after it cools down.

steps: Place the chocolate in a heatproof bowl.
Place cream, milk, sugar, and butter in a kadhai (pan) over medium heat and stir occasionally.
After 10-15 minutes, immediately pour it over the bowl containing the chocolate.
Keep stirring until the chocolate melts. Add 2 drops of vanilla essence to it.
Put this prepared chocolate sauce in a fondue pot and serve with fresh fruits, cake, or cookies.
If you are using a bowl instead of a fondue pot and the sauce has become too thick, reheat it.
First, sift and mix both powders and powdered sugar in a bowl.
Take water in a vessel and boil it.
Now place another large bowl on top of it such that it does not touch the water.
Put coconut oil in that bowl, slowly add the mixed powder to it, and mix well.
Then pour it into chocolate molds and place these molds in the deep freezer for 4 – 5 hours.
Now after it sets, it can be taken out of the molds and used.
Peel the mango and extract its pulp (the weight of the pulp should be 500 grams).
Then make a smooth puree of it in a mixer without adding water.
Put a non-stick pan on heat, add the puree, and stir for 2 minutes.
Then add sugar and mix well.
After 10 minutes, add lemon juice and let it boil on medium heat.
Once it thickens, turn off the gas and let it cool down.
875.note: Can be stored in the refrigerator by filling it in a glass bottle.

steps: First, peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, clean and wash it, then cut it into small pieces.
Make a smooth paste of the pineapple in a mixer.
Now heat a non-stick pan, add the pineapple pulp to it and stir for a while.
Then add sugar to it and boil on low heat, keep stirring so that the sugar and pulp mix well.
Turn the gas flame to medium and boil until the pulp thickens.
When the jam is almost ready, add lemon juice and a pinch of yellow color, mix well and turn off the gas.
Once the jam cools down, fill it in an airtight bottle and store it in the fridge.
Wash the strawberries thoroughly and chop them.
Then combine strawberries and sugar in a pan and keep stirring on medium heat until the sugar dissolves.
Then add 1 lemon juice to it.
Keep stirring it continuously so that it does not stick to the pan.
To check if it is ready, take it in a spoon and drop it onto any dish.
If the mixture does not fall down from the spoon, then understand that the jam is ready.
882.note: Strawberry jam can be enjoyed spread on bread or roti.

steps: Crush all the above spices in a mixer and sift them using a maida (all-purpose flour) sifter.
Pound almonds, pista, charoli (chironji), and nutmeg separately, and if they are finely ground, do not sift them.
Steam the amla or boil them in a cooker with one cup of water up to 3 whistles.
Once the amla cool down, remove the seeds, crush them in a mixer to make a smooth paste, and strain it.
Then put 7 tablespoons of ghee in a vessel and add the amla mawa (khoya) to it.
After a while, add sakar to it.
When it becomes transparent and slightly dark in color, remove it on a dish to check.
When the mawa (khoya) does not spread outside and stays as a dot, turn off the gas and slowly keep adding the spices while stirring.
Keep it slightly thick and a bit loose.
First, mix curd, water, black salt, roasted cumin powder, and pepper powder in a deep vessel.
Now prepare buttermilk using a blender.
Now mix salt into it as needed.
Add green fresh coriander leaves to it and put the buttermilk in the fridge to chill for an hour.
Now serve the buttermilk in glasses.
950.note: Adding all the above spices makes masala buttermilk. If spices are not added, it becomes plain buttermilk.

steps: First, boil the milk in a bowl and let it cool down.
When the milk is lukewarm, add buttermilk or curd to it and stir well.
Now cover it and keep it in a warm place.
Depending on the season, curd takes different times to set.
Mostly, if set at night, curd is ready early in the morning.

First, strain the milk and put it in a vessel to heat, making it very hot so that it reduces by half. Now add sugar, charoli (chironji), cardamom powder, and cashew-almond pieces to it and mix well. Serve it chilled. It can also be served piping hot.
Cut the oranges in half through the middle along with the peel.
Now extract all the juice by pressing them by hand using a juicer.
Now add powdered sugar and ice cubes and blend again.
Pour into glasses and serve.
Crush watermelon and mint in a mixer, take sugar, pepper powder, lemon juice, and ice cubes, and mix it well.
Add a little water only if felt necessary.
Now pour it into glass tumblers, garnish with mint leaves and a lemon slice, and serve nice and cold.
Take chopped pineapple, sugar, pepper powder, black salt powder, and ice cubes in a mixer and mix well.
A little water can be added if deemed necessary.
Now pour it into a glass, garnish with a lemon slice, and serve nice and cold.
Peel the apples and cut them into pieces in a mixer jar.
Now take sugar, pepper powder, black salt powder, and ice cubes in it and mix well.
A little water can be added if felt necessary.
Now pour it into a glass and serve nice and cold.
Mix all the above ingredients together in a glass.
You can decorate it by placing two ice cubes on top in the glass, a lemon slice and 3 mint leaves.
Clean the jamun and remove the seeds.
Then grind it in a mixer by adding sugar and black salt.
Add water if needed. Then serve it by putting a few ice cubes in it.
Chop all the fruit, combine with honey or sugar, milk or water, and blend in a mixer.
Now your smoothie is ready.
First put milk to heat in a pan.
Boil for a while to thicken.
After the milk boils, add the crushed Dairy Milk chocolate to it and mix well.
Then add a little cinnamon powder to it, mix and the hot chocolate is ready.
Mix all the above ingredients well using a blender.
Then add ice cubes to it.
So the nice and delicious pina colada juice is ready.
Put all the ingredients shown in the recipe into a mixer and blend them.
Then pour it into a glass and decorate by placing small pieces of mango on top.
First wash the chikoos and chop them finely.
Then put the chikoos in a mixer jar and add milk, sugar, cashews, almonds and crush them.
Then add vanilla ice cream to it and blend well until smooth.
Place the chikoo shake in the fridge for a while to chill it more.
After it becomes cold, pour it into a glass, add small pieces of cashews and serve.
968.note: Can also be made without adding vanilla ice cream.

steps: First take milk in a mixer jar.
Add chocolate ice cream, cocoa powder and sugar to it and crush.
Now pour it into a glass.
Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream and chocolate chips on top of it.
Then decorate from top using chocolate syrup and serve.
First take water in a cup and soak the sabja seeds in it.
Now put one cup of water to boil in a small pan.
Once the water boils, add falooda sev to it and boil for 2 minutes.
After boiling, drain the excess water from it.
Take cold milk in a bowl and add rose syrup and cream to it.
Now blend this mixture well using a blender.
Now for serving, pour rose syrup around the inner edge of the glass.
By doing this, streaks will go down and it will look good.
Now put boiled sev, soaked sabja seeds, strawberry crush, sliced cashews-almonds and rose milk into that glass.
Place vanilla ice cream on top of it and give a straw and spoon to Ghanshu Maharaj so he can enjoy drinking it.
970.note: You can also take fresh home malai. Whisk it with a beater.

steps: First soak the figs in some warm water.
Now put the milk to heat and add sugar to it.
After it comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat until it thickens.
Once thickened, remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature.
While the milk is cooling, grind cashews, almonds and figs separately.
Then add it to the cooled milk.
And place it in the fridge to chill for 1 hour.
After chilling, run a blender through it once.
Now pour it from a height into a pot or glass (meaning keep the pot or glass much lower than the vessel while filling so that foam forms on the surface and the shake looks nice).
Then garnish with cashews and figs.
First, take 200 grams of mango pieces in a mixer jar and crush them, then add curd, powdered sugar, and mango essence to it and crush again.
Now take it in a bowl or vessel, chop and add the remaining mango pieces (150 grams) finely into it.
Now keep it in the fridge for 30 minutes to let it chill.
Take nice glasses, pour the prepared lassi, and offer it to beloved Ghanu.
Take sugar in a bowl and add water to it.
Let it rest for 15 minutes and keep stirring until all the sugar dissolves.
Now the sugar water is ready.
989.note: Cold water or ice can be used.

steps: First, add sugar, GMS powder, CMC powder, corn flour, and saffron to the milk.
Now place it on the gas stove and let it heat until it thickens.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and saffron essence to it, and mix well.
Pour the milk into an aluminium container and place it in the freezer.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the freezer.
Put it in a mixer and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add chopped pistachios to it and mix well.
Pour it back into the aluminium container and place the ice cream in the freezer to set.
Once the ice cream is set properly, use it.
Place milk with sugar, GMS powder, and CMC powder on the gas stove and let it heat until it thickens.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, mix well, pour the milk into an aluminium container, and place it in the fridge.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the fridge, put it in a mixer, and mix until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add cashew and raisin pieces to it, mix well, pour it again into the aluminium container, and place the ice cream in the fridge to set.
Once the ice cream is set properly, use it.
First, boil the figs in a pan and mash them.
Place milk with sugar, GMS powder, and CMC powder on the gas stove and let it heat until it thickens.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream, vanilla essence, and mashed figs to it, and mix well.
Then pour the milk into an aluminium container and place it in the fridge.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the fridge, put it in a mixer, and mix until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add cashew pieces to it, mix well, pour it again into the aluminium container, and place the ice cream in the fridge to set.
Once the ice cream is set properly, use it.
In a rectangular plastic container, first apply a 1 to 1 ½ inch layer of strawberry ice cream at the bottom.
Now place it in the freezer and let it freeze for 10 to 15 minutes.
Take it out from the freezer and apply a 1 to 1 ½ inch layer of butterscotch ice cream over it.
Place it in the freezer and let it freeze for 10 to 15 minutes.
Then apply a layer of vanilla ice cream over the butterscotch ice cream.
Mix almonds, pistachios, cashews, and chocolate chips in a bowl. Make this mixture the topmost layer.
Now keep it in the freezer until the ice cream is completely frozen.
1003.note: First, a layer of sponge cake or bread can also be applied before the strawberry ice cream.

steps: Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add custard powder and milk powder to it, and mix well, keeping it aside. (Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk)
Coarsely crush half of the dry fruits and thinly slice the other half.
Soak saffron in two tablespoons of lukewarm milk for a while.
Then mix it well into the milk and set aside.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the gas to heat.
Once the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat and boil the milk for 10 minutes.
Then add the saffron and custard powder milk mixture to it and mix well.
Next, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
Once the milk thickens slightly (coating the back of a spoon), remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream, mawa (khoya), yellow color, and vanilla essence to it, and mix well.
Now pour this mixture into an aluminium container and place it in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the fridge and beat it with a beater until completely smooth.
Then mix in the crushed dry fruits and some slices.
Now pour it into the aluminium container, garnish the top with dry fruit slices, and place the ice cream in the fridge to set.
Once the ice cream is set properly, serve it.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder to it, mix well and keep it aside. (Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk)
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat for 5-7 minutes.
Then add the powder-mixed milk into it and mix well.
After that, add sugar and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the stove and keep it aside.
Now heat some water in a large pan.
Now fill grated chocolate in another small pan, place it inside the pan with hot water, and stir the chocolate for a while.
Once the chocolate melts completely, add it to the boiled milk, mix well, and set the milk aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and chocolate essence to it, and mix well.
Then pour it into an aluminum container and place it in the freezer to chill for 2-3 hours.
Once the ice cream sets, take it out from the freezer and beat it with a beater for 10-15 minutes.
Beat it until the ice cream becomes completely smooth and its quantity doubles.
Then mix in the chocolate chips, pour it into an airtight container, and place it in the freezer to set for 5-6 hours.
Once the ice cream is set, take it in a bowl, pour chocolate sauce over it, and serve.

ing: Cashew, almond and walnut pieces – 25 grams
steps: Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add G.M.S. powder, C.M.C. powder and corn flour to it, and mix well.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk and keep it aside.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the powder-blended milk into it and mix well.
After that, add sugar and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, run a blender in it for a while to make it smooth.
Then pour it into an aluminum container and place it in the refrigerator.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the refrigerator, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk is completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Now add cashew, almond and walnut pieces to it and mix.
Now pour it into an aluminum container or candy molds and place the ice cream in the refrigerator to set.
Once the ice cream is set, take it in a bowl, pour chocolate syrup over it, and serve.
Crush green and black grapes in a pan, add the crushed grapes and powdered sugar, and cook until it thickens.
Soak 25 grams of dry raisins in 50 ml of lukewarm milk.
Add sugar, G.M.S. powder, C.M.C. powder, and corn flour to milk, place it on the stove, and let it heat until it thickens.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream, the cooked mixture of green and black grapes, soaked black raisins, and vanilla essence.
Mix it well, pour the milk into an aluminum container, and place it in the refrigerator.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the refrigerator, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk is completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add the remaining black raisins, mix well, pour back into the aluminum container, and place the ice cream in the refrigerator to set.
Once the ice cream is properly set, use it.

ing: Cashew, almond and walnut pieces – as required
steps: Put 1 scoop of vanilla or mango ice cream in a glass or small bowl.
Then make a layer of mango pieces over it.
Again put 1 scoop of ice cream on top of it.
After that, make a layer of cream and mango pulp, and add dry fruits like cashews on top.
Sweet and sour mango sundae ice cream is ready.
1008.note: Choose mangoes that are slightly sweet and sour.

steps: Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder to it, mix well and keep it aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the powder-blended milk into it and mix well.
After that, add sugar and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, run a blender in it for a while to make it smooth.
Then pour it into an aluminum container and place it in the refrigerator.
When the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the refrigerator, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk is completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Add Tutti Frutti to it and mix again.
Now pour it into an aluminum container or candy molds and place the ice cream in the refrigerator to set.
Once the ice cream is completely set, take it out from the refrigerator, pour syrup of your favorite flavor over it, and enjoy Tutti Frutti ice cream.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, mix G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder in it properly and keep it aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan, put it on the stove to heat, and also add milk mawa (khoya) to it.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the milk mixed with powder to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk becomes slightly thick, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream freezes slightly, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Now add cashew, almond and pistachio slivers and cardamom powder to it and mix well.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds, scatter some cashew, almond and pistachio slivers and cardamom powder on top, and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
First, remove the seeds from the black jamun and extract the pulp.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, mix G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder in it properly and keep it aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the milk mixed with powder to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk becomes slightly thick, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Now add the black jamun pulp to it and mix well.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream freezes slightly, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Add cashew, almond and pistachio slivers to it.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
First, prepare the strawberry pulp.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, mix G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder in it properly and keep it aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the milk mixed with powder to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk becomes slightly thick, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and strawberry essence to it, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Now add the strawberry pulp to it and mix well.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream freezes slightly, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Add cashew, almond and pistachio slivers to it.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds, scatter strawberry pieces on top, and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
First, prepare the custard apple pulp.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, mix G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder in it properly and keep it aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the milk mixed with powder to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk becomes slightly thick, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Now add the custard apple pulp to it and mix well.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream freezes slightly, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Add cashew pieces to it.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add custard powder to it, mix well and keep aside.
Stir until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
After that, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Then add the milk mixed with custard powder to it and mix well.
Once the milk becomes slightly thick, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream freezes slightly, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Now add raisins, mini chocolate cookies, jelly and cashew pieces to it and mix well.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
First, chop the pineapple into fine pieces.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, mix G.M.S. powder and C.M.C. powder in it thoroughly, and keep it aside.
Stir the milk until the powder dissolves completely.
Now take the rest of the milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the milk with the powder to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk thickens a bit, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and pineapple essence, and run a blender for a while to make it smooth.
Now add the pineapple pieces and mix well.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream is slightly set, take it out from the freezer, put it in a mixer, and blend until the milk is completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Now fill it in an aluminum container or candy molds and put the ice cream in the freezer to set.
Freeze the strawberries. Then prepare their juice.
First of all, take four glasses and put 180 grams of vanilla flavored yogurt in each.
Mix all the berries—blackberry, raspberry, blueberry—with the strawberry juice.
Now make a layer of this fruit on top of the yogurt in the glass. Then make a layer of granola on top of it.
Keep layering like this until the glass is filled to the top.
Now immediately serve this yogurt parfait to Maharaj.
Take oil and butter in a bowl, add powdered sugar to it, and whisk well.
Now add vanilla essence and salt to it.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour) flour and milk to prepare a thin batter.
Make sure the batter does not become too thin.
Now take a spoonful of batter on a non-stick tawa and spread it into a thin layer like a circular pancake.
Once the cone layer is ready, shape it into a cone using the aluminum cone mold.
Make the rest of the cones similarly.
Now fill a scoop of choco chips ice cream into this cone and place it inside.
Serve lovingly and plenty to Maharaj.
Take oil and butter in a bowl, add powdered sugar to it, and whisk well.
Now add vanilla essence and salt to it.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour) flour and milk to prepare a thin batter.
Make sure the batter does not become too thin.
Now take a spoonful of batter on a non-stick tawa and spread it into a thin layer like a circular pancake.
Once the cone layer is ready, shape it into a cone using the aluminum cone mold.
Make the rest of the cones similarly.
Now apply chocolate syrup along the inner sides of this cone.
