Then fill a scoop of vanilla ice cream and place it in the cone.
Pour chocolate syrup on top as well and serve lovingly and plenty to Maharaj.
Take oil and butter in a bowl, add powdered sugar to it, and whisk well.
Now add vanilla essence and salt to it.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour) flour and milk to prepare a thin batter.
Make sure the batter does not become too thin.
Now take a spoonful of batter on a non-stick tawa and spread it into a thin layer like a circular pancake.
Once the cone layer is ready, shape it into a cone using the aluminum cone mold.
Make the rest of the cones similarly.
Now fill a scoop of saffron pistachio ice cream into this cone and place it inside.
Garnish the top with almond and pistachio slices and serve lovingly and plenty to Maharaj.
Take oil and butter in a bowl, add powdered sugar to it and whisk well.
Now add vanilla essence and salt to it.
Then add maida (all-purpose flour) flour and milk to it to prepare a thin batter.
Make sure the batter does not become too thin.
Now take a spoonful of batter on a non-stick tawa and spread it into a thin layer like a circular pancake.
Once the cone layer is ready, shape it into a cone using an aluminum cone mold.
Make the rest of the cones in the same way.
Now fill these cones with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a scoop of choco chips ice cream.
Offer lovingly to Ghanshyam Maharaj.
1025.note: Any two ice creams can be taken, and the ice cream can be made slightly liquid, poured in equal parts into the cones, and placed in the freezer to set.

steps: In a large bowl, add maida (all-purpose flour), salt, cinnamon powder, and cocoa powder and combine gently with hands.
Now add oil, water, and white vinegar to this flour mixture and mix with hands.
Keep sprinkling small amounts of grape juice over it and knead the dough.
Now cover it with a cloth and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, take small portions of the dough, make balls, and roll them out like rotis.
Now wrap the rolled roti around the aluminum cone mold, sealing one loose end onto the roti with water.
Now place this mold with the roti into a frying vessel with heated oil to fry.
Once the cannoli cones are fried, remove them onto a paper towel in a vessel to cool, then transfer them to another vessel.
While the cones are cooling, prepare the cream filling. Cream filling:
Whisk cream cheese and sugar using a hand mixer.
Fold it into the heavy whipping cream and keep mixing until it becomes slightly stiff.
Now fill the cream into the cones.
Decorate by sprinkling chocolate chips on top, and the cannoli cones are ready to serve.
Put all the above-mentioned ingredients in a blender and blend until everything is uniform.
Now fill it into the candy molds.
Place in the freezer for a few hours.
Once set, they can be removed from the molds and consumed.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 teaspoon
steps: Take sugar and water in a pan and boil it.
Then add color, citric acid crystals, and essence to it.
Mix well to prepare a liquid thinner than sugar syrup, then let it cool.
Now pour this liquid into candy molds and put it in the freezer to set.
1028.note: Can be made using different colors and essences.

ing: Candy molds - small and large sizes
steps: First take cream in a large bowl.
Add powdered sugar to it and whip it with a beater for one minute.
Now add vanilla essence and milk to it and whip again for 1-2 minutes.
Now pour the prepared mixture into small candy molds.
Place it in the freezer to set for 8 hours or until completely set.
Now blend mango pulp and sugar in a mixer to make mango syrup.
Add a little water if needed.
Now spoon this pulp into the large candy molds.
Take the set candy out from the freezer molds.
Then submerge the candy right in the center of the large mold containing the mango syrup.
Put it back in the freezer to set.
Once set, carefully remove it from the mold and offer to Ghanshyam Maharaj.
First, take cream in a large bowl.
Add powdered sugar to it and whip it with a beater for one minute.
Now add vanilla essence and milk to it.
Whip it again for 1-2 minutes.
Now pour the prepared mixture into candy molds.
Place it in the freezer to set for 8 hours or until it is completely set.
Now heat some water in a pan and place a large bowl over it, making sure that the bowl does not touch the water.
Now add dark chocolate along with butter into that bowl.
In a short while, the chocolate will melt and become like a chocolate sauce.
Now take it in a deep glass and let it cool slightly.
Then remove the frozen candy placed in the freezer from the candy mold and dip it into the prepared chocolate sauce.
Put it back in the freezer to set.
Chocobar is ready.

ing: Candy molds - small and large size
steps: First, take cream in a large bowl.
Add powdered sugar to it and whip it with a beater for one minute.
Now add vanilla essence and milk to it.
Whip it again for 1-2 minutes.
Now take the prepared mixture in small candy molds and place it in the freezer to set for 8 hours or until it is completely set.
Now to make raspberry pulp, blend raspberry fruit and sugar together in a mixer. Add raspberry red color and a little water and mix it in the mixer.
Now pour this raspberry syrup with a spoon into large candy molds.
Then remove the frozen candy from the freezer out of its mold and submerge it right in the middle of the large mold into which the raspberry syrup was poured.
Put it back in the freezer to set.
Once set, carefully remove it from the mold and offer it to Ghanshyam Maharaj.
Take cream in a pan, add white chocolate and vanilla essence to it and heat it.
Once the white chocolate melts, take it in an aluminum mold and place it in the fridge for 15-20 minutes.
Now take it out of the fridge, add dark chocolate cookies to it and mix it well. Now pour the prepared mixture into candy molds.
Place it in the freezer to set for 8 hours or until it is completely set.
Then remove the frozen candy placed in the freezer from the candy mold and dip it in chocolate syrup.
Put it back in the freezer to set.
So the choco truffle candy is ready.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl and add G.M.S., C.M.C. powder, and corn flour to it.
Mix well and keep aside, stirring until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a vessel, put it on the gas to heat, and also add milk mawa (khoya) to it.
After the milk comes to a boil, boil it on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the corn flour and powdered milk mixture to it and mix well.
After that, add sugar and boil the milk on medium heat for a while.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk becomes completely cold, add cream and vanilla essence to it, run a blender in it for a while to make it smooth.
Then fill it in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
When the ice cream sets slightly, take it out of the fridge.
Put it in a mixer jar and mix it in the mixer until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Now add cashews, almonds, and pistachio slivers and cardamom powder to it and stir well.
Now fill it in candy molds and put the candy in the fridge to set.
Add sugar, G.M.S. powder, C.M.C. powder, corn flour, and crushed saffron to the milk.
Put it on the gas to heat and let it heat until it thickens.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the gas and set it aside to cool.
When the milk becomes completely cold, add cream and vanilla essence to it and mix well.
Fill the milk in an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
When the ice cream sets slightly, take it out of the freezer.
Put it in a mixer jar and crush it until the milk becomes completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add pistachio, cashew, and almond slivers to it and mix well.
Take it in matkas and put them back in the freezer.
Matka kulfi is ready.
Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl and add GMS powder, CMC powder, and corn flour to it.
Mix well and keep aside, stirring until the powder dissolves completely in the milk.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan, put it on the stove to heat, and also add milk mawa (khoya) to it.
Bring the milk to a boil, then simmer on medium heat for 8-10 minutes.
Then add the corn flour and powder milk mixture to it and mix well.
Afterwards, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for a short while.
Once the milk thickens slightly, remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream and vanilla essence to it, and blend for a short while to make it smooth.
Then pour it into an aluminum container and place it in the freezer.
Once the ice cream is slightly set, take it out of the freezer.
Put it in a mixer and blend until the milk is completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Then add the pista slices and mix well.
Now fill it into candy molds and place it in the fridge to set.
Soak the sabja seeds in water for at least 30 minutes.
Also, boil the falooda, drain the water, and keep it aside.
Grind the sugar and saffron together.
Combine condensed milk, milk, heavy whipping cream, and cool whip in a large bowl.
Using an electric hand blender, mix gently.
Add rose syrup to the saffron and sugar mixture and blend well.
Pour the mixture into a large airtight container.
Place the kulfi in the freezer for at least 4 to 6 hours, or until it is semi-set.
Since we need to add sabja seeds and falooda noodles, it should not be completely frozen.
Then add the sabja seeds and falooda noodles, and mix well with a spoon.
Pour this mixture into kulfi cups and place them to freeze for 6-8 hours depending on your refrigerator temperature.
Once set, take it out and offer it to Maharaj.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 spoon
steps: Take sugar and water in a kadhai, boil it, and then add color, citric acid crystals, and essence to it.
Mix well until it forms a syrup-like consistency, then let it cool.
Now grate the ice in a gola maker, put it in a glass, and press the ice down slightly with your hand.
Then pour the flavored color over it and you can add dry fruit and grated dry coconut.
Then place a scoop of ice cream on top and serve.
1038.note: Ice gola can be made using different colors and essences. If you don't have a gola maker, it can also be crushed in a mixer jar. The ice machine has molds for ice where the ice should be placed.

ing: Cashew nuts, almonds, pistachio, walnuts – 1 cup
steps: Take about 50 grams of cold milk in a bowl, add custard powder and milk powder to it, mix well, and keep aside.
Stir until the powder is completely dissolved in the milk.
Crush half of the dry fruits coarsely and cut the other half into thin slices.
Now soak two tablespoons of saffron in lukewarm milk for a short while.
Then mix it well into the milk and keep it aside.
Now take the remaining milk in a pan and put it on the stove to heat.
After the milk comes to a boil, simmer on medium heat and boil the milk for 10 minutes.
Then add the saffron and custard powder milk to it and mix well.
Afterwards, add sugar to it and boil the milk on medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
Once the milk thickens slightly (such that it sticks to the spoon), remove it from the stove and set it aside to cool.
When the milk is completely cool, add cream, mawa (khoya), yellow color, and vanilla essence to it and mix well.
Now pour this mixture into an aluminum container and place it in the fridge for 2-3 hours.
Once the ice cream is slightly set, take it out of the freezer and beat it with a beater until completely smooth.
Then mix in the crushed dry fruits and some slices.
Now fill it into candy molds and place the candy in the fridge to set.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 spoon
steps: Take sugar and water in a kadhai and boil it.
Then add color, citric acid crystals, and essence to it, mix well until it forms a syrup-like consistency, and let it cool.
Now grate the ice in a gola maker.
Take it in a small glass, insert a plastic stick or wooden stick right in the middle, and press the ice down firmly.
Then remove it from the glass, pour the prepared flavored color over it, and serve.
1040.note: Ice gola can be made using different colors and essences. If you don't have a gola maker, it can also be crushed in a mixer jar.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 tsp
steps: Take sugar and water in a kadhai and bring it to a boil.
Then add color, citric acid crystals and essence to it.
Mix well and once it forms a syrup-like consistency, let it cool down.
Now shave the ice in a gola maker, take it in a small bowl and gently press the ice with your hand.
Then pour the flavored color over it and serve by adding dry fruits, grated dry coconut, tutti-frutti and cherries.
1041.note: Ice gola can be made using different colors and essences. If you do not have a gola maker, the ice can also be crushed in a mixer jar. Do not add citric acid crystals to sweet colored syrups.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 tsp
steps: Take sugar and water in a kadhai and boil it.
Then add color, citric acid crystals and essence to it.
Mix it well to prepare a liquid thinner than sugar syrup and then let it cool down.
Now fill this liquid into cylindrical plastic bags that are 1 inch wide and 6 inches long.
Pack both ends and place them in the freezer to set.
1042.note: Pepsi can be made using different colors and essences.

ing: Citric acid crystals (limbu na phool) – 1 tsp
steps: Take sugar and water in a kadhai and boil it.
Then add color, citric acid crystals and essence to it.
Mix well and once it forms a syrup-like consistency, let it cool down.
Now shave the ice in a gola maker, take it in a small bowl and gently press the ice with your hand.
First, grate mawa (khoya) over it and gently press it onto the ice.
Then pour the flavored color over it and add grated dry coconut.
Now pour malai over it to give it a complete coating of malai.
Finally, garnish with chocolate chips and serve.
1043.note: Your favorite dry fruits and cherries etc. can also be used.

steps: Heat a teaspoon of ghee in a pan, add cashews and roast them on medium heat.
Roast the cashews until they turn slightly brown in color.
Then turn off the gas and transfer the cashews to another bowl, draining out the ghee.
Add salt to taste and mix well.
Once the cashews cool down, fill them in a bottle.
Heat a teaspoon of ghee in a pan, add almonds and roast them on medium heat.
Roast the almonds until they turn slightly dark in color.
Then turn off the gas and transfer the almonds to another bowl, draining out the ghee.
Add salt to taste and mix well.
Once the almonds cool down, fill them in a bottle.
Take large-sized dry chana in a bowl.
Now heat a kadai, add salt, and heat it thoroughly.
Now add a few chana to it.
Stir and roast the chana frequently (roast on high heat only).
Within two minutes, the chana will roast and start popping.
Once all the chana are roasted and popped, remove them using a slotted spoon, and leave the salt in the kadai.
Prepare the remaining chana in the same way by roasting them.
Now remove their outer black skin so that the chana do not taste too salty.
After they are roasted and ready, let them cool and store them in an airtight container.
So the plain roasted chana are ready.
First, take the peanuts and roast them on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes.
After roasting, separate all the skins of the peanuts.
Then rub the peanuts to split them properly into halves.
In a bowl, take powdered sugar, amchur (dry mango powder) powder, red chilli, garam masala, chaat masala, and black salt and mix them.
Then heat oil in a kadai.
When the oil is hot, add the peanuts and sauté them in the oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
Then remove the peanuts onto a plate.
Then add the prepared masala and mix well.
1068.note: Salted peanuts can also be used instead of raw peanuts.

steps: First, wash the peanuts thoroughly with water.
Then heat water in a cooker, add salt, turmeric, and peanuts, and let it whistle for 7 to 8 times.
After boiling, remove the peanuts into a colander and let them cool.
After they cool down, shell the peanuts, extract the seeds, and serve.
When peanuts are not fully mature, their seeds are completely white, and these unripe peanuts are called ola singh.
Heat sand in an iron kadai.
Then roast the peanuts in it.
After roasting, shell them and serve the warm seeds with jaggery.
Take water in a glass.
Dissolve the salt and then add Eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, and serve.
1073.note: Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and Eno.

steps: In a large glass, add lemon juice, powdered sugar, black salt, pepper powder, and chaat masala, then mix well.
Now add ice cubes and water to it and mix.
Then add eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, and serve.
1074.note: Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and eno.

steps: In a large glass, add lemon juice, black salt, and pepper powder, then mix well.
Now add ice cubes and water to it and mix.
Then add eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, and serve.
1075.note: Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and eno.

steps: In a large glass, add lemon juice, powdered sugar, black salt, pepper powder, and crush the mint leaves with your hands, then mix well.
Now add ice cubes and water to it and mix.
Then add eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, put a straw in the glass, and serve.
The glass can be decorated with a lemon slice and mint leaves.
1076.note: Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and eno.

steps: Roast cumin seeds and pepper in a pan on medium heat.
Once roasted and slightly cooled, coarsely grind them in a mixer jar.
Now in the same pan, take one cup of water, ground cumin, and sugar, and boil it.
Now add black salt powder and hand-crushed mint leaves to it.
Once this mixture becomes thick, turn off the gas, add chaat masala, mix, and strain the mixture through a strainer.
Allow this strained cumin syrup to cool.
Now take 50 ml of the prepared cumin syrup in a glass, add ice and water to it, and mix well.
Then add eno to it, stir with a spoon, and serve immediately.
1077.note: Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and eno.

steps: First, peel the orange and remove the seeds from it.
Now take these oranges in a mixer jar, add sugar, color, and lemon juice, and grind them finely.
Strain it through a strainer into a pan.
Now add orange essence to it and boil until it thickens.
Once thickened, let the orange syrup cool down.
Now take 50 ml of the prepared orange syrup in a glass, add ice and water to it, mix well, then add eno, stir with a spoon, and serve immediately.
1078.note: The taste becomes very good by making a masala of pepper powder, black salt powder, and cumin powder and adding it to the soda. Ready-made cold soda can also be used instead of water and eno.

steps: First, peel the outer skin of the lychees and remove the seeds from them.
Now, take these lychees in a mixer jar, add sugar and lemon juice, and grind it into a fine paste.
Strain it in a pan using a strainer.
Now add lychee essence to it and boil until it becomes thick.
After it becomes thick, let the lychee syrup cool down.
Now take 50 ml of the prepared lychee syrup in a glass.
Add ice, mint leaves crushed by hand, and water to it, and mix well.
Then add Eno to it, stir with a spoon, and serve immediately with a straw.
1079.note: Making a spice mix of black pepper powder, black salt powder, and cumin powder and adding it to the soda tastes very good. Ready cold soda can also be used in place of water and Eno.

steps: In a large glass, add lemon juice, black salt, and black pepper powder and mix well.
Now crush the mint leaves to extract their juice.
Also, crush a few leaves with your hand and put them in the glass.
Now add ice cubes and water to it and mix.
Then add Eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, and serve with a straw.
1080.note: Making a spice mix of black pepper powder, black salt powder, and cumin powder and adding it to the soda tastes very good. Ready cold soda can also be used in place of water and Eno.

steps: In a large glass, add lemon juice, ginger juice, black salt, and black pepper powder and mix well.
Now add ice cubes and water to it and mix.
Then add Eno to it, stir immediately with a spoon, and serve.
1081.note: Ready cold soda can also be used in place of water and Eno.

steps: First, extract the mosambi juice and strain it.
Now add as much cold water to this juice as the amount of juice.
If the mosambi is sour, sugar can be added as needed.
Then add black salt and cumin and mix well.
Finally, add Eno, stir, and serve immediately.
1082.note: Ready cold soda can also be used in place of water and Eno.

steps: First, peel the mango and cut it into pieces.
Now take these mango pieces in a mixer, add sugar and mango essence, and grind it smoothly.
Now strain it in a bowl using a strainer.
Now take 50 ml of the prepared mango syrup in a glass.
Add ice and water to it and mix well.
Then add Eno to it, stir with a spoon, and serve immediately.
1083.note: Making a spice mix of black salt powder and cumin powder and adding it to the soda tastes very good. Ready cold soda can also be used in place of water and Eno.

steps: Take the pineapple pieces in a mixer jar, add sugar and essence, and grind it to a smooth paste.
Strain it into a bowl using a strainer.
Now take 50 ml of the prepared pineapple syrup in a glass.
Add ice and water to it and mix well.
Then add Eno to it, stir with a spoon and serve immediately.
1084.note: Making a masala of black pepper, black salt and cumin powder and adding it to the soda tastes very nice. Ready cold soda can also be used instead of water and Eno.

ing: Jaljeera / amchur (dry mango powder) powder – 1/2 spoon
steps: Heat one spoon of ghee in a pan, add almonds, keep the flame medium first and then roast on low flame.
Roast the almonds until their color becomes slightly dark.
Then turn off the gas and remove the almonds to another bowl in such a way that the ghee drains out.
Then add all the above spices and mix well.
After it cools down, fill it in a bottle.
1090.note: Just like almonds, other dry fruits like cashews, pistachios, etc., can also be roasted.

steps: Take water in a bowl and add 1 teaspoon of black salt and lemon juice to it.
Now add dry dates to it and let them soak for 24 hours.
After 24 hours, slice the dry dates, take them out in a bowl and dry them.
Now add pomegranate powder, 1 teaspoon black salt, cumin powder, red chilli powder and amchur (dry mango powder) to it and mix everything well.
Now cover it with a sieve and keep it in the sun for 1 day.
So the dry dates mouth freshener is ready.
Rub the mango seeds well and wash them with water.
Then dry the seeds in the sun for 5 to 6 days.
Break the seeds collected in this way using a pestle to extract the kernels, breaking the seeds in such a way that whole kernels come out.
Put enough water in a vessel to submerge the kernels and heat it.
After the water gets hot, add the kernels and appropriate salt to it and boil the kernels.
After the kernels are boiled, strain out the water.
After the kernels cool down, chop them into thin slices.
Then spread them in a wide vessel and dry them in the sun for 2 days.
Then put a little ghee in a kadhai and roast on low flame.
After the kernels are roasted, take them out in a bowl, add appropriate black salt and mix well.
Rub the mango seeds well and wash them with water.
Then dry the seeds in the sun for 5 to 6 days.
Break the seeds collected in this way using a pestle to extract the kernels, breaking the seeds in such a way that whole kernels come out.
Put enough water in a vessel to submerge the kernels and heat it.
After the water gets hot, add the kernels and appropriate salt to it and boil the kernels.
After the kernels are boiled, strain out the water.
After the kernels cool down, chop them into thin slices.
Then spread them in a wide vessel and dry them in the sun for 2 days.
Then put ghee in a kadhai and fry on low flame.
After the kernels are fried, take them out in a bowl, add appropriate black salt and mix well.
1097.note: To make masala kernels, black pepper powder, black salt, amchur can be added to it.

steps: In a vessel, put enough water to submerge the amla and bring it to a boil.
Once the water becomes hot, add the amla to it and cover the vessel.
Keep checking the amla at regular intervals.
Boil them until the amla segments start separating. Take care not to overboil the amla.
Once the amla are boiled, turn off the heat, strain the water, and take the amla out of the water.
When the amla cool down a bit, separate all the segments one by one.
Take the amla segments in a vessel, add sugar, stir gently, and let it rest for 3 days.
After 3 days, once the sugar has dissolved, strain the sugary water that has come out.
Dry the amla segments in a wide vessel under the sun for 3 days.
Now they can be stored in an airtight container and used.
Chop the amla into long slices or square pieces.
Put the amla in a vessel or a plastic container, mix all the above spices into the amla, and keep it covered.
Let the amla stay like this for a full day and keep stirring them every 2 hours.
From the next day, dry those amla in the sun for 2 to 3 days.
Once the amla are dried, store them in a container.
1101.note: It is fine even if you prefer not to use spices other than salt.

ing: Jaljeera / amchur (dry mango powder) powder – 1/2 teaspoon
steps: Heat one teaspoon of ghee in a pan, add the cashews, and roast them on medium heat.
Roast them until the cashews turn slightly brown.
Then turn off the heat and transfer the cashews to another bowl in a way that drains out the ghee.
Next, add all the above spices and mix well.
Once cooled, store them in a bottle.
1104.note: Just like cashews, other dry fruits like almonds, pistachios, etc., can also be roasted.

ing: powdered sugar – 3 teaspoons (for coating on jaggery)
steps: Roast the cumin seeds on low heat, taking care not to roast them too much, and keep stirring continuously.
Once the cumin is roasted and cooled down, grind it in a mixer.
Now, combine cumin powder, amchur (dry mango powder) powder, black salt powder, rock salt, and sugar in a bowl and mix well.
Then add the lemon juice to the mixture little by little.
Do not add all the juice at once.
Form a dough ball just like you would knead a stiff dough.
Then roll it into small pills.
Roll these pills in sugar and arrange them separately on a plate.
Once all the pills are rolled, store them in a bottle and put the remaining sugar into the bottle as well.
1105.note: Pills made this way stay good for up to 1 year.

steps: Soak the black raisins in water and remove the seeds.
Now crush the black raisins, lemon juice, and powdered sugar in a mixer.
Transfer it to a plate and add amchur (dry mango powder) powder, cumin powder, salt, and pepper powder.
Now add water in the required quantity, knead like a dough, and roll into small pills.
Roll the pills in powdered sugar immediately.
Different types of drakshadivati can be made by adding color and essence.
Take fibreless ginger, peel it, and cut it into thin and long strips.
Then add black salt powder, lemon juice, and ajwain powder, and mix well.
Next, spread the strips loosely on a plate and dry them in the sun for 3 days.
After drying, store them in a bottle.
Mix fennel powder, white pepper powder, amla powder, cinnamon powder, powdered sugar, tamarind pulp, and cumin powder thoroughly in a bowl.
Now add lemon juice little by little into this mixture, mix it, and knead it into a stiff dough-like ball.
Now roll small pills from that dough.
Roll the pills in powdered sugar and place them on a plate.
After all the pills are coated in sugar this way, let them dry under a fan for a while and store them in an airtight bottle.
Soak the seeds in water for 5-10 minutes and wash them.
Then dry the seeds in the sun for 3-4 days.
After 3-4 days, crack open the seeds to take out the kernel inside and remove the brown skin from the kernel.
Put water in a vessel, add salt, and let it boil for 5-7 minutes.
Then turn off the gas and let the kernel soak in the water for 10 minutes.
Now take out the kernel, drain it, and let it cool.
Once the kernel is cool, cut it into chips and let it dry for 3-4 hours.
Then heat 3-4 teaspoons of ghee in a non-stick pan and roast the kernel chips on a very low flame until they become crisp.
Once cooled, add black salt, cumin powder, and salt to taste over them.
